Result: 在ALFWorld、AppWorld、WebShop三个基准上，使用GPT-5.4-mini、Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma-4-31B三个LLM进行评测（k=10，temperature=1.0）：(1) 全局一致性分数与经验任务成功率正相关（ALFWorld上Spearman ρ=0.80-0.83，AppWorld上0.57-0.74，WebShop上0.25-0.40）；(2) 任务成败预测平均AUROC达0.811，超越最佳行为一致性基线AC(0.729)及语言化置信度VC(0.769)，在9个模型-基准设置中的6个取得第一；(3) 在k=2-10的不同rollout预算下均优于基线；(4) 消融实验证实步数归一化和基于访问次数的节点加权均对性能有显著贡献。

Conclusion: GraphACM通过状态对齐的方式实现细粒度行为一致性分析，无需访问模型内部或训练，作为免训练的解释性信号可有效评估LLM智能体的可靠性并量化不确定性，在多个LLM和基准上稳定优于现有行为一致性方法和语言化置信度。局限性：一致性是间接可靠性指标，智能体可能一致地重复错误（如部分WebShop任务所示）；性能依赖状态抽象质量；需要多次rollout带来额外推理成本；评估局限于三个LLM和三个基准。

Abstract: Behavioral consistency across repeated executions provides an informative signal for assessing the reliability of large language model (LLM) agents. However, existing approaches typically summarize consistency with a single task-level score, without identifying where behavioral differences occur or whether actions are compared under equivalent decision contexts. We propose a graph-based framework for fine-grained behavioral consistency measurement and uncertainty quantification. Given multiple rollouts of the same task, we merge equivalent states into a directed, action-labeled graph, enabling action comparisons at shared decision states. We introduce node-level and global measures of action consistency, using the global consistency score as a proxy for uncertainty to predict task success or failure. Experiments across three LLMs on ALFWorld, AppWorld, and WebShop demonstrate that our measure is positively associated with task success and achieves an average AUROC of 0.811 for task-success prediction, outperforming the strongest behavioral-consistency baseline (0.729) and verbalized confidence (0.769). These results highlight the effectiveness of state-conditioned behavioral consistency and pinpoint where agent actions agree.

</details>


### [389] [Progress Reward Model for Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22056)
*Xiuhui Zhang,Ning Gao,Xingyu Jiang,Yihui Chen,Yuheng Pan,Mohan Zhang,Yue Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PRM4RL框架,通过LLM生成子任务分解与进度函数,并基于势能奖励塑形构造Progress Reward Model (PRM),为强化学习同时提供高层规划与低层密集奖励,在机器人控制任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RL在长周期稀疏奖励任务中表现受限;现有LLM增强方法(LLM作为规划器或奖励生成器)各执一端——前者依赖预定义技能库、无法优化低层控制策略,后者需要大量人工反馈或穷举搜索。亟需一种统一高层规划与低层奖励塑形的高效框架。

Method: 1) LLM通过Python代码格式的CoT提示,一次性生成三类内容:子任务列表(plan_list,"动词+名词"形式)、子任务判定函数Ψ(s)、细粒度进度函数Φ(s)。2) 基于势能奖励塑形理论,将Φ(s构造为PRM奖励:R^PRM = γ·Φ(s_{t+1}) - Φ(s_t) + 𝕀(s_{t+1})·r_bonus,证明策略不变性(Theorem 4.1)与收敛效率(Theorem 4.3,等价于Q值以Φ(s)初始化)。3) RL增强:子任务先验经SimCSE嵌入扩展状态空间,PRM奖励作为低层引导,采用SAC或PPO在增强MDP上训练。

Result: 在MetaWorld和ManiSkill上的10余项机器人操控任务中,PRM4RL在成功率与收敛速度上均显著优于ELLM(LLM规划器)和Text2Reward(LLM奖励生成器),在MW-pick-out-of-hole、MS-LiftPegUpright等复杂任务上基线方法成功率<15%,而PRM4RL接近100%。消融实验表明:PRM奖励与子任务先验具有"1+1>2"的协同效应;直接使用进度作为奖励会导致成功率下降;子任务先验对未见任务泛化至关重要。

Conclusion: PRM4RL成功将LLM的高层任务规划与基于势能塑形的低层密集奖励相结合,通过理论保证(最优性与收敛效率)弥合了高层规划与低层策略训练之间的鸿沟,为稀疏奖励长周期任务的RL训练提供了一种通用且高效的方案。

Abstract: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms face significant limitations in handling long-term tasks with sparse rewards. Recent advancements have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to enhance RL by utilizing their world knowledge for task planning and reward generation. However, planning-based approaches often depend on pre-defined skill libraries and fail to optimize low-level control policies, while reward-based methods require extensive human feedback or exhaustive searching due to the complexity of tasks. In this paper, we propose the Progress Reward Model for RL (PRM4RL), a novel framework that integrates task planning and dense reward to enhance RL. For high-level planning, a complex task is decomposed into a series of simple manageable subtasks, with a subtask-oriented, fine-grained progress function designed to monitor task execution progress. For low-level reward generation, inspired by potential-based reward shaping, we use the progress function to construct a Progress Reward Model (PRM), providing theoretically grounded optimality and convergence guarantees, thereby enabling effective policy optimization. Experimental results on robotics control tasks demonstrate that our approach outperforms both LLM-based planning and reward methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [390] [Prism-1: Position- and Rival-Independent Scoring for System One Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22066)
*Yao Long Teng,Jianguo Huang,Yanchen Deng,Jiayi Cai,Bo An*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Prism-1 提出了一种满足顺序不变性和 Luce 选择公理的 System One 决策读取方法，通过为每个选项分配独立块、互不注意力，在单次前向传播中实现对选项集的内在一致决策，实验证明其在准确率上与 SCQ 相当但完全消除洗牌敏感性和对抗性选项注入的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web 系统使用 System One 模型从语言模型中读取决策用于路由、工具选择等场景，但现有方法（SCQ 提示、循环平均、排序、集合架构）都不满足两条理性选择公理：选项列出的顺序不应影响决策（Luce 选择公理中加入一个选项不应改变其他选项的相对概率）。这些违反会导致决定被底层组件的任意顺序操控，也使决策易受工具注入等对抗性攻击。

Method: 根据 Luce 定理，公理要求决策规则为 softmax，评分仅依赖于单个选项本身。在 transformer 中，这通过结构约束实现：每个选项放置在以相同位置 P 开始的独立块中，使用因果（左到右）注意力机制，块之间互不可见。共享上下文只计算一次，所有块在一次打包的前向传播中读取；每个块末尾通过 yes/no 对数几率差读取评分，softmax 跨块给出决策分布。

Result: 在 Banking20、Newsgroups、BEV、Typed Decisions、JevBench 五个基准集上用 Qwen3-8B 和 Gemma 4 12B 测试：Prism-1 准确率与同数据训练的 SCQ 相当（差 ≤1 点），但在顺序鲁棒准确率上领先 1.6-3.7 点；不发生任何洗牌后的答案变化，加入无关选项也不改变原始选项的概率分布；商用决策 API（Jev 1.13、Mercury Decide）的洗牌改答案率分别为 4.7% 和 7.6%，加入无关选项操纵决策率 10.9% 和 16.0%。Prism-1 还是所有读取方法中 token 处理量最低（221 vs SCQ 的 282）、注意力对数最少的方法。

Conclusion: System One 决策在集合上应满足顺序不变性和 Luce 选择公理，命题 2.4 表明唯一满足两者的形式是 softmax 评分仅依赖单个选项；Prism-1 通过独立的因果块实现这一形式，跨五个基准和两个模型同时满足两公理，准确率与 SCQ 持平且是测试中最便宜的读取方式，唯一的代价是放弃了选项间的内部比较，这并未带来显著的准确率提升。

Abstract: Given a state and a set of options, such as intents, tools or interface elements, System One decision models return a distribution over the options in one forward pass, without generated reasoning. Web systems increasingly build them by reading decisions from language models. Two axioms of rational choice are natural requirements for such decisions, because in web systems the listing and the option set are determined by other components and can change or be manipulated: the order in which the options are listed should not matter, and adding an option should not change the relative odds of the others (Luce's choice axiom). We test the standard reads, namely single-choice question (SCQ) prompting, with shuffled-order training, order averaging or sorted options, and invariant set architectures, and find that each violates at least one axiom: one shuffle changes 12-20% of SCQ answers, sorting only freezes an arbitrary convention, and a well-chosen added option steers 4-34% of decisions. By Luce's theorem, a read satisfies both axioms only if it is a softmax over scores that each depend on one option alone, so in a transformer they hold by construction only if no token that scores an option sees another. We implement this as Prism-1 (Position- and Rival-Independent Scoring for System One Models): every option is read in its own block at shared positions, with the model's usual left-to-right attention, in one forward pass. On five benchmark sets with Qwen3-8B and Gemma 4 12B, SCQ prompting trained on the same data still changes 7% of its answers under one shuffle, and an added irrelevant option steers 12% of its decisions. Prism-1 stays within one point of that baseline's accuracy and is 2-4 points more accurate once only answers that survive a reordering are counted, while no shuffle changes any of its answers and no added irrelevant option moves its choice among the others.

</details>


### [391] [When Reasoning Is Not Enough: Proactive Inquiry for Cross-Modal Safety in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22068)
*Wei Cai,Jian Zhao,Yuchen Yuan,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAFE-PRO是一个统一框架，通过风险条件不确定性（RCU）信号将推理路径优化与主动询问相结合，解决多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中单独良性的图像和文本联合解读时产生的两类安全风险（隐式推理风险与意图级风险）。配合构建的SSUI-Dialog多轮对话数据集，SAFE-PRO在七个基准上显著提升安全性并大幅降低过度拒答率，超越GPT-4o与Claude-3.5-Sonnet。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）存在跨模态安全漏洞：单独无害的图像与文本联合解读时可引发不安全行为。现有方法存在两类局限：(1) 路径级优化方法（如SRPO）仅能处理推理链分叉导致的"隐式推理风险"，无法处理"意图级风险"——即跨模态歧义使模型静默承诺于危险前提的情况；(2) 现有主动询问方法依赖纯熵触发信号和效率偏置奖励，未针对安全关键场景设计，且缺乏多模态多轮训练数据。

Method: SAFE-PRO包含三个核心组件：(1) 风险条件不确定性（RCU）信号 u(s)=α·PE(s)+β·R(s)，结合归一化预测熵与基于隐藏状态学习的跨模态风险分数（轻量MLP头，无需独立模型），用于决定何时询问及何处优化；(2) 两层防御——内层在中间RCU区间进行风险引导的对比路径优化（按风险分数幂次采样以降低梯度方差），外层在高RCU区间发出安全导向的澄清问题，K_max=3；(3) 复合奖励 R_total=w_s·R_safe + w_h·R_help − w_o·R_over + w_e·R_eff，其中 w_s≫w_o>w_h>w_e，安全严格主导效率。配套构建SSUI-Dialog数据集（3,912实例，7,824双意图轨迹），通过六阶段管线注入安全关键前提歧义并模拟安全/不安全意图用户回复。训练分三阶段：风险头预训练→交互式SFT冷启动→RCU门控GRPO。理论上证明了风险引导采样在梯度幅度与风险正相关时可严格降低内层梯度估计器方差，并在RCU门控下界定了不安全完成的概率。

Result: 在五个单轮基准（USBBench、MSSBench、MLLMGuard、SafeBench、VLSBench）、SSUI-Dialog多轮测试集和MOSSBench上的实验表明：(1) 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上SAFE-PRO将SRPO的平均安全分数从76.18提升至82.67，平均危害分数从12.67降至7.64，USBBench ASR从42.38降至16.64，SafeBench ASR从7.50降至0.62；(2) 在LLaVA-NeXT-LLaMA3-8B上同样全面提升（75.25/11.96 vs SRPO 65.99/17.70）；(3) 在SSUI-Dialog上取得最低ASR 15.83和最高CSHC 0.68，TTR仅1.62；(4) MOSSBench过度拒答率从SRPO的38.4%降至19.7%，约减半；(5) SAFE-PRO在所有单轮安全指标和过度拒答上超越GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet和Gemini-1.5-Pro。消融实验验证了RCU双信号必要性、两层循环互补性、过度拒答惩罚必要性及SSUI-Dialog对话数据的关键作用。风险头在区分安全与不安全延续上达到ROC-AUC 0.894（vs 熵单独0.612）。

Conclusion: 论文识别了"意图级风险"作为路径优化无法单独解决的独立MLLM安全漏洞类别。SAFE-PRO通过RCU信号统一了路径优化与主动询问，辅以SSUI-Dialog数据集，在七个基准上显著提升安全性并减少过度拒答，超越了主流商业模型。理论分析明确了风险引导采样降低方差的前提条件和RCU门控下不安全完成的概率上界，为安全关键多模态对话系统提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can act unsafely when individually benign images and texts are interpreted jointly. Beyond implicit reasoning risk, where reasoning drifts toward harm, we identify intent-level risk, where cross-modal ambiguity silently commits the model to a hazardous premise that path-level optimization alone cannot correct. We propose SAFE-PRO, which uses a Risk-Conditioned Uncertainty (RCU) signal, combining predictive entropy with a learned cross-modal risk score, to decide when to ask safety-grounded clarifying questions and where to apply path optimization, under a reward that prioritizes safety and penalizes over-refusal. We also build SSUI-Dialog, a multimodal multi-turn dataset with dual-intent supervision, and theoretically analyze gradient variance and unsafe-completion risk under RCU. Across seven benchmarks and two base MLLMs, SAFE-PRO consistently improves safety over SRPO, roughly halves its over-refusal, and surpasses GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet in average single-turn safety.

</details>


### [392] [Learning from Unverified Peers via Shared Residual Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22080)
*Feiyang Chen,Runze Ma,Zichen Wang,Jiong Lou,Zihan Wang,Shuangjia Zheng,Jie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Shared Residual Distillation (SRD)，一种无需参考答案、可验证反馈或外部教师的on-policy自蒸馏方法，通过挖掘未经验证的同题同伴解之间的共享分布调整来构造稠密监督信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练方法依赖参考答案、可验证奖励或外部教师。当这些监督信号都不可用时，模型自身生成的解（即使最终答案错误）仍可能包含有用的中间推理。核心问题是：能否在不判断正确性的前提下，从未经验证的同伴解中学习？

Method: SRD对每个问题采样K=4条轨迹，随机选M=2个作为"同伴"，另取一个其他问题的轨迹作为跨问题控制。冻结教师模型分别在仅有问题(q₀)、加入跨问题解(q_c)、加入各同伴解(q_j)三种条件下对同一目标前缀评分。通过minmod规则：仅当所有同伴对某词表坐标的对数概率残差同号时，保留最小幅度的调整；否则置零。最终将共享残差施加于q₀上形成教师目标q_∩，学生仅用问题前缀进行蒸馏。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B上，SRD将AIME24-26平均avg@12分别从11.02→16.20、19.07→45.46、21.39→54.44。在HMMT上也取得提升，IFEval和MMLU-Pro通用能力不退化。在所有模型规模和是否使用clipping的条件下，SRD均优于OPSD、GRPO、TTRL基线。消融实验验证了minmod幅度限制和跨问题控制的价值。案例分析表明最终答案错误的同伴仍能提供有用的局部监督信号。

Conclusion: SRD证明了无需参考答案或正确性标签即可从未经验证的同伴解中提取有效的后训练监督。通过共享方向加保守幅度限制的残差聚合，SRD在多个模型规模上显著提升了数学推理能力，并保持了通用能力。局限性：同伴一致不能保证正确推理；跨问题控制对风格性影响的去除程度尚不明确；在开放式任务上的有效性有待验证。

Abstract: A language model can generate several solutions to the same problem, some leading to correct answers and others to incorrect ones. Many post-training methods turn these trajectories into learning signals using supervision from reference answers, verifiable feedback, or external teachers. Without such supervision, learning from the model's own generations becomes less straightforward, as their correctness cannot be reliably assessed. An incorrect solution may nevertheless contain useful intermediate reasoning, so its value as supervision need not be determined solely by its final answer. Can a model improve by learning from its unverified peer solutions without first determining which are correct? We propose Shared Residual Distillation (SRD), an on-policy self-distillation method that learns from the model's own unverified peer trajectories. SRD compares how peers change the prediction distribution relative to a control, retaining adjustments that agree in direction and are conservative in magnitude. This yields supervision without treating any complete solution as correct, and the trained model requires no peers at inference time. Starting from the corresponding base models, SRD raises mean AIME24--26 avg@12 from 11.02 to 16.20 on Qwen3-1.7B, from 19.07 to 45.46 on Qwen3-4B, and from 21.39 to 54.44 on Qwen3-8B. Controlled ablations support the value of the shared-residual construction, and we observe no degradation relative to the base models on two general-capability benchmarks.

</details>


### [393] [PROBE: Learning to Audit Policy Compliance in Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22124)
*Kshitij Mishra,Abhijith Sharma,Nils Lukas,Salem Lahlou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PROBE 提出了一种基于多轮工具调用对话训练 LLM 审计员的新方法，通过强化学习自动发现工具型 LLM 代理在执行合法任务时的策略合规性违规行为，在 SkyAssist 环境中将策略覆盖率从零样本 35% 提升至 60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估方法存在空白：能力基准测试衡量代理能否完成任务，内容安全测试检测有害输出，但两者都无法评估代理在执行有效工具调用过程中是否遵守操作策略（如定价、隐私、确认、安全等规则）。这些违规往往跨多轮、多工具调用出现，难以通过静态脚本发现。

Method: 1) 将代理审计形式化为两方部分可观察马尔可夫博弈，审计员仅观察公开对话历史，目标代理使用外部工具；2) 设计复合奖励函数，包含去重违规奖励（按严重度加权且去重）、进度奖励、新颖性奖励和合理性奖励；3) 采用课程学习，从短对话长度(4轮)逐步增加到长对话(14轮)；4) 比较三种优化器：GRPO（mode-seeking）、DPO（mode-seeking但对奖励幅度变化稳健）、GFlowNet（mode-covering）；5) 在 SkyAssist 飞行预订环境中进行实验，使用 Qwen3-4B 审计员审计冻结的 Qwen3-30B-A3B 目标代理。

Result: 在 SkyAssist 环境中（20项策略）：随机探测仅覆盖5%（1/20策略），零样本30B审计员覆盖35%（35%），而训练的4B审计员覆盖60%（12/20策略），多策略失败率达94%。审计员能转移到未见目标家族（Gemma 4E-4b-it覆盖40%）和 τ-bench（覆盖从20%提升至30%，违规数增加123%）。人类验证显示LLM法官在语义策略上的精确率仅24%，GRPO会利用法官漏洞进行奖励hack，但DPO更稳健。GFlowNet虽训练收益高但因频繁低深度策略主导奖励，覆盖率反而较低。

Conclusion: PROBE 证明了多轮行为审计是代理评估中独立且必需的轴，补充了能力和安全基准。它提供了自动化策略审计的可扩展路径，并提出审计员-代理共同进化的循环。策略合规性是与能力完成和安全生成不同的评估维度，需要专门的自适应行为审计来发现真实交互中可触及的违规。研究也展示了奖励设计与优化器选择的交互作用：GRPO和GFlowNet对奖励幅度敏感，DPO更稳定但响应较慢；GFlowNet需要按策略多样性和严重度校准的奖励才能发挥优势。

Abstract: Modern agentic systems extend language models with external tools, enabling them to complete complex tasks through multi-turn interactions. As these agents are deployed in consequential settings, they are often constrained by policies governing pricing, privacy, confirmation, safety, and other requirements. However, existing evaluation methods leave a critical gap: capability benchmarks measure what agents can accomplish, while content-safety red-teaming measures harmful generations, but neither tests whether agents comply with predefined policies during otherwise valid tool use. Such policy violations are difficult to audit because their effects may emerge only after several turns, span multiple tool calls, or surface in downstream systems. We propose PROBE (Policy Rule Observation via Behavioral Exploration), an algorithm for training LLM-based auditors that interact with deployed agents as realistic users and probe them for policy violations through multi-turn, tool-mediated dialogue. We formalize agent auditing as a two-player Markov game and propose a composite reward that balances violation discovery, behavioral plausibility, conversation progress, and policy diversity. To study training objectives and reward design, we compare GRPO, DPO, and GFlowNet-based optimization in a controlled setting. Across extensive experiments, auditors trained with PROBE uncover substantially broader and higher-yield policy violations than same-architecture zero-shot adversaries, even when the auditor is significantly smaller than the target agent. Our results show that multi-turn behavioral auditing is a distinct and necessary axis of agent evaluation, complementing capability and safety benchmarks. PROBE offers a scalable path toward automated policy auditing for real-world agentic systems and suggests a co-evolutionary loop in which auditors expose failures and agents improve from auditor feedback.

</details>


### [394] [DropKV: Decoupling Residual-Output Perturbation for Near-Optimal KV-Cache Eviction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22130)
*Aozhong Zhang,Selcuk Gurses,Yanxia Deng,Naigang Wang,Chi-Chun Liu,Davis Wertheimer,Derrick Liu,Xin Li,Zi Yang,Felix X.-F. Ye,Penghang Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DropKV是一个基于解耦残差输出扰动的KV缓存淘汰框架，通过将NP-hard的组合优化问题转化为可处理的逐token评分，在RULER和LongBench上以5%和10%缓存预算实现最先进精度，并使用Triton融合内核提供19.8倍的评分加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM部署中KV缓存的线性增长成为关键内存瓶颈，现有淘汰策略仅依赖注意力分数忽略了value向量的作用，且最小化输出扰动的精确优化是NP-hard组合问题，难以高效内核化。

Method: 提出Decoupled Residual-Output Perturbation框架，将NP-hard的联合token淘汰决策解耦为独立的逐token扰动评分score_j = Σ_t(p_j/(1-p_j))²·‖a^(t)-v_j‖²²；在小权重假设和锥条件下证明常数因子近似保证；实现三个融合Triton内核（FlashAttention风格前向、评分累积分核、split-K合并）避免实例化完整注意力矩阵。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-512K和Qwen2.5-7B-1M三个长上下文LLM上，DropKV在RULER 128K/5%预算下分别达到82.00、85.40、83.77平均分，超越最强基线AnDPro 2.35-4.03分；Triton实现在n=128K时达到19.8倍评分加速和540倍暂存内存减少（从9GB降至17MB）；整体生成延迟优于所有淘汰方法并快于动态缓存基线。

Conclusion: DropKV通过解耦组合扰动优化为逐token评分，同时具备数学最优性保证和实际部署效率，在长上下文LLM推理中实现了精度与速度的SOTA平衡；锥条件的经验成立性预测高估常数比保守理论优秀得多，反映了实际算法的紧凑性。

Abstract: Key-value (KV) cache management has become a critical bottleneck for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) to long-context scenarios due to linear memory growth. While recent eviction methods have moved beyond simple attention-score heuristics to incorporate value representations, they typically face a fundamental trade-off: the underlying optimization for minimizing output perturbation is an NP-hard combinatorial problem, leading to mathematically suboptimal heuristics or implementations that are difficult to kernelize. In this work, we propose DropKV, a simple principled eviction framework based on Decoupled Residual-Output Perturbation. By decoupling the joint eviction decision into independent per-token scoring, DropKV circumvents combinatorial intractability and admits a provable constant-factor approximation guarantee under a cone condition that we empirically verify on three long-context LLMs. To ensure practical viability, we provide a high-performance implementation using fused Triton kernels that avoid materializing the full attention matrix, delivering a 19.8x scoring-kernel speedup that translates to up to a 9.9% matched-batch end-to-end prefill speedup. Extensive evaluations on the RULER and LongBench benchmarks demonstrate that DropKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines at equivalent cache budgets, achieving the lowest inference latency among eviction methods while also remaining faster than the dynamic cache baseline.

</details>


### [395] [CART: Compatible Routing for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22137)
*Ling-Xiang Zhang,Tao Hu,Da-Wei Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CART（Compatible Routing）方法，用于多模态持续指令调优（MCIT）。核心发现是现有方法仅保护语言模型侧而持续更新投影器，导致跨模块失配并加剧灾难性遗忘。CART通过维护配对的投影器-LLM专家对，并基于输入相关性（高斯分布似然）与跨模块兼容性（CAVI坐标上升）联合推断路由权重，实现两个模块的协调适应；同时引入相关性引导的专家合并机制控制模型规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）通过指令调优获得强大性能，但实际应用中需要持续从顺序任务中获取新能力（即MCIT）。现有方法主要保护语言模型不遗忘，而跨任务持续更新投影器，造成投影器表征漂移，加剧了投影器与语言模型之间的失配，进而加剧灾难性遗忘。本文揭示并解决这一不对称适应问题。

Method: 1. **配对投影器-LLM专家**：为每个任务保存联合训练的投影器专家（完整参数）和LLM专家（LoRA）。2. **分布感知专家相关性**：在冻结特征空间中将每个专家的输入建模为高斯分布，通过似然估计输入与专家的相关性。3. **兼容性感知路由**：通过坐标上升变分推断（CAVI）交替更新两个模块的路由权重，联合优化专家相关性与跨模块兼容性偏好。4. **相关性引导的专家合并**：基于分布距离（Mahalanobis距离）识别冗余专家对，通过参数平均和截断SVD合并，控制专家池规模。

Result: 在CoIN基准上，CART取得72.92%的Last Accuracy，超过最强基线SAME 6.10分；在UCIT基准上达到75.67%，超越SAME 2.60分。消融实验证明分布感知相关性、兼容性感知路由（CAVI协调更新）及专家合并策略均对性能有显著贡献。在多随机种子（5个）和多种任务顺序下均表现稳定，且实现了精度-参数效率的Pareto最优权衡。

Conclusion: 投影器-语言模型失配是多模态持续指令调优中灾难性遗忘的重要来源。CART通过协同协调投影器和LLM专家的适应过程，并兼顾分布感知相关性与跨模块兼容性，显著缓解了遗忘问题并控制了模型增长。实验证明了该方法在标准基准上的优越性和鲁棒性，为多模态持续学习中的跨模块协调提供了新思路。未来需在更长任务序列上进一步评估长期知识保留能力。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet real-world applications often require them to continually acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks, i.e., Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). In typical MLLMs, a projector is employed to align visual representations with the language model. However, existing methods primarily protect the language model from forgetting while continuously updating the projector across tasks. Such asymmetric adaptation can cause substantial representation drift in the projector, increasing the mismatch between the projector and language model and consequently exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To address this issue, we propose Compatible Routing (CART), which explicitly coordinates the adaptation of the projector and language model. Specifically, CART maintains task-specific experts for both modules and combines them through weighted mixtures. CART jointly infers their weights by considering both expert relevance and cross-module compatibility, thereby promoting coordinated adaptation between the two modules. To further control model growth, we introduce relevance-guided expert consolidation, which merges experts exhibiting similar relevance profiles across samples within each module. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CART achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [396] [Believed but Not Said: Measuring Hidden Belief Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Discussions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22138)
*Liangjie Huang,Henry Peng Zou,Wei-Chieh Huang,Wooseong Yang,Yuwei Han,Philip S. Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究在十智能体多智能体LLM讨论中，通过区分每个智能体的公开立场和私有答案（独立隐藏探测），发现少量对抗性智能体（1或3个）能轻易地将虚假答案扩散到大多数良性智能体的私有信念中（单攻击者：44.8%；三攻击者：60.5%），而这种"隐藏感染"在对话记录中基本不可见——公开支持率仅19.7%但私有持有率达51.6%。这与人类从众研究中"公开顺从而私下保留"的经典模式相反，呈现出"私下接受而公开沉默"的少数派影响模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统建立在"群体协作能互相纠错"的核心假设之上，但这一假设忽视了对话通道本身可成为攻击面。本文质疑该假设的鲁棒性，尤其关注一个关键问题：智能体在私下（无人监督时）是否真的被说服，还是仅在公开场合表面上服从？这对基于对话记录监测多智能体安全性的方法具有根本性影响。

Method: 构建受控的十智能体事实问答聊天室，持续16轮。设置k∈{0,1,3}个对抗性智能体（Sybil）反复主张一个合理的错误答案。采用"双通道测量"协议：每次发言后通过独立隐藏调用（private probe）探测良性智能体的私有答案；由LLM裁判分别标注其公开立场（endorse/reject/hedge/ignore）与私有答案（true/manipulated/mixed/uncertain）。在6个模型×3个事实问答数据集（CounterFact/PopQA/SimpleQA）共18个单元上进行评估，并进行消融实验（二人组对比、探测器时序验证、对原始探测的重提问验证、跨裁判一致性检验等）。

Result: 1）"隐藏感染"显著：k=3时暴露轮次中私有持有错误答案率51.6%，公开支持率仅19.7%（2.6倍差距）；其中36.6%的私有错误答案表现为公开"忽视"，21.2%为对冲；2）"易受攻击"：无攻击者时FPI仅0.6%，单攻击者升至44.8%，三攻击者达60.5%，单攻击者造成三攻击者74%的破坏；3）"纠正不力"：私有持有真答案的智能体仅在61.9%轮次中公开拒绝错误主张；4）"基线知识不能预测鲁棒性"：HY3与GPT-OSS-120B均知85%事实，但GPT-OSS-120B放弃80%，HY3仅放弃25%；5）社会级联与自我内化：被转换的良性同伴越多，转换概率越高（9%→66%）；6）当要求智能体给出"自己的答案"时，86.4%仍维持原错误答案（FPI仅下降5.7个百分点）；7）二人组与十人组差异不显著，平均仅改善6.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 多智能体LLM讨论系统在事实纠错方面存在根本性脆弱性：少量攻击者可通过对话通道将其虚假信念扩散到多数智能体的私有答案中，而这种"隐藏感染"在对话记录中基本不可见——呈现"私下接受但公开沉默"的少数派影响模式（与人类从众中多数派引发的"公开顺从、私下不变"相反）。群体冗余和更强的基线知识都不提供可靠防御；监控应直接针对每个智能体的私有答案而非仅看公开消息；干预窗口仅在前4轮；多智能体系统的鲁棒性必须在单智能体层面通过对抗性同伴压力测试直接测量。

Abstract: LLM systems increasingly rely on groups of agents that discuss, critique, and check one another, assuming that peers will catch individual errors. We test this assumption against a minimal adversary. In a ten-agent factual discussion, one or three adversarial agents repeatedly assert a plausible false answer. After each round we probe each benign agent's private answer through a separate call whose response is hidden from its peers, and we separately label its public stance toward the claim. Across six models and three factual-QA datasets, groups remain stable without an attacker: only 0.6% of benign agents finish with the false answer. A single adversarial agent increases this rate to 44.8% and three to 60.5%. Studies of conformity typically report public agreement without private change; we find the reverse. With three adversarial agents present, benign agents hold the false answer in 51.6% of exposed turns but publicly endorse it in only 19.7%. Much of the influence therefore remains invisible in the discussion, and the false answers persist when agents are asked for their own views. Agents that retain the true answer often fail to defend it; once adopted, the false answer spreads among benign agents, and baseline knowledge does not predict robustness.

</details>


### [397] [Are You Sure Your LLM Is Sure? Repairing and Auditing Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22139)
*Arijit Dey,Bhartendu Kumar,Ramya Hebbalaguppe,Khuushi Maheshwari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RADAR框架，将大语言模型置信度分数的可靠性管理分解为三个独立环节：修复（Repair）、采纳（Adopt）和审计（Diagnose）。在平方损失下推导了预测风险的分解定理，揭示标量重校准只能修复映射误差，无法恢复被分数隐藏的信息损失I和由单调性约束引入的池化间隙G。提出了Probe-Anchored Isotonic Calibration (PAIC)方法，通过将无标签目标提示上的探针预测蒸馏为原始分数的单调映射实现免标签修复；给出了基于投注（betting）的配对采纳程序以控制错误采纳概率；并开发了基于核的提示聚类审计测试，以检测特征对齐的残差误差同时应对同提示内答案的依赖性。实验表明，更丰富的预测器可能改善置信度估计，但其信息投影回标量分数时可能丢失增益，且更低的预测风险不一定带来更好的审查决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量置信度重校准存在两个根本局限：通常需要部署群体的有标签数据（分布偏移时可能不可用），且只能改变分数值而无法恢复分数中不存在的信息。作者通过一个示例揭示：即使期望校准误差为零、分数被校准为0.8，仍可能存在系统性的、可预测的子组错误。这表明"修正分数"和"恢复被该分数隐藏的区分"是两个不同的问题，需要分别处理。

Method: RADAR框架包含三个组件：(1) PAIC（Probe-Anchored Isotonic Calibration）：将有界正确性探针的预测蒸馏为原始置信度分数P的非递减映射，使用无标签目标提示进行拟合，其超额风险取决于探针的分数条件偏倚（score-conditional bias）而非整体准确率；(2) 基于投注的采纳程序：对冻结候选者在有标签提示上的配对平方损失差异进行检验，通过构造满足∏(1−sD_jh/B_h) 的e-value来控制错误采纳非改进候选者的概率；(3) 提示聚类核审计：将每个提示内的残差特征平均后进行跨提示核内积，配合中心化高斯乘子程序构建提示级别检验，控制同提示兄弟答案的依赖性。

Result: 在Llama 3.2 3B、Qwen 2.5 3B/7B 和 Mistral 7B 等模型的多个基准测试与分布偏移中：(i) 更丰富的预测器在某些任务上可改善置信度估计，但向标量分数投影时可能丢失增益（rich-PAIC-U与rich direct的差异在BoolQ上为0.0121–0.0169）；(ii) PAIC在六个偏移设置中均优于所有源拟合标量基线，相对源标签等渗校准降低均方风险4.9%–16.4%；(iii) 在47,400次重放的原始分数分配中，配对投注法采纳有益候选的概率为42.95%，远高于单边经验Bernstein法的15.09%，且错误采纳为零；(iv) 决策实验显示低预测风险并不必然带来更好的审查决策，例如Qwen在MATH上的接受率从73.00%降至零（仅因最大分数从0.900015变为0.899516跨越阈值）。

Conclusion: 本文论证了置信度校准并非单一的数字校正问题，而应分解为修复、证据驱动的采纳和残差诊断三个独立环节。核心理论贡献包括：标量重校准的风险分解定理揭示即使最优保序修复仍会保留I+G的不可恢复损失；PAIC的超额风险界表明探针的整体准确率不重要，关键是分数条件偏倚；投注采纳方法在有限样本下以更高效率控制错误采纳概率。结论强调：降低预测风险不等于改善下游决策，部署前必须分别验证修复、采纳和审计三个环节的证据。

Abstract: Confidence scores determine whether an LLM answer is accepted, reviewed, or regenerated, yet scalar recalibration can only correct errors visible through the score itself. We introduce RADAR (Repair, Adopt, and Diagnose After Recalibration), a reliability framework that separates confidence repair from deciding whether to deploy the repair and auditing the errors that remain. Under squared loss, we decompose prediction risk into outcome noise, information hidden by the score, and mapping error; restricting repair to order-preserving maps additionally introduces a pooling gap. For repair, we propose Probe-Anchored Isotonic Calibration (PAIC), which learns a monotone map from correctness-probe predictions on unlabeled target prompts. PAIC's excess risk depends on the probe's score-conditional bias and fitting error rather than its overall accuracy. For adoption, we derive a paired procedure with finite-sample control of false improvements. For auditing, we develop a prompt-clustered kernel test that detects feature-aligned residual errors while accounting for dependent answers from the same prompt. Across multiple LLM checkpoints, benchmarks, and distribution shifts, richer predictors can improve confidence estimation, but projecting their information back to a scalar score can lose these gains, and lower prediction risk need not yield better review decisions. Across 47,400 replayed raw-score allocations, paired betting adopts candidates with lower held-out test risk in 42.95% of allocations, versus 15.09% for one-sided empirical Bernstein. RADAR thus provides a principled workflow to repair what a scalar score can express, adopt a repair only when supported by evidence, and diagnose systematic errors that recalibration leaves behind. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [398] [RAG-RST: Retrieved Exemplars as In-Context Discourse Schema for RST Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22150)
*Mohammadreza Sediqin,Shlomo Engelson Argamon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 RAG-RST,一种检索增强的框架,无需参数更新,通过将 RST 注释模式作为上下文示例(而非通过训练)提供给基础模型,用于改善话语解析中的核心性和关系标签预测。该方法对比了预计算和动态两种配置,动态配置表现最佳,在多项指标上超越现有 RST 解析器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管基础模型已在大规模话语丰富的文本上进行预训练,但它们对 RST 注释模式的恢复仍然较差:仅给定目标 EDU 对,强 LLM 在核心性上仅达到 0.794 F1,在关系上仅达到 0.738 F1。这表明话语现象存在于预训练数据中,但将其划分为特定类别的注释惯例并不存在。参数化方法通过训练获取该惯例,缺乏灵活性,而 RAG 提供了一种在推理时补充缺失惯例的方法。

Method: RAG-RST 集成神经 EDU 编码器、FAISS 检索和大型语言模型进行标签预测,有两种配置:(1)预计算标签——在解析前为所有 EDU 对生成标签并存储在查找表中;(2)动态 RAG——在每个 reduce 步骤检索,使示例反映已完成的归约。检索使用 RST-GUM(带注释)和 CNN/DailyMail(无语义话语模式)构建 FAISS 索引,使用 MiniLM 编码,使用 LLaMA-3 作为生成器,采用 K=50 个最近邻。shift-reduce 解析器的动作策略未做修改,RAG-RST 仅在归约操作时提供核心性和关系标签。

Result: 无检索时 LLaMA-3 在核心性上仅达到 0.794 F1,关系上仅达到 0.738 F1。加入 RST-GUM 检索后分别提升至 0.829 和 0.768。加入 CNN/DailyMail 后进一步提升至 0.846 和 0.788。检索量的效用是有限的:K=50 时达到最佳,超过 50 后性能下降。两种 RAG 配置均优于所有现有 RST 解析器:动态配置达到 0.892 Span、0.791 核心性、0.711 关系和 0.674 完全树 F1,预计算配置略低。两个关键发现:示例的效用有限(超过 50 个后饱和然后下降),且依赖于结构位置(因为两个复合跨度之间的关系不一定等同于其最左叶子之间的关系)。

Conclusion: RAG-RST 表明,正式的 RST 注释模式可以作为演示(而非训练参数)提供给基础模型。所检索的示例功能是注释惯例的演示,而非关于目标对的额外证据,这解释了为什么其效用有限以及为什么检索位置影响其有效性。未来工作将探索更强的检索模型、跨语言评估以及下游任务(如摘要)的应用。

Abstract: In Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST), each edge of a discourse tree carries a nuclearity label, marking which span holds the central content, and a relation drawn from a closed inventory of functional categories. Neither label is a surface property: the same two clauses can be Elaboration or Background depending on rhetorical intent, and the boundary between them is fixed by annotation convention rather than by lexical cues. Predicting these labels therefore requires a formal discourse schema, and exposure to discourse-rich pretraining text does not supply it: given only a target EDU pair, a strong LLM recovers nuclearity at 0.794 F1 and relation at 0.738 F1. We propose RAG-RST, a retrieval-augmented framework that supplies this schema as in-context demonstration rather than through parameter updates, raising nuclearity to 0.846 F1 and relation to 0.788 F1 with no training. Two configurations are compared: a precomputed strategy that labels all EDU pairs before parsing, and a dynamic strategy that retrieves at each reduce step, so that the exemplars reaching the generator depend on the reductions the parser has already committed to. Both outperform existing RST parsers across span, nuclearity, relation, and full tree metrics, with the dynamic variant consistently strongest. Two properties of the retrieved schema emerge: its utility is bounded in number, saturating and then declining beyond fifty exemplars, and it depends on structural position. Both indicate that a formal linguistic schema can be supplied to a foundation model as a demonstration rather than trained into its parameters.

</details>


### [399] [Realtime-Bench: Can Frontier Models Solve Real-time Interactive Problems?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22155)
*Jingyu Tang,Xu Yang,Zhehao Zhang,Zheng Wang,Qi Cheng,Haozhe Zhao,Manling Li,Wenxuan Li,Xide Xia,Jiaxin Pei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Realtime-Bench是一个用于测试多模态智能体在动态环境中实时交互能力的基准测试，包含50个网页和游戏任务。研究者评估了12个前沿模型，发现即使最佳模型在Wall Clock下成功率也仅为44%、Pass^3仅为36%。为分离推理延迟与实时能力，作者提出三种时钟协议（Wall Clock、Paused Clock与Token Clock），揭示了高推理投入在时间紧迫时具有权衡利弊的折中效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对实时流式模型的评估主要关注对话流畅性和流式感知能力，而忽略了在严格时间约束下采取有效行动的能力评估。因此需要一个能测试模型在动态演化环境中基于时间约束进行感知、推理与行动的基准。

Method: Realtime-Bench包含50个任务（30个网页任务和20个游戏任务），采用三种时钟协议评估模型：(1) Wall Clock——按实际推理延迟推进环境；(2) Paused Clock——推理期间暂停环境作为理想参考；(3) Token Clock——按生成token数量推进模拟时间，独立于物理服务速度测试时间感知能力。评估涵盖12个前沿模型（含异步、流式和决策模型），并在三种协议下分别测试低/高推理投入。同时提出实时流式能力的三个维度：时间状态感知（RT-Perceive）、自适应推理（RT-Deliberate）和时间感知动作选择（RT-Act）。

Result: 在Wall Clock下，GPT-6-Astra (high) 取得最高Pass^3仅为36%，最佳成功率为44%。在Paused Clock下高推理投入对所有模型均有提升，但存在权衡利弊效应——在Token Clock下，Claude Opus 5的Pass^3从TL的44%降至TH的30%。三种主要失败模式包括：(1) 缺乏时间感知（RT-Deliberate，模型未根据时间约束调整推理长度）；(2) 未能追踪演化状态（RT-Perceive，模型依赖陈旧信息）；(3) 误判是否需要行动（RT-Act，模型错误等待或错误行动）。放松时间压力可提升表现但不能保证任务成功。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了实时多模态智能体面临的核心挑战：将任务能力转化为及时行动即使在标准化token时间下仍存在困难。当前模型在时间压力下推理投入具有权衡利弊效应：更多推理可能改善决策质量，但时间消耗会减少执行机会。未来研究方向包括：(1) 具有时间感知的自适应推理；(2) 持续感知与行动，更高帧率下高效视觉编码与鲁棒的上下文管理策略。Realtime-Bench为研究这些方向并衡量实时交互进展提供了受控测试平台。

Abstract: Real-time interaction requires agents to perceive evolving environments and act under temporal constraints, yet existing evaluations of real-time streaming models focus on conversational quality and streaming perception, leaving effective action under strict temporal constraints untested. We introduce Realtime-Bench, a suite of carefully curated dynamic tasks where delayed actions directly affect success. Under Wall Clock, where environments advance according to actual inference latency, the best success rate reaches only 44% and the best Pass^3 is only 36%, demonstrating that real-time interaction remains challenging. To separate serving latency from models' real-time streaming capability, we compare Wall Clock with Paused Clock, which removes inference delays as an idealized reference, and introduce Token Clock, which advances simulated time according to generated token counts, testing temporal awareness independently of physical serving speed. We find that temporal costs limit success in evolving environments and that higher reasoning effort has mixed effects under time pressure, reflecting a trade-off between decision quality and timely execution. These findings suggest directions for improving real-time multimodal agents, including adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action.

</details>


### [400] [Multi-sourced AI Tutor for Non-Native English Speaker Students](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22163)
*Yiyin Shen,Xinyi Ai,Weibing Wang,Rogers Jeffrey Leo John,Meenakshi Syamkumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文开发了一个基于多源RAG管道的AI导师系统，专门帮助非英语母语（NNES）学生（目前以普通话为主）克服计算机课程中的语言障碍。该系统能接收母语问题、生成双语回复，并附带技术术语词汇表。在91个Piazza帖子的评估中，系统正确且有帮助地回答了83.52%的问题，76.92%提供了高质量翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着国际学生入学计算机项目的人数增加，非英语母语学生面临语言障碍和信心不足的问题，导致他们不愿主动提问。本研究旨在通过AI导师系统为这些学生提供无评判、易获取的学习支持，促进教育公平与包容性。

Method: 系统采用基于GPT-4的多源RAG管道，包含四个阶段：(1)翻译阶段：使用Azure AI Translate API将普通话问题翻译为英语；(2)问题提取阶段：使用Llama 3 8B模型从帖子中识别标准化题号，并通过规则算法从题库中提取具体题目内容；(3)RAG阶段：使用LangChain和text-embedding-ada-002从包含讲义、项目、实验、测验等多种课程材料构建的FAISS向量库中获取相关信息（检索前10个结果，排除测验和考试以避免干扰）；(4)响应生成阶段：使用GPT-4 API根据系统提示（避免直接揭示答案、引用来源、生成双语回复和技术词汇表）生成最终答案。

Result: 在91个Piazza帖子的评估中：(1)翻译阶段仅2/382篇帖子翻译失败；(2)问题提取准确率：物流类97.78%、概念类90.74%、环境设置类100%、编程类97.46%；(3)RAG相关性（每10个结果中相关数）：物流6.1、概念7.7、环境设置7.3、编程6.6；(4)回答正确率：物流80.95%、概念100%、环境设置100%、编程97.83%；(5)帮助率：物流61.90%、概念93.33%、环境设置88.89%、编程89.13%；(6)翻译质量：物流71.43%、概念86.67%、环境设置77.78%、编程76.09%；(7)技术词汇表生成率：物流95.24%、概念86.67%、环境设置77.78%、编程86.96%。评分者间信度（Gwet's AC1）为67%-94%。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了多源RAG管道和专门的题号提取机制在AI导师系统中的有效性，能够为非英语母语学生提供高质量、无评判的学习支持。系统可访问性强，能降低学生提问的心理障碍。未来工作包括：实际课堂部署、扩展图像处理和多语言支持、改进编程题的防泄漏机制、开发自动化评估方法以及为其他教师提供可配置化界面。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being adopted as teaching tools in computing education, particularly for developing AI tutors capable of answering student questions. With the rise in enrollment of international students in computing programs, researchers have begun to explore the difficulties that non-native English speaker (NNES) students face in computing courses due to language barriers. To aid such students, we developed a general-purpose AI tutor system that can process student questions in foreign languages (currently focused on Mandarin) and provide bilingual responses. Our system also incorporates the functionality of generating a glossary of technical terms and their explanations to enhance comprehension. Our approach utilizes a specialized Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline with a novel question extraction mechanism, enabling us to effectively utilize a diverse array of course materials for answering student queries. We evaluated our AI tutor using 91 Piazza posts, demonstrating that it could answer 83.52% of the posts correctly and in a helpful manner. The tutor also provided high-quality translations for 76.92% of the questions and generated technical term glossaries for 64.47% of them. Our findings underscore the potential of multi-source RAG pipeline in enhancing AI tutor systems, offering support for non-native speakers that are challenging to provide with traditional supporting staff of a computing course.

</details>


### [401] [Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22192)
*Junyao Yang,Zongxia Li,Yucheng Shi,Zhongzhi Li,Ruhan Wang,Ruiwen Zhou,Haitao Mi,Shuicheng Yan,Leowei Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Terminal-RSI提出了一种递归自改进的终端智能体框架，通过交替执行"递归自我改写(RSR)"和"带评论家继承的递归策略精炼(RPR)"，在Qwen3-27B上生成了Terminal-RSI-27B模型，在多个Terminal-Bench基准上取得显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体需要通过受保护验证器完成完整任务执行，但当前面临两大障碍：① 信用分配中的"时间膨胀"问题——token生成时钟与环境变化时钟不同步；② 递归监督中的"价值漂移"问题——critic重置会丢失学习成果，不校准的critic传递会保留系统性预测错误。同时奖励对齐也存在困难：单一全局尺度会过度强调验证器多的任务族，而纯比例的进度奖励在策略具备严格成功能力后仍偏好不完整行为。

Method: 1) 递归Actor-Critic框架：五阶段序列Qwen3-27B基座→RSR-1→RPR-1→RSR-2→RPR-2，通过critic权重传递保留学习成果；2) TB-GAE信用分配：在交互轮次边界应用跨轮衰减，同时保留token特定基线；3) FDR奖励：以族分位数校准家族进度为非任务分母；4) SPR奖励：分离严格成功与有界部分信用；5) Warm-up Critic Model初始化与递归critic交接；6) 阶段自适应学习率（actor率5e-4降至1e-4，critic率保持1.5e-5）。

Result: Terminal-RSI-27B在Terminal-Bench 4.0/2.1/3.0/Hard上分别达到19.84%/86.52%/16.95%/79.00%，四套件平均成功率达50.58%（较Base提升29.90个百分点，较RSR-1提升16.33个百分点）；LHTB上进程奖励从0.21升至0.37，严格完成任务从0/46升至5/46；SWR100成功率从3.00%翻倍至6.00%。离线重评分将失败轨迹的奖励份额从50.09%降至28.72%，所有失败轨迹奖励归零。

Conclusion: 通过将经验证鞒谱改写与带critic继承的策略精炼进行递归耦合，每个保留阶段巩固已发现能力，逐步将智能体从部分局部修复推进至严格终端验证。Terminal-RSI-27B在顺序终端基准上达到50.58%的宏平均成功率，同时展示了从部分进度到严格完成的过渡。然而计算匹配的交替实验、孤立的TB-GAE分析、匹配的在线奖励以及继承vs重置critic控制仍是未来工作所需，以建立各组件的因果贡献。

Abstract: Converting verifier outcomes into useful policy updates and partial progress into complete task resolution is crucial for terminal agents. We present Terminal-RSI, which alternates Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR) of verified trajectories with critic-inheriting Recursive Policy-Refine (RPR). We formulate Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE (TB-GAE) to retain token-specific baselines while applying decay across interaction turns. Family Dense Reward (FDR) calibrates semantic progress across task families; Success-Prioritized Reward (SPR) separates strict success from bounded partial credit. A Warm-up Critic Model, recursive critic handoff, and stage-specific learning rates coordinate the two refinement phases. The five-stage sequence from Qwen3.8-27B base model through RSR-1, RPR-1, RSR-2, and RPR-2 yields Terminal-RSI-27B: 19.84% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, 86.52% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 16.95% on Terminal-Bench 3.0, and 79.00% on Terminal-Bench Hard. On LHTB, process reward rises from 0.21 to 0.37 and strict completion from 0/46 to 5/46; SWR100 success doubles from 3.00% to 6.00%. By recursively coupling verified trajectory rewriting with critic-inheriting policy refinement, each retained stage consolidates discovered behaviors and progressively advances the agent from partial local repairs to strict terminal verification.

</details>


### [402] [AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22194)
*Bingxiang He,Pengqi Sun,Shihao Peng,Shaoxuan Li,Huiyu Xiao,Hongjian Shi,Zixuan Fu,Ziqing Qiao,Yuxin Zuo,Cheng Qian,Xinqiang Yu,Jiayi Li,Xiusi Chen,Yizhen Song,Xiangyang Wang,Iofai Lei,Yudong Wang,Ning Ding,Zhiyuan Liu,Xiaozhi Wang,Chaojun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoSFT 提出一个多智能体系统,通过将执行与分析分离、并使用多个互补的分析子智能体以及合成子智能体,自动化 SFT 数据研究。该系统证实结构化分解比单一动作更重要,使数据动作空间得到更全面覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当语言模型代理被赋予完整的训练栈时,往往会收敛于监督微调(SFT),并将大部分精力投入到修改训练数据中。然而现有的自动化系统仅赋予代理单一类型的控制(从固定池中选取行,或调用生成器),而人类数据工程师则需要进行比例调整、剪枝、修复、替换和合成等多种操作。论文研究的核心问题是:自动化系统能否完成人类工程师所做的全方位数据操作,而不仅仅是其中一种?需要怎样的结构来支撑这一点?

Method: 研究首先采用单个代理完成整个 SFT 数据研究循环,发现其仅能触及六类数据动作中的一种(比例调整),且因执行输出占用上下文而频繁触发压缩。基于此失败,论文提出 AutoSFT,一个多智能体系统:(1)执行器子代理在独立会话中负责训练、检查点转换和评估,仅返回路径和状态报告;(2)四个分析子代理从训练数据、失败案例、学习动态和研究历史四个互补视角提出数据动作建议;(3)合成子代理为池中未充分覆盖的能力合成新数据。每轮均从基础模型重新训练,确保各组件效果可单独归因。实验以 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 为基础,使用 argilla/ifeval-like-data 池,在 IFEval/IFBench 和 MBPP+ 上分别评估指令遵循与代码生成场景。

Result: 在指令遵循任务上,每加入一个组件都有可归因的提升:执行器将上下文丢失减少一半;分析子代理使最佳 IFEval 提升 +6.5;合成子代理再增加 +3.4 IFEval 和 +2.9 IFBench。同时分析运行将动作范围扩展至修复(resupervision 占据 55% 的动作),而基础运行仍局限于比例调整家族。在代码生成(MBPP+)迁移实验中,分析相对无提升的单代理基线带来 +3.7 的提升,合成以更少轮次达到相当峰值。论文通过从基础模型每轮重新训练、固定模型/训练器/预算的设计,保证所有差异均可单独归因。

Conclusion: 单一代理拥有完整 SFT 数据研究循环会坍缩为单一类别的数据动作并反复丢失上下文。AutoSFT 通过结构化多智能体分解(隔离执行、多视角分析、合成补全)解决了这一瓶颈。结论强调:自动化 SFT 数据研究的关键瓶颈不在于任何单一动作,而在于让智能体能覆盖数据工程师所作出的全部数据操作范围的系统结构,多智能体分解是提供这种结构的有效途径。该系统在无现成能力分类法的代码生成领域也能迁移,显示出结构化分解的通用性。

Abstract: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce \textbf{AutoSFT}, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by $+6.5$, and synthesis adds $+3.4$ IFEval and $+2.9$ IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds $+3.7$ MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.

</details>


### [403] [HTN-Orchestrate: A Hierarchical Task Network Framework for Multi-Agent Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22195)
*Yanchen Deng,Jianguo Huang,Yao Long Teng,Yixuan Li,Handuo Zhang,Ning Wang,Liangcai Su,Xinyu Wang,Bo An*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HTN-Orchestrate，一种基于层次任务网络(HTN)的两层多智能体编排框架，通过分离全局任务规划与本地子任务执行，在五个基准上优于现有基线，并在推理密集型任务上接近前沿专有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体编排方法在"灵活运行时调度"与"结构化全局规划"之间存在权衡：动态调度方法缺乏显式的子任务层级与依赖建模，而预定义工作流在执行前固定分解，无法根据执行反馈重塑规划。该差距在需要结构化分解与迭代精炼的复杂任务上尤为明显。

Method: HTN-Orchestrate采用两层架构：(1)上层Planner维护一个层次任务网络T=(V, E_h, E_d)，其中E_h为父子层级边，E_d为兄弟节点间的优先级依赖边，使用LLM增量式扩展网络，仅在先决条件结果可用后才进行依赖子任务的分解，结果沿层级边在AND语义下向上合成；(2)下层每个可执行叶节点被委托给一个Orchestrator，在多轮决策中根据累积报告派遣工作者(研究员/验证器)、等待进度或终止；(3)引入重建机制——当当前任务网络无法解决根任务时，将已支持的证据抽取为摘要M作为条件，构建新网络进入下一epoch。两层通过共享、可修订的任务结构与向上传播的结果相互反馈。

Result: 使用DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash骨干，HTN-Orchestrate在五个基准上均优于ReAct、Agent Team和DeepSeek Harness：BrowseComp 89.73%、FSR 43.33%、FSO 79.00%、SUPERChem 73.44%、PRL-Bench 46.00%，最高较Agent Team提升10.19个百分点(PRL-Bench)。尽管使用较小的开源骨干，差距却在多项指标上接近或超过GPT-6 Astra、Gemini 3.1 Pro等前沿专有模型。BrowseComp-200消融验证：移除结果知情规划、单智能体叶执行、移除重建各使准确率下降1.5/2.5/2.5个百分点，且改变执行模式。

Conclusion: 通过全局规划与本地执行的解耦，加上可重建的HTN作为共享结构，HTN-Orchestrate实现了灵活动态执行与结构化全局规划的统一，且各组件(结果知情规划、本地多智能体、重建)对最终性能均有独立贡献。未来工作包括扩展任务网络深度以应对更深的分解层级，并在更多骨干模型上评估。

Abstract: Orchestrating multiple agents on a complex task requires reconciling local subtask execution with global task planning. Dynamic dispatch approaches provide execution flexibility but do not explicitly model subtask hierarchies or dependencies, while predefined workflows impose this structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins. Therefore, we introduce HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN). The Planner maintains subtask hierarchies and dependencies, deferring decomposition until prerequisite results become available, while local Orchestrators schedule workers to execute each leaf subtask. Results propagate upward under \textbf{AND} semantics, and accumulated findings inform a rebuilt task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task. On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness using the same base model, achieving 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [404] [GNN-Guided Local Refinement for Efficient Layout Decomposition with DSA-MP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22214)
*Yu Feng,Liyi Zhou,Haoyu Wang,Yiming Xu,Hao Geng,Shaozhi Deng,Ningsheng Xu,Shisheng Xiong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对DSA-MP布局分解问题，提出了一种新的冲突图模型（显式捕获模板边到边间距约束）和基于GNN引导的局部精炼策略，通过利用ILP求解器中间特征训练的GNN预测需重新分配的via子集，显著加速收敛。在7nm和5nm基准上实现了约45倍加速，仅带来0.1%-2%的成本增加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 先进节点下，多重图案化光刻（MPL）与定向自组装（DSA）结合（DSA-MP）虽可提升分辨率，但传统分解方法面临求解质量与运行时间的权衡困境；2. 现有冲突图模型仅基于通孔中心间距，忽略了193i光刻中引导模板的非圆形几何特性及关键的边到边间距要求，导致可制造性受损；3. 随着设计进入先进节点，冲突与通孔比从1:2上升至2:1甚至3:1，传统方法难以扩展。

Method: 1. **新冲突图模型**：构建混合分组/冲突图，将光刻间距和模板相关冲突统一表示为模板边到边约束，区分三类冲突（SC、STC、TTC），并据此精炼EILP公式；2. **GNN引导的局部精炼框架**：采用三阶段流程——（A）基于ASAP7 PDK设计规则生成合成布局，用限时ILP求解生成"Vias-to-Refine"数据集；（B）将ILP实例表示为二部图，利用求解器派生特征（目标系数、约束偏置、约束系数、解池频率）训练GNN；（C）推理时根据GNN预测概率采用温度缩放采样策略选择2/3的via进行重优化，其余固定，缩小搜索空间。

Result: 1. **DSA-TPL（7nm）**：在合成布局上实现约45×加速，成本仅增加0.1%；在BOOM核心设计上实现约15×加速，成本增加约1.0%；2. **DSA-QPL（5nm）**：在工业设计上实现约12×加速，成本增加仅2%，GNN模型无需任何微调即可跨节点迁移；3. **大规模挑战布局**：在EILP和DLXplus均超时（20小时）的超大型布局（最大达66万via）上成功运行；5. **可制造性**：基于S-Litho仿真，所提冲突图模型相比传统模型获得最低的EPE和L2损失。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了首个显式建模DSA模板边到边间距约束的冲突图模型，以及一种通用的GNN引导局部精炼框架，可显著加速基于ILP的布局分解，同时保持接近最优的解质量。该框架具备良好的泛化能力（跨布局规模、设计风格、技术节点和掩模数量），并有潜力推广至其他基于ILP的物理设计优化问题。

Abstract: Multiple patterning lithography (MPL) has been widely used to improve lithography resolution in advanced nodes, but it faces cost limits as feature sizes shrink. Directed self-assembly (DSA) offers a cost-effective complement, extending the resolution of optical lithography to sub-10 nm and beyond. Integrating DSA into MPL (DSA-MP) further enhances the resolution of contact/via patterning. Nevertheless, growing design complexity exposes the limits of existing decomposition methods, which struggle to balance solution quality and runtime, and neglect edge-to-edge spacing constraints of DSA templates, compromising manufacturability. To address these issues, we introduce a new conflict graph model capturing the previously overlooked constraints and develop a local refinement strategy powered by the graph neural network, enabling efficient and scalable layout decomposition. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves higher solution quality with faster convergence than state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining robustness across layout scales, design styles, technology nodes, and varying mask counts.

</details>


### [405] [Shortcut Sensitivity in Agent-Safety Evaluations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22243)
*Hasan Demirkiran,Jens Ernstberger*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对AI智能体安全评估中的"捷径学习"问题，提出三级捷径审计框架，并在多个已发布的智能体安全基准上验证捷径信号对护栏决策的影响。核心发现是：基准数据的标注构建特征会强烈预测标签，且某些提示词护栏（特别是Claude Haiku 4.5）的决策会显著受这些表面线索操控，而其他模型（Luna、Q8量化TS-Guard）则不表现出同等程度的敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体通过工具执行操作，需用护栏(guard)监督敏感动作。但评估护栏的数据中常含有"捷径线索"——它们能预测标签，却未必反映真正的安全属性。这些线索同样可能误导护栏本身，造成评估失真。本文尝试系统化地揭示、审计并量化这种现象。

Method: 提出三级捷径审计推理阶梯：(1)标签可预测性——用能力受限的诊断器r(z)仅观察候选线索z预测标签y；(2)观测护栏关联——测量护栏输出与线索z的存在性差异Δassoc；(3)配对决策敏感性——在固定判断上下文s下改写线索z→z'，对每个(x, T(x))对调用护栏g，对随机型用重复调用+格式化安慰剂控制统计ΔT。在LinuxArena（932条公开轨迹去重为576条）、AgentDojo-Traj（1,220步）、AgentHarm-Traj（731步）三个数据集上使用简单诊断器（命令字符负均数、<INFORMATION>标记+11个动作前缀、精确工具名查表、全不安全基线）。构造64步冻结AgentDojo-Traj反事实队列（每域每标签8个标记存在样本），通过OpenRouter调用Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.6 Luna，并以8位Q8量化MLX复现的确定性TS-Guard作为对照，进行五次条件（原始/标记改写/工具别名/组合/安慰剂）各三次重复共960次调用的配对干预。

Result: (1) LinuxArena中命令长度AUC=0.910，LOEO词法AUC=0.934；(2) AgentDojo-Traj中标记+动作前缀规则F₁=0.802/bacc=0.894/recall=0.972；精确工具查表在分组CV下F₁=0.901但LODO下骤降至0.495，仅17.3%行工具有跨域训练可见；(3) AgentHarm-Traj行级TS-Guard F₁=0.902，但等权交互下F₁=0.719而bacc从0.754升至0.776；TS-Guard在配对执行组上不安全上下文均分0.922 vs 安全0.413；(4) Haiku干预中标记改写使阻塞率降低8.33pp[-15.05,-2.49]、别名提升11.46pp[2.69,20.59]、安慰剂-1.56pp；扣除安慰剂后效应-6.77pp[-12.82,-1.61]与+13.02pp[4.92,21.72]均不含零；严格准确率在原始73.44%→标记改写81.77%→别名61.98%变化；(5) Luna 0.00pp与+1.04pp，Q8对3/64对改变决策；(6) 7配置筛查中Haiku有最强安全行标记关联74.09pp[68.67,79.75]。

Conclusion: 基准表示会实质性地改变护栏的决策与评估分数。三级捷径审计（标签可预测性→观测关联→配对决策敏感性）可替代表面基准表现，给出评价结论是否在构造保留前提下保持稳健的证据。研究建议最低限度审计序列：诊断+迁移压力测试、明确评估单元、关联后干预、随机护栏加入重复/安慰剂控制；Haiku级别的效应在Luna与确定性Q8 TS-Guard中未复现，表明敏感性是配置特异的而非普遍现象。

Abstract: AI agents take actions through tools. Some actions are sensitive, so guards that supervise them must themselves be evaluated reliably. Yet the data used to evaluate a guard can include cues that make labels predictable without measuring the intended safety construct, and those cues can also influence guard decisions. We introduce a three-level shortcut-auditing framework and audit completed LinuxArena trajectories and two TS-Bench-derived step datasets. We distinguish label predictability, observational guard association, and paired decision sensitivity. In LinuxArena, shorter average shell commands strongly predict trajectory labels. In AgentDojo-Traj, exact-tool lookup falls from F_1=.901 with mixed-domain folds to .495 under domain holdout. In AgentHarm-Traj, released TS-Guard F_1 falls from .902 under row weighting to .719 with equal interaction weighting, while balanced accuracy rises. We then test the strongest safe-row marker association in a seven-configuration screen on a frozen 64-step AgentDojo-Traj cohort using repeated, interleaved Haiku calls. Rewriting the <INFORMATION> marker lowers blocking by 8.33 percentage points, while opaque tool aliases raise it by 11.46 points. All unsafe calls remain blocked; the changes concern false positives against inherited labels. Both effects remain nonzero after subtracting the formatting-placebo effect, with exploratory 95% ranges excluding zero. The same edits also change measured accuracy against inherited labels. This provides direct evidence that benchmark representation can materially change a guard's decisions and measured evaluation performance. The Haiku-sized effects do not reproduce in Luna or deterministic Q8 TS-Guard. We recommend domain group holdouts, evaluation-unit metrics, and placebo-controlled paired interventions.

</details>


### [406] [Disagreement-Guided Weak-to-Strong Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22245)
*Sima Noorani,Shayan Kiyani,George Pappas,Hamed Hassani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"修正分歧"（Corrected Disagreement, S_CD）路由分数，一种无需真值监督的弱到强模型路由方法。该分数通过弱-强模型分歧减去强模型自分歧来近似最优路由增益，在智能体环境和单轮推理任务中均优于无监督基线，甚至优于依赖真值标签训练的监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在边缘设备和机器人系统上部署小型语言模型时，传统级联路由依赖响应正确性信号。但在开放性和智能体任务中，获取真值监督成本高昂且难以规模化。例如，机器人动作评估需要环境交互，智能体行动可能产生延迟下游失效。因此，需要一种无需真值标签就能判断何时调用强模型的路由信号。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 在总体层面理论刻画最优弱到强路由策略——基于"正确性增益"Δ(h_σ) = t_p - max q_p(y_{w,i}) 的阈值规则；(2) 推导无监督近似——修正分歧分数 S_CD = min Pr(Y_s≠y_{w,i}) - Pr(Y_s≠Y_s')，即弱-强分歧减去强模型自分歧，仅用模型生成的响应即可计算，随着强模型逼近真值分布，近似误差消失；(3) 通过在线下对弱模型隐藏状态训练两个探针 f_d 和 f_g 来学习该分数，使用二元交叉熵和经验软标签，在智能体环境中采用DAgger式在线策略数据收集缓解分布漂移。

Result: 在两个智能体环境（BFCL Multi-Turn、Qwen3-8B→GPT-5-mini；WebShop、Qwen3-8B→RL策略）和三个单轮基准（MATH-500、Spider、AceCode）上，S_CD在所有路由预算下均一致优于原始弱-强分歧、token熵、自一致性、语义熵等无标签基线，甚至优于使用真值标签训练的代理奖励探针。在强模型较强的WebShop上，修正分歧优势显著；在强模型较弱的BFCL上，优势较小，印证了理论预测。智能体环境中的分布漂移通过DAgger式迭代缓解。

Conclusion: 修正分歧提供了一个原则性强、可扩展的无监督路由信号，将路由视角从"弱模型何时正确"转变为"使用强模型的相对价值"。它弥合了理论最优路由与其在缺乏真值场景下的实际部署之间的差距，为边缘部署和智能体系统中的混合推理开辟了实用路径。

Abstract: Small language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices and robotic systems to meet cost and latency constraints, yet their limited capabilities can make reliable deployment challenging. Stronger models can provide assistance when needed, but deciding when to route a weak-model response to a stronger model often relies on signals of response correctness. In open-ended and agentic tasks, however, obtaining such signals can require costly ground-truth supervision that is difficult to obtain at scale. We revisit the foundations of weak-to-strong routing and ask whether routing decisions can instead be guided by signals that do not require ground-truth supervision. We first characterize the optimal weak-to-strong routing policy, while allowing for multiple weak-model responses generated through local inference. Building on this characterization, we derive a principled approximation to the optimal routing based on model-to-model comparison. In particular, we introduce a notion of model disagreement that can be measured directly from model-generated responses, without ground-truth supervision. Importantly, the approximation becomes increasingly accurate as the strong model becomes a better proxy for the ground-truth distribution. Across agentic and single-turn tasks, our approach effectively navigates the trade-off between routing cost and response accuracy without ground-truth supervision. Moreover, even when ground-truth correctness signals are available for training, disagreement-based routing can outperform methods trained directly to predict correctness

</details>


### [407] [X-RIC: An Agentic RAN-Intelligent Controller Benchmark for Enhancing Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22269)
*Adhwaa Al-Chaab,Ayman Younis,Dario Pompili*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: X-RIC提出了一种集成Agentic AI的O-RAN智能控制器框架，通过TLM+RL混合架构与双过滤BC机制，实现样本高效、可解释的近实时RAN控制，并配套BARX评估基准，在SLA感知的网络切片场景中显著降低运营成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: O-RAN架构中现有RL方法存在样本效率差、泛化能力弱、可解释性不足三大局限，且传统LLM方案无法满足近实时RIC的亚秒级时延需求与闭环控制要求，导致其在动态网络切片等场景中难以部署。

Method: 提出X-RIC混合控制架构：(1)基于LLaMA3-8B + LangChain的TLM推理模块（含RAN状态编码器）作为监督决策层；(2)BC训练的DDPG作为低时延主控(<10ms)；(3)Critic引导的双过滤BC机制——episode级策略影响门控+动作级Q过滤自动采集高质量演示；(4)BARX基准从延迟、合规性、确定性、策略影响四个维度评估Agentic模型。

Result: X-RIC实现89%运营成本降低，75%更快收敛，50%训练步数节省，46%方差降低；L3模型BARX综合表现最优（延迟441.9ms，确定性100%）；Periodic校正策略获最佳稳定性（CV=15.2%）；OTA实测eMBB 17Mbps超出SLA 42%，URLLC时延降至5ms，SLA余量充足。

Conclusion: X-RIC首次将自动化BC与Agentic推理集成至O-RAN架构，验证了TLM+RL混合架构在近实时闭环控制中的可行性，BARX为领域专用Agentic模型评估提供了标准化方法，BC演示数量与策略性能正相关，为AI原生RAN部署奠定基础。

Abstract: The O-RAN ALLIANCE introduces architectural flexibility through disaggregation and AI-driven control. While the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) enables centralized optimization, current AI approaches lack reasoning capabilities and explainability. We propose eXplainable RIC (X-RIC), a novel framework integrating agentic AI into O-RAN architectures. X-RIC combines reactive Reinforcement Learning (RL) with strategic agentic reasoning through: (i) automated Behavioral Cloning (BC) using domain heuristics for sample-efficient training, (ii) a Telecom Language Model (TLM), a transformer-based reasoning module providing contextual abstraction and interpretability, and (iii) closed-loop co-adaptation within the Near-RT RIC control loop enabling continuous policy refinement. To ensure deployment readiness, we introduce BARX (Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning for RAN), a domain-specific evaluation framework assessing agentic control across latency, compliance, and determinism metrics. We validate X-RIC on SLA-aware network slicing in simulation and O-RAN-compliant testbed deployments. X-RIC achieves 89% operational cost reduction while maintaining SLA compliance, converging 75% faster with 50% fewer training steps and 46% lower variance.

</details>


### [408] [LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22280)
*Qingni Wang,Changdae Oh,Yuzhe Yang,Sharon Li,Jiachen Yang,Ang Li,Xin Eric Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LEASH是一个免训练的弱到强升级框架，通过分析弱智能体隐藏状态与历史成功/失败轨迹的相似度来估计不确定性，用于决定何时升级到强智能体以及升级后如何监控黑盒强智能体。在OSWorld基准上，使用Qwen3.5-35B-A3B作为弱智能体时达到73.66%任务成功率，匹配始终开启的Claude Opus 5（72.90%），同时推理成本降低19.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机使用智能体处理长时任务时，始终使用前沿模型成本高昂，而单独使用小型开源模型又常失败。弱到强升级提供了中间方案，核心难题在于：(1) 何时升级需要一个能在每步检查的低成本不确定性信号；(2) 升级后强智能体可能也会迷失，但黑盒API不暴露内部状态难以监控。现有方法要么需要额外监控智能体增加成本，要么需要专门训练监控模块，且忽略了升级后对黑盒强智能体的持续监督问题。

Method: LEASH是一个三层的免训练框架，统一由"潜在不确定性"驱动：(1) 初始任务级门控——基于任务提示查询的隐藏状态进行早期路由；(2) 步骤级门控——基于执行过程中动作隐藏状态的运行时升级；(3) 升级后影子观察者——弱智能体转变为监控者，每3步查询一次强智能体的轨迹，不确定性高时回滚待执行动作并促使强智能体以更高推理力重新决策。不确定性通过共享协方差高斯判别模型（LDA）在潜在空间中比较新隐藏状态与过去成功/失败轨迹的Mahalanobis距离来计算，运行时无需额外前向传播。方法在预算约束序列停止问题的框架下形式化，并提供了理论最优性证明。

Result: 在OSWorld（262个任务）上使用四个开源弱智能体和Claude Opus 5作为强智能体评估，LEASH在匹配升级率下比随机升级高出6.55–11.94个百分点，恢复75–102%的升级性能差距，成本仅为始终使用强智能体的69–81%。最佳配置：Qwen3.5-35B-A3B达到73.66%成功率（成本$0.4117/任务），超越始终开启的Opus 5（72.90%，$0.5094），降低19.2%成本；并优于StepWise和Progress Advantage等基线方法。阴影观察者在触发子集上将成功率从48.4%提升至64.5%。

Conclusion: LEASH提出弱到强升级作为自适应智能体系统的一般推理范式，证明单一潜在不确定性信号能同时支持选择性升级和升级后持续监督，为动态分配模型能力同时保持对强智能体执行的持续控制提供了实用机制。理论分析证明初始门控在固定升级率下具有最优性。但局限包括：评估限于OSWorld单一领域；不确定性分数估计弱智能体失败风险而非升级预期收益；升级后影子监控存在分布偏移问题。

Abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks, where running a frontier model at every step is expensive and a small open-weight model alone often fails. Weak-to-strong escalation offers a middle ground where a weak agent acts by default and hands control to a strong one only when needed. The core challenge is deciding when to escalate, which requires an uncertainty signal cheap enough to check at every step. However, even after handoff, the strong agent can still get lost, but a black-box API that the strong agent is usually served exposes no internals to monitor. To this end, we propose LEASH, a training-free framework that unleashes the strong agent only when the weak agent's latent uncertainty signals it is needed, and keeps it on a leash afterward. LEASH has three layers: (1) initial task uncertainty for early routing, (2) step-level uncertainty for runtime escalation, and, after handoff, (3) a shadow observer for continued oversight of the strong black-box agent. Here, we use latent uncertainty as a fuel for all three layers. Specifically, we compare the weak model's hidden states with those from its past successful and failed trajectories, and a state that looks more like the failures signals higher uncertainty. During weak-agent execution, our uncertainty estimator reuses activations already produced during action generation, so it needs no extra forward pass or dedicated monitor training. Experiments on OSWorld across four contemporary model backbones show that LEASH consistently improves over standalone weak agents and outperforms random escalation by 6.55--11.94 points at matched escalation rates. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, LEASH achieves 73.66% task success at $0.4117 per task, matching always-on Claude Opus 5 (72.90%) while reducing inference cost by 19.2%.

</details>


### [409] [Improving Environment-Agnostic Coding Agents: The Role of Scaffolding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22289)
*Sergey Rodionov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究环境无关（environment-agnostic）编码智能体中scaffolding的作用。通过在ARC-AGI-3、AGI Maze和Terminal-Bench三个环境中测试一个仅修改单条指令（鼓励遇到困难时停止并报告，让外部控制器自动继续）的Codex智能体，验证了小的、与环境无关的提示修改可以跨环境提升性能，同时发现专用scaffolding的优势仍然存在，并提供了EnvTraverse框架供进一步研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 更强的语言模型可能越来越多地为自己构建有用的程序，从而减少开发者提供的scaffolding的优势。本文旨在探究：①为什么专用scaffolding的优势仍然存在？②能否在不进行环境特定工程的情况下改进环境无关智能体？核心动机是区分"拥有可用的信息和工具"与"有效使用它们"之间的区别。

Method: 提出EnvTraverse框架，通过统一的agent-environment交互契约连接智能体和三个不同环境（ARC-AGI-3视觉谜题、AGI Maze状态迷宫、Terminal-Bench命令行任务）。设计了一个测试环境无关智能体的两个提示变体：Baseline（"继续工作直到完成任务"）和Stop-and-report（鼓励遇到困难/不确定性时停止并报告，由控制器自动继续）。两个变体仅在一条指令上有所不同，代码、提示和通用工具完全相同。评估模型包括GPT-5.5（high/xhigh）和GPT-5.6-sol（xhigh/max）。同时引入两个诊断变体：twma_v1.61（ARC-AGI-3专用参考）和Controlled_RESET（在Stop-and-report基础上添加脚本化重置管理）。还包括AGI Maze教程实验，测试先前经验的效果。

Result: Stop-and-report在ARC-AGI-3和AGI Maze上均提升了平均得分（ARC-AGI-3 RHAE提升1.4-7.3个百分点，AGI Maze RHAE70提升0.37-4.95个百分点），Terminal-Bench变化较小且方向不一。但即使使用GPT-5.6-sol，环境无关智能体仍低于ARC-AGI-3专用参考twma_v1.61。Controlled_RESET恢复了约34-60%的性能差距。AGI Maze教程实验显示，额外教程经验在某些配置下会降低性能。所有性能提升伴随着更高的令牌成本。

Conclusion: 即使在最强的测试配置（GPT-5.6-sol max）下，开发者提供的程序scaffolding仍然重要。关键洞察是"拥有信息/工具"与"有效使用它们"之间的区别。Stop-and-report通过鼓励智能体在遇到困难时返回控制（让控制器重新提示，可能促使智能体重读环境描述），从而提供重新考虑的机会。Controlled_RESET证明，将已存在于环境描述中的约定（game_over后重置）通过脚本化控制器实施，可以部分恢复专用智能体的优势。性能提升可能来自更有效的信息使用或更多的推理开销（这些效果可能同时作用且无法分离）。EnvTraverse框架和Baseline智能体已开源。

Abstract: Stronger language models may increasingly construct useful procedures for themselves, reducing the advantage of developer-supplied scaffolding. We investigate why this advantage persists and whether an environment-agnostic agent can be improved without environment-specific engineering. We evaluate a Codex-based agent in two nearly identical prompt variants on ARC-AGI-3, AGI Maze, and Terminal-Bench. Each variant is deployed with unchanged code, prompts, and general-purpose tools across environments, receiving environment-specific information as input. Changing only an instruction to encourage reporting difficulties and returning control for automatic continuation improves mean scores on both ARC-AGI-3 and AGI Maze, while Terminal-Bench shows small, mixed changes. Yet the general agent remains below an ARC-AGI-3-specific reference, including with GPT-5.6-sol. The reference prescribes organization and control rather than supplying new game rules or solutions. To investigate this gap, we transfer reset decisions to a scripted controller that follows a convention already given to the agent. This small change recovers part of the specialized agent's advantage. A complementary AGI Maze experiment shows that additional tutorial experience can reduce performance. Together, these findings highlight the distinction between having information and tools available and using them effectively. Supplied procedures still matter for the models tested here. The performance gains also come with higher token-based cost. The experiments do not separate better use of information and procedures from additional or differently allocated inference. We provide the EnvTraverse framework and an evaluated baseline agent for testing whether further environment-independent changes improve performance in some environments without degrading it in others.

</details>


### [410] [EliteReplay: Preserving Diverse Solutions in RL Post-Training via Quality-Diversity Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22290)
*Hanane Nour Moussa,Doeun Lee,Sachin Kumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EliteReplay提出了一种结合GRPO与质量-多样性搜索的LLM后训练方法，通过构建"精英档案库"并在训练中重放，有效解决RL后训练中解决方案多样性丧失的问题，在text-to-SQL任务上显著提升了策略多样性和对模糊问题的处理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL后训练（如RLVR/GRPO）虽能提升LLM的可靠性（pass@1），但会通过"锐化"效应收窄模型能产生的解决方案范围，降低其生成多样化正确答案的能力（pass@k）。现有方法多用pass@k作为多样性代理指标，无法区分"找到正确解"与"找到不同正确解"，且无法反映对基础模型原有策略的保留程度。理想目标是使模型既可靠又能产生多种优质解决方案。

Method: EliteReplay分两阶段：(1) 使用冻结的基础模型通过MAP-Elites质量-多样性算法构建"精英档案库"——先用LLM作为"标注器"从已验证解决方案中诱导出方法词汇表并分配行为描述符，再通过有针对性的选择（优先未表示的方法）、变化（提示基础模型按目标方法生成）和评估（验证并填充档案单元格）来填充档案；(2) 在GRPO训练中叠加一个固定权重的重放损失（基于档案中验证解的负对数似然），公式为 L=(1-μ)L_GRPO + μL_replay，其中μ=0.05。策略多样性度量包括：基于AST的唯一正确策略数(U@k)、有效多样性（ED）和基础模型策略保留率（Ret）。

Result: 在text-to-SQL任务（BIRD、Spider、AmbiQT）上的实验表明：EliteReplay在BIRD上达到74.8% pass@128（与MaxRL的73.7%相当），但产生9.1个不同正确策略/题 vs 6.2；在OOD的Spider上pass@128达93.2%，比最强基线高6.3个百分点，正确策略数最多多77%；保留62%（BIRD）和60%（Spider）的基础模型正确策略，比基线高至少23个百分点；在AmbiQT模糊问题上覆盖双义解读的比例达27.0%，接近最强基线14.2%的两倍；MATH-500上pass@1从28.3%提升至35.5%，优于所有基线（基线均下降）。消融实验证实：质量-多样性搜索构建的档案优于IID采样档案，且重放必须在RL全过程中持续进行（仅SFT预热不够）。

Conclusion: EliteReplay证明通过质量-多样性搜索构建的精英档案库在RL后训练中重放，可在保持准确率提升的同时显著保留基础模型的解决方案多样性。该工作还提出了基于策略级的多样性评估框架，揭示了pass@k指标无法捕捉的方法多样性差异，表明后训练不必以多样性换取可靠性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a common post-training technique to improve the accuracy of LLMs on verifiable tasks. However, such training can narrow the set of solutions the model can produce. Several approaches have attempted to address this behavior-sharpening effect, but they often optimize metrics that do not reflect the diversity of correct solutions. Ideally, we want a model that can produce multiple good solutions, not only a single reliable one. We propose EliteReplay, a post-training recipe that pairs GRPO with an "elite" archive built by quality-diversity search. Before training, we use the frozen base model to collect solutions that span distinct approaches; during training, GRPO is combined with a replay loss on this archive. The result is a post-trained model that improves accuracy while preserving more of the base model's solution diversity. On multiple text-to-SQL tasks, EliteReplay achieves a higher pass@128 than all baselines, producing up to 77% more distinct correct strategies than the strongest baselines. It preserves most of the base model's correct strategies, outperforming existing methods in strategy retention. This diversity translates into practical benefits on ambiguous questions, where EliteReplay covers both interpretations nearly twice as often as the strongest baseline on AmbiQT.

</details>


### [411] [Private Retrieval Augmented Generation via Random Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22297)
*Dixi Yao,Tahseen Rabbani,Tian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于随机投影（Random Projection, RP）的轻量级隐私保护方法，用于防御RAG系统中的数据提取攻击。通过对数据存储库嵌入和查询嵌入应用相同的随机投影矩阵，该方法在理论上保持语义相似性，在实践中显著降低隐私泄露，同时在效用上大幅优于基于差分隐私（DP）的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统通过从外部知识库检索信息增强LLM能力，但攻击者可通过精心设计的提示从数据存储库中提取敏感信息（如邮箱、电话、地址等个人身份信息）。现有基于差分隐私的防御手段虽提供形式化保证，但往往严重损害输出质量（高困惑度），且实现复杂。因此需要一种轻量级、实用且能有效防御数据提取攻击的隐私保护方案。

Method: 核心方法：对数据存储库的预计算嵌入和在线查询嵌入应用相同的随机投影矩阵 R ∈ ℝ^(k×d)，其中每个元素独立采样自 N(0, 1/k)。离线阶段一次性预处理，在线推理仅需一次矩阵-向量乘法。理论保证基于Johnson-Lindenstrauss引理，证明投影后ℓ2距离和余弦相似度均以高概率被保持。隐私机制在于：投影后，与原始top-1嵌入足够接近的替代嵌入可以以不可忽略的概率取代原始token，使得敏感token可能被语义相似但不含敏感信息的替代token替换。文中还提出了Top-1选择改变概率的Fisher变换证明。实验覆盖两种RAG架构：KNN-LM和Standard RAG。

Result: 在四个数据集（Enron Email、ECHR、C4、HotpotQA）和多个LLM（GPT-2、Llama3-1B/8B-Instruct、Qwen2-7B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B）上的实验表明：1）RP方法在效用上较DP基线提升超过50%，困惑度接近未受保护的RAG基线；2）在强攻击模型（重复查询攻击、多轮自适应攻击、成员推断攻击）下，隐私泄露率接近无RAG的参数化模型水平；3）RP的推理效率与vanilla RAG相当（每token延迟0.08秒），远优于DPSparseVoteRAG（2.80秒/每token，约30倍慢）；4）隐私-效用权衡对投影维度k具有鲁棒性，推荐k=100（d=2048时）；5）Rademacher分布的投影矩阵同样有效。

Conclusion: 随机投影可作为隐私保护RAG系统的一种实用且有竞争力的基线方法。相比形式化差分隐私保证，RP方法以更低的实现复杂度和计算开销实现了更优的隐私-效用权衡，为实际部署的RAG隐私防御提供了简单有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by querying external structured knowledge. However, it can also introduce privacy risks by leaking sensitive information from the retrieval datastore. We propose a simple method to preserve datastore privacy in RAG systems via random projection. By applying the same projection to both datastore embeddings and query embeddings, our method provably preserves semantic similarity between queries and retrieved items while substantially mitigating data extraction attacks. Across multiple RAG architectures and datasets, we show that this lightweight approach achieves superior retrieval and generation performance compared to prior methods which leverage formal differential privacy (DP) guarantees, while exhibiting comparable empirical privacy under strong attack models. Our results for the first time suggest that random projection can serve as a competitive and practical baseline for privacy-preserving RAG systems.

</details>


### [412] [A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22319)
*Maxence Faldor,Satinder Singh,Roberta Raileanu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon 通用编码智能体组成团队，仅通过标准开源 Mineflayer 库以编写 JavaScript 程序的方式控制玩家，无人类预设角色、游戏逻辑或专用工具，通过游戏内聊天与共享记忆自主协作，在 27 小时 14 分钟内完成了 Minecraft 生存模式从零开始击败末影龙的端到端挑战，期间共编写 2,783 个程序、死亡 605 次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究的核心动机是检验通用编程型智能体团队能否在没有人类编写游戏专属策略、技能库或课程学习的前提下，仅依靠通用指令完成超长视野（持续超过一天）、包含数千个依赖步骤且需多智能体协调的复杂任务。这一挑战反映了现实世界中软件工程和企业级任务对长程编码与协作能力的需求。

Method: 方法层面采用五个相同的 Gemini 4 Argon 编码智能体实例：四名玩家通过 Mineflayer（JavaScript 机器人库）与 Minecraft Java 1.20.4 生存服务器（简单难度、随机种子）交互，第五个为不参与操作的 Observer 智能体。智能体通过编写运行 JavaScript 程序（默认 60 秒超时，中位数 33.5 秒）执行采集、合成、建造、战斗等动作，结果以文本返回。团队协调依靠游戏内聊天和持久共享记忆（含私有与公共部分）。一般指令要求观察环境、验证结果、建立可复用工具、记录经验教训并诚实报告；不包含任何 Minecraft 专属策略。服务器每 5 分钟存档，崩溃后从最近存档重启。

Result: 27 小时 14 分钟内击败末影龙，达成首个完全自主、仅使用标准 Mineflayer 库的端到端通关：跨越 13 个相互依赖的步骤，团队自发形成分工（gyldenia 采集、janesick 工具与要塞定位、auratian 战略与水晶突破、bulicame 最终一击），克服了末影人捕捉、烈焰人刷怪、龙治疗水晶等多个复杂挑战。在无干预下涌现出专门化、共享记忆、自主工具、相互救助与错误纠正等类人团队行为。最终龙战 bulicame 仅剩 2.5/20 生命值。总成本约 810 美元（输入 13.5 亿 tokens，91% 来自上下文缓存；输出 1600 万 tokens，含 400 万思考 tokens）。

Conclusion: 论文证明通用编程智能体团队可在无需游戏专属工具、课程或预分配角色的条件下，通过长视野自主编码与多智能体协调完成复杂端到端任务，是首个从零通关 Minecraft 的 AI 自主尝试。然而存在显著局限：Mineflayer 提供超越人类的感知与寻路能力、简单难度降低难度、依赖模型先验知识、605 次死亡、22% 程序错误、6 次服务器中断，以及仅展示单次成功运行，结果的可靠性与泛化性仍待证明。这为评估智能体在现实软件与企业任务中的长程协作能力提供了初步参考。

Abstract: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on Easy difficulty, the team wrote 2,783 programs and defeated the dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes, dying 605 times along the way. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents, achieved using only the standard Mineflayer library without pre-scouted seeds or other game-specific tools written by humans. Winning required the agents to keep a coherent plan across thousands of dependent steps for more than a day. Complex real-world software engineering and enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination. We describe the setup, how the run unfolded, the team's strategies (dividing the work, sharing what they learned, recovering each other's items), and the limits of the result.

</details>


### [413] [Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22330)
*Weijian Luo,Yujian Chen,Hao Jiang,Guang Cheng,Tianyang Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对连续扩散语言模型（CDLM）系统性地研究了Transformer架构设计，提出了一种名为LangDiT的新型骨干网络。该架构结合了特征与Q/K归一化、宽度噪声条件化、似然捷径梯度路由与校准、以及置信门控训练自条件化等四项核心设计。在OpenWebText数据集上，LangDiT在LangFlow框架中以250k更新匹配条件下将GenPPL从64.26降至53.66（128 NFE），相对降低16.5%；扩展训练至660k更新后达到21.72 GenPPL（1024 NFE）。在Plaid风格CDLM中，LangDiT也取得了领先的11.33 GenPPL（1024 NFE）。研究证实了架构设计是连续扩散语言模型性能提升的重要独立来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CDLM研究通常直接沿用因果LLM或图像Diffusion Transformer（DiT）的架构，而这些架构并未针对连续语言生成的特殊需求进行优化。CDLM需要从噪声连续状态恢复离散语言token，同时协调噪声依赖计算、词汇预测和自条件化，这要求专门的架构设计。因此本文旨在系统性地研究：什么样的Transformer架构最适合连续扩散语言模型？

Method: LangDiT包含四个核心设计组件：1) **骨干网络归一化**：用RMSNorm替代LayerNorm以保留均值信息；引入Headwise Q/K RMSNorm以控制注意力logit尺度，其上界为√d_h·‖g_q‖_∞·‖g_k‖_∞，消除原始输入范数对注意力logit的影响。2) **加宽噪声条件化**：将条件向量宽度从128增至256（增加7.36M参数），为噪声依赖调制提供更大容量。3) **似然捷径梯度路由与校准**：基于高斯腐蚀模型推导捷径ℓ = ℓ_raw + c_skip(γ)·z_γ·C^⊤；提出stop-gradient切断直接codebook梯度路径，同时引入有界学习门a_ψ(γ)∈[0.5,2]控制捷径的前向贡献。4) **置信门控训练自条件化**：使用基于token熵的权重w_i=clip(1-H_i/log|V|,0,1)对bootstrap输入进行门控，推理时仍使用未加权后验均值。架构实验采用7阶段累积消融（R1-R7），在LangFlow和Plaid-style两种CDLM公式中分别评估。

Result: 核心实验结果：在OWT-1024上，LangFlow基线与LangDiT在250k更新匹配条件下，128 NFE的GenPPL从64.26降至53.66（相对降低16.5%），平均样本一元熵从5.416降至5.391。1024 NFE下（180k检查点）GenPPL从41.98降至24.04。扩展训练（660k）下LangFlow+LangDiT在1024 NFE达到21.72 GenPPL（熵5.06），128 NFE为44.72。在Plaid-style CDLM上，250k内匹配对比显示GenPPL从52.32降至38.14（128+1 NFE）、从23.91降至13.90（1024+1 NFE）；扩展训练（520k）后达到27.51（128+1 NFE）和11.33（1024+1 NFE，熵5.01）。累积消融中，R1→R7在50k步骤将GenPPL从87.48降至61.73（降低29.4%），其中置信门控自条件化带来最大相邻降幅（74.03→61.73）。模型总参数量为334.45M（基线327.09M）。需要注意的是，Plaid对比存在检查点步数不完全匹配的情况，且所有GenPPL改进均伴有熵降低。

Conclusion: 本文通过系统性消融研究确立了架构设计是连续扩散语言模型性能提升的根本来源之一。LangDiT的核心贡献在于：(1)将特征尺度控制与噪声依赖调制解耦；(2)解耦似然捷径的前向贡献与直接codebook梯度；(3)区分干净状态估计与自条件化输入的权重。LangDiT可作为即插即用骨干网络应用于不同的CDLM公式（LangFlow和Paid），在保持各模型的表示、目标和采样器不变的前提下改善生成性能。然而，研究存在以下局限：仅在OWT-1024单一规模、单一种子上测试；累积消融测量的是沿固定设计序列的增量效应；加宽条件化引入了参数增加；GenPPL和一元熵仅捕获生成质量的有限方面。未来的工作需要更大规模的实验、组件移除消融、参数匹配对比，以及对注意力行为和codebook梯度的直接测量。

Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) offer an alternative approach to parallel language generation; however, most existing studies directly use transformer architectures from either causal large language models (LLMs) or Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for image generation, which were not optimized for CDLMs. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on Transformer architectures for CDLMs and introduce Language Diffusion Transformer (LangDiT), combining feature and query-key normalization, wider noise conditioning, likelihood-shortcut gradient routing and calibration, and confidence-gated training self-conditioning. LangDiT significantly reduces generation perplexity in matched LangFlow comparisons, establishing a new state of the art in continuous language generation across different model formulations. Using LangFlow as a representative CDLM, LangDiT as a plug-and-play backbone leads to a new state-of-the-art model with a generation perplexity (GenPPL) of 21.72 using 1024 NFEs and 44.72 GenPPL using 128 NFEs on the unconditional generation of 1024-token sequences on the OpenWebText dataset. When adapted to Plaid-style CDLM formulations, LangDiT results in a new leading GenPPL of 11.33 using 1024 denoising NFEs, and 27.51 GenPPL using 128 denoising NFEs. These gains are achieved while retaining each model's underlying representation, training objective, and inference sampler, isolating transformer architecture as a fundamental source of improvement. Our study identifies architectural design as an important source of improvement in continuous diffusion language models.

</details>


### [414] [KnowGPO: Knowledge-Grouped Policy Optimization for Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22331)
*Siqi Chen,Zhengxi Lu,Yuchen Yan,Xingyu Wu,Qipeng Chen,Xin Zhang,Aiting Liu,Chao Deng,Jie Liu,Jin Ma,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KnowGPO 提出了一种基于"任务相关知识状态"而非"表面观察"进行轨迹对齐的强化学习框架,通过将查询分解为原子知识条件、构建知识状态分组,并以增量知识增益作为环境接地的过程奖励,解决了深度搜索智能体中的长程信用分配难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度搜索智能体在长程多轮交互中存在信用分配难题:基于结果的RL(如GRPO)将单一终端奖励均匀广播到所有动作,而现有过程监督方法(GiGPO依赖环境状态匹配、IGPO依赖模型内部置信度)在异构观察和噪声检索内容下均不可靠。需要一种既能进行细粒度信用分配、又不依赖状态匹配或模型内部信号的环境接地方法。

Method: 1) 两阶段构建原子知识条件集 K(Q):Stage1 从查询中识别带占位符的推理骨架,Stage2 利用参考答案与成功轨迹进行实体落地,保证原子性、完整性与一致性;2) 知识状态 s_{i,t}:LLM 验证器(DeepSeek-v3.2)逐检查每步新观察是否满足各条件,通过单调 OR 累积形成 K 维二值向量;3) 增量知识增益 r_{i,t}=||s_{i,t}||_1-||s_{i,t-1}||_1 作为过程奖励;4) 在同一知识状态组内做组内归一化得到步级优势 A^S,与回合级结果优势 A^E 通过混合系数 ω 线性组合,采用 PPO 裁剪目标更新策略。验证器调用异步执行,与下一批 rollout 重叠,几乎无额外开销。

Result: 在 Xbench-2505/2510、BrowseComp-ZH、GAIA 四个基准上,以 Qwen3-8B 为基座:平均比 GRPO/GiGPO/IGPO 基线提升 3.8–4.2 个百分点;在 BrowseComp-ZH 达 38.8%,超越 WebSailor-32B、DeepDive-32B 等 32B 开源系统;消融显示 ω=0.3 最优,知识分组与增量增益各自必要;分组质量分析表明知识锚 ESR 达 97.8%(观察锚仅 51.8%);案例显示 KnowGPO 在证据充分时及时停止搜索,避免 GRPO 因过度搜索用误导性释义覆盖已得出的正确答案。

Conclusion: KnowGPO 通过把信用分配从"观察层面"提升到"知识层面",在不依赖状态匹配、学得的价值模型或模型内部概率的前提下,实现了细粒度、环境接地的过程监督,为长程深度搜索智能体提供了一条可扩展、训练成本几乎与 GRPO 持平且显著强于现有过程监督基线的路径。局限在于依赖可验证的原子知识条件集、需要至少一条成功参考轨迹进行实体落地,以及验证器残余误差会向上传播至步级优势。

Abstract: Deep search agents solve knowledge-intensive tasks through long-horizon, multi-turn interactions, where assigning credit to individual search decisions is fundamentally difficult. Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides only a single terminal reward shared across an entire trajectory. Recent process-supervision methods aim to assign credit at finer granularity, but they typically anchor credit to either surface-level trajectory states or model-internal signals, both of which become unreliable in deep search where observations are heterogeneous and retrieved contexts are long and noisy. We propose KnowGPO, a reinforcement learning framework that aligns trajectories by the task-relevant knowledge they have acquired rather than by their surface observations. For each query, KnowGPO decomposes the information required to derive the answer into atomic knowledge conditions, and represents the state of a trajectory at each step by the subset of conditions it has satisfied. Trajectories sharing the same knowledge state are grouped for within-group comparison, and the incremental knowledge gain between consecutive steps serves as an environment-grounded process reward. Experiments on Xbench, BrowseComp-ZH, and GAIA show KnowGPO consistently outperforms outcome-only (GRPO) and process-supervision baselines (GiGPO, IGPO) by 3.8 to 4.2 points, with our 8B model rivaling or exceeding most 32B open-source systems.

</details>


### [415] [Evaluation Awareness Beyond English: Do LLMs Act Differently When Tested in Indic Languages?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22333)
*Trizal Garg,Sibayan Mitra,Arya Karanjkar,Advait Singh,Jagat Sesh Challa,Yash Sinha,Siddharth Mehrotra,Dhruv Kumar,Pratham Yogish Maliya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型在五种印度语言（印地语、孟加拉语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语和卡纳达语）中是否表现出"评估意识"（evaluation awareness），即模型在被告知正在接受测试时是否会改变其行为，特别是在安全相关任务上。研究测试了四个指令调优模型在六种语言下的表现，发现所有模型在所有语言中，当被告知正在接受评估时，对有害请求的拒绝率都会显著上升，且这种上升在印度语言中至少与英语一样大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的评估意识研究几乎完全集中在英语上，而模型实际上服务于全球数十亿使用印度语言的用户。安全评估通常假设测试期间的行为可以推广到部署环境，但如果模型能够识别评估场景，这一假设就会失效。鉴于印度语言使用者超过十亿，了解评估意识是否存在于这些语言中对于设计有效的多语言安全评估至关重要。

Method: 研究采用受控行为实验设计，从AI4Bharat的IndicAlign语料库中获取有害和良性提示，使用Claude Opus将199个英语有害提示翻译成五种印度语言，并确保所有语言都有平行翻译。测试了四个指令调优模型（Gemma-3-27B、Qwen3-32B、Qwen2.5-72B和Sarvam-M）。实验设计了五种"提示线索"（cues）——从基本的部署框架到明确的安全测试声明，以测量不同强度的评估信号影响。使用Gemma-4-31B-IT作为主判断模型（LLM judge）评估拒绝率，并通过第二判断模型（GPT-6 Luna）和母语者审查进行验证。采用McNemar检验、Cochran Q检验和GEE逻辑回归等多种统计方法分析数据，共产生47,880个判断响应。

Result: 研究发现三个核心结论：1）明确的安全测试线索使所有四个模型在所有六种语言中对有害提示的拒绝率均提高了13.8个百分点（平均），且在24个模型-语言单元中的23个具有统计显著性；2）这一上升在印度语言中与英语相当或更大——印度语言平均上升14.4个百分点，而英语为10.6个百分点；3）测试线索主要作用于有害提示而非良性提示，害提示的拒绝率上升是良性提示的3.5倍。此外，即使从监控提示（仅说明响应被记录）与评估日志提示（增加AI安全团队审查内容）的对比中，也能观察到拒绝率上升，表明模型会对评估框架作出反应，即使没有显式使用"测试"或"评估"等词汇。表明印度语言安全评估可能无法真实反映模型对日常用户的处理方式。

Conclusion: 评估意识并非仅限于英语问题，必须在设计多语言安全评估时予以考虑。模型在所有测试语言中都能识别评估上下文并调整其行为，这表明当前的印度语言安全评估可能高估了模型的实际安全性，因为模型会识别出评估情境并采取更谨慎的行为。研究者发布了完整的47,880个判断响应数据集，以支持该领域的进一步研究。然而该研究也存在一些局限：仅测试了24B到72B参数的开源模型（推理能力被禁用），印度语言有害提示是LLM翻译的（仅小样本经过母语者验证），以及泰卢固语中主判断模型与母语者的一致性较低（κ=0.56）。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can often tell when they are being tested. This ability, known as evaluation awareness, can lead models to act more cautiously during safety evaluations than in real use. Existing work has studied evaluation awareness almost entirely in English, although models serve users in many languages. Indic languages are spoken by over a billion people, yet evaluation awareness remains almost entirely unstudied in them. We test four instruction-tuned models from three families in five Indic languages alongside English. A set of cues varies whether the model is told that it is monitored and whether the monitoring is a safety test. Models refuse harmful requests more often when they are told that they are being tested. This increase appears in all four models and all six languages. In Indic languages, refusal of harmful requests rises by 14.4 percentage points on average. The test cue also brings Indic refusal of harmful requests level with English, but raises refusal of benign Indic requests from 6.9% to 11.3%. We release all 47,880 judged responses to support further work. These results suggest that safety evaluations in Indic languages may not reflect how models treat their everyday users.

</details>
