### [416] [MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22344)
*Shangheng Du,Jinxin Shi,Shuaiyu Zhang,Yiming Wu,Junpeng Zhao,Shiyang Feng,Xin Li,Liang He,Xiangchao Yan,Bo Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MLExpert（35B MoE智能体模型），通过分层智能体SFT和窗口交互强化学习（WIRL）实现自主长周期机器学习工程，在MLE-Bench Lite上将奖牌率从37.9%提升至72.7%，性能媲美Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3等更大前沿模型，并可泛化至科学任务、智能体脚手架优化和算法优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLE系统多采用外部预定义工作流或搜索规则控制实验流程，对模型的自主组织能力利用不足；同时长周期MLE任务中每次实验的反馈依赖多次前置决策，单次实验代价高昂，给在线RL带来延迟反馈与异步更新两大核心挑战。论文目标是将长周期优化决策能力训练为模型自身能力，推动AI4AI与递归自我改进。

Method: 构建Kaggle-MLE Factory将历史竞赛转化为可执行任务，并设计模型主导的ReAct式交互环境（实验树、提交候选管理、invalidate_node、analyze子智能体等）。训练分为两阶段：1）分层智能体SFT——先基于通用工具使用/代码数据，再基于MLE与科学实验教师轨迹，通过结果导向的监督选择（按最优提交锚点截断退化尾部）筛选样本；2）窗口交互RL（WIRL）——将相邻实验结果之间的多轮决策视为一个执行窗口，以可验证的执行奖励（含本地趋势奖励T_m和令牌级策略修正的PPO式损失）作为共享优势进行异步在线更新，无需等待轨迹完成。

Result: MLExpert在MLE-Bench Lite上将基础模型Qwen3.6-35B-A3B的Any Medal率从37.9%提升至72.7%，Gold率从22.7%升至50.0%，在Claude Code通用脚手架下也以69.7%对42.4%保持优势；NatureBench Lite上Surpass-SOTA率由0%提升至50%，与GLM-5.3持平；AIME脚手架优化中保持43.7%留出准确率（Kimi-K3为40.0%），MLS-Bench-Lite算法组件优化上12任务中10胜1平1负，均值奖励从0.322提升至0.425。消融显示：通用SFT→47.0%、MLE SFT→62.1%、WIRL→72.7%；WIRL学习器等待占比39.3%，远低于GRPO的87.6%。

Conclusion: 长周期优化决策是可训练的模型能力。分层智能体SFT结合执行窗口级RL（WIRL），结合可执行MLE任务工厂与交互环境，使中等规模MoE模型在自主机器学习工程上达到与更大前沿模型相当的水平，并能泛化至科学实验、智能体脚手架和算法组件优化，为自主ML工程与AI4AI/递归自我改进提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are expanding from assisting scientific research and engineering to autonomously developing and improving AI systems, advancing AI for AI (AI4AI) as a pathway toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Workflow-driven machine learning engineering (MLE) systems provide a practical path toward this pursuit through complex orchestration that manages long-horizon experimentation, while recent MLE systems adopt model-directed interaction, allowing models to autonomously organize experiments and adapt optimization strategies based on execution feedback. However, feedback from each experiment reflects several preceding decisions, and a long MLE run contains many such costly experiments. Training must therefore select useful supervision from long interaction trajectories and learn from intermediate outcomes. We propose a post-training method for autonomous long-horizon MLE optimization and apply it to train MLExpert, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model. We design the Kaggle-MLE Factory to construct executable tasks and an interaction harness for model-directed experimentation. Hierarchical agentic SFT transfers general tool-use and coding capabilities to MLE through outcome-guided supervision. Windowed Interaction RL (WIRL) treats the multi-turn decisions between successive experiment results as an execution window and assigns it a shared outcome-based reward. Asynchronous collection and policy correction support policy updates before the trajectory ends. On MLE-Bench Lite, MLExpert improves the average medal rate of the base model from 37.9% to 72.7%, achieving performance comparable to larger frontier models such as Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3. Further experiments show that MLExpert improves performance on NatureBench Lite, agent scaffold optimization, and algorithm optimization, suggesting that the learned optimization capability generalizes to other tasks.

</details>


### [417] [FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22350)
*Dongxu Yang,Hongda Yan,Renxin Wang,Baoli Zhang,Haojia Zuo,Ying Zhao,Youmin Chen,Xiaojian Liao,Congming Gao,Tianyang Jiang,Yixiao Chen,Qing Wang,Zhiguo Yu,Xiaqing Li,Yuhao Zhang,Jiawen Sun,Renzhe Xu,De Mi,Tiancheng Wu,Xianya Fu,Xuanlu Zhao,Bo Feng,Meixuan Ren,Guanming Lin,Ziheng Zhou,Xinhua Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FDE-Gym 是首个端到端评估 AI 在真实客户交付场景中表现的基准,涵盖 95 个任务、20 个行业场景、18 个领域。它揭示了当前最优模型与参考解决方案之间的巨大差距:最佳配置平均得分仅 0.56,仅解决 14/95 任务。未声明约束的发现是主要瓶颈,而仅获取信息也不足以确保有效交付。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准通常评估任务规范明确的情形(如 issue 报告、规格说明),而真实客户交付中,前线部署工程师(FDE)需要澄清需求、优化施工、并发现未声明的约束。该论文旨在填补"AI 交付最后一公里"评估的空白。

Method: 该论文构建了 FDE-Gym 基准,包含 95 个端到端交付任务(源自 20 个真实客户场景,覆盖 18 个行业领域),由行业专家改编自真实交付项目。评估在模拟客户环境中进行,包含脚本化利益相关者和可修改的客户系统。设计了四个任务指令级别(L0-L3),从完全规范到发起方原始请求逐步减少信息量。评分基于客户自身业务指标的改进,归一化为 0(无变更系统)到 1(参考解决方案),并对利益相关者交互(消息、试验运行、等待时间)进行惩罚。评估了来自七个提供商的 13 个模型配置。

Result: 最佳模型配置(Claude Opus 5.5)在 L3 真实设置下平均得分 0.56,仅解决 14/95 任务;五个配置未解决任何任务。当提供规则和约束(L0)时,领先模型得分 0.73-0.82;当需自行发现限制时,得分降至 0.39-0.62。领先模型获取了 72-85% 的关键事实,但仅实现 0.60-0.70 的参考提升,利益相关者接触成本进一步降低得分 0.14-0.22。弱模型在 60-83% 的任务上低于"不作为"基线。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了解决明确定义的任务与为真实客户交付有效 AI 系统之间的巨大差距。领先模型在发起方请求被误导时表现出较少的性能损失,其主要性能损失源于将事实转化为有效系统,以及交付过程中的利益相关者接触成本。较弱的模型在大多数任务上的表现劣于完全不交付。FDE-Gym 通过客户自身指标量化了这一交付判断能力,为人和智能体在同一规则下的评估提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.

</details>

### [418] [Cyclotron: A Recurrence Language for Expressing Interprocessor Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20981)
*Shiv Sundram,Akhilesh Balasingam,Nathan Zhang,Kunle Olukotun,Fredrik Kjolstad*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Cyclotron是一个将分布式数据流算法表达为循环方程（recurrence equations）并编译为分布式处理器拓扑的编译器系统。它将通信策略提升为编程中的一等公民，使用户能够灵活探索不同的通信模式（系统脉动、广播、树形广播、双向分裂环、混合分段策略），并在不重写计算逻辑的情况下切换空间-时间映射。系统在矩阵乘法、TRSM、Cholesky和融合Cholesky-TRSM等分布式线性代数算法上与ScaLAPACK、SLATE和cuSolverMp等专家调优库相比具有竞争力且常超越后者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式架构上，数据移动成本远高于计算成本，已成为性能瓶颈。然而，现有的主流编程抽象（张量代数、循环IR、多面体表示）将所有数据访问视为对内存位置的逻辑读取或写入，无法表达数据如何在处理器间或时间维度上移动。同时，现有的分布式库（如ScaLAPACK、SLATE）要么硬编码通信策略，要么只暴露有限的预设选项，而最佳通信策略随问题规模、瓦片大小、互连和架构变化。多面体框架（如AutoSA、AlphaZ）虽能自动生成通信，但通常只支持最近邻脉动传输，无法表达广播、树形广播或异构混合通信策略。

Method: Cyclotron引入一种基于迭代空间上的循环方程编程模型，允许张量不仅存在于内存中，也存在于迭代空间本身上。计算和通信均通过同一坐标系统中的方程表达：例如，(i,j,k)_A ← (i,j-1,k)_A既可表示脉动数据移动，也可表示相邻处理器的传输。用户通过逐维注释声明哪些维度为空间维度（跨处理器）、哪些为时间维度（跨时间步保留）。编译流水线包括：(1) 依赖图构建与活跃/陈旧边分类——纯沿时间维的偏移被标记为"陈旧"（值已在寄存器中），被切除以打破循环依赖；(2) 拓扑排序确定发射顺序；(3) 推导推送（DeducePushes）综合出发送端；(4) 同步控制流插入；(5) 可选的块循环分解与通信去重。系统支持Gimbal-locking索引（通过将索引变量互相替代来定义子空间），以及通过约束定义三角形金字塔形迭代空间。

Result: 在CPU集群（Perlmutter上最多16个节点）上，矩阵乘法相对ScaLAPACK获得1.7-1.8×加速；块循环Cholesky在16个CPU节点上相对ScaLAPACK获得1.34-1.68×加速，最佳通信策略随配置变化。在GPU（A100，最多16个）上，相对SLATE（主机暂存通信）获得最高1.24×加速；使用GPU直接通信时相对SLATE获得最高4.74×加速，相对Nvidia cuSolverMp获得1.12-1.28×加速。"乒乓球"调度（交错两种互补空间映射的TRSM）在4节点和8节点配置下相对ScaLAPACK分别达到1.97×和2.07×吞吐量。融合Cholesky-TRSM在负载不均衡配置下隐藏了约90%的独立TRSM时间，在块循环配置下隐藏18-23%。不同通信策略间的相对性能随架构（CPU vs GPU）和问题规模显著变化。

Conclusion: Cyclotron成功将通信策略提升为分布式分块算法中可表达的一等概念，通过将通信从计算和空间-时间映射中分离，程序员可以在不重写计算的情况下改变数据移动方式，并可探索广泛的通信调度空间。在CPU和GPU上，这种灵活性使Cyclotron能够匹配且经常超越手工优化的分布式线性代数库，同时证明最佳调度依赖于机器、算法和问题规模。这项工作为在异构分布式计算平台上探索更深入的通信策略（包括多芯片GPU系统、晶圆级引擎和空间数据流加速器）开辟了道路。

Abstract: We present Cyclotron, a compiler that expresses streaming dataflow algorithms using recurrence equations, which are then compiled to distributed topologies of interlinked processors. Our compiler lowers a language of recurrences over logical iteration spaces into per-processor programs of sends, receives, and computations. In these recurrences, data accesses are not limited to external accesses to memory; data can live separately on the iteration space itself, allowing internal points to communicate values directly with other points. Users specify this communication directly in the recurrence language, which allows them to express various communication patterns such as a nearest-neighbor systolic exchange, a one-to-all broadcast, a bidirectional split ring, or an asymmetric and piecewise broadcast pattern, which are often not supported by standard distributed linear algebra libraries. These recurrences describe the algorithm and communication independently of how they map onto the hardware. A programmer then chooses which dimensions execute across processors and which execute over time, without rewriting the entire program. Users only specify data dependencies across the iteration space, and the compiler safely generates a program, per process, with correct placement of both communication and computational operators according to the chosen space--time mapping. We evaluate distributed matrix multiplication, TRSM, Cholesky, and fused Cholesky--TRSM on up to 16 CPU nodes and 16 GPUs, comparing against ScaLAPACK, SLATE, and cuSolverMp. Cyclotron is competitive with and often outperforms these hand-optimized libraries; for Cholesky, the best communication strategy changes with problem size and architecture.

</details>


### [419] [Probabilistic Optical-Layer Surrogate for Risk-Aware Control-Plane Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21069)
*Venkat Sai Suman Lamba Karanam*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于光层的生成式代理模型（generative surrogate），将光层物理行为暴露为快速概率查询接口，使控制面做出风险感知决策，无需为每次决策重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有光网络控制面决策依赖解析损伤模型、确定性ML预测器或分位数回归的不确定性估计，仅提供静态、有限的物理层信息摘要，迫使运营商使用保守固定裕度导致容量利用率不足。需要一种能在线暴露完整条件分布、支持任意阈值违规概率查询的快速概率接口。

Method: 采用条件生成模型（主选混合密度网络MDN，亦评估条件VAE）作为光层代理。离线阶段基于GNPy模拟器生成训练轨迹并训练代理；在线阶段由控制面查询代理以获取OSNR、Q-margin、非线性惩罚及可行性的完整条件分布，支持任意阈值τ下的违规概率估计和尾部风险查询。通过RSA-lite控制器集成风险感知路径选择策略；九大研究问题（RQ1-RQ9）涵盖精度、延迟、不确定性质量、控制器集成、跨模拟器泛化（Mininet-Optical）、动态重配置、拓扑可扩展性、GNPy验证泛化、生产网络延迟。

Result: （1）Q-margin MAE = 0.787 dB，与确定性ML相当；（2）单次查询延迟从GNPy的2592 ms降至0.005 ms，候选集1000路径评估仅5.34 ms；（4）生成式风险感知策略阻塞率最低（0.395）、频谱利用率最高（0.652）；（5）Mininet-Optical跨模拟器AUC=0.667（Q-margin动态范围差2.61×），排序部分保留；（6）MDN主动控制器比反应式基线提前19步触发重路由，τ=0.20时违规率为0；（7）四种拓扑MAE稳定在0.72-0.77 dB；（8）GNPy验证泛化MAE劣化<0.10 dB，AUC保持0.997-0.999；（9）阿里云生产网络11209快照上单查询0.41±0.29 ms，实现6275倍加速。

Conclusion: 该生成式代理将物理层行为从离线模拟输出或确定性可行性规则转变为快速概率查询机制，是首个针对光层的代理建模案例研究。MDN在风险感知控制面集成、主动重配置和跨拓扑泛化方面展现了优势。存在的局限包括：仅使用模拟器数据、未涵盖硬件联合、版本路由频谱联合优化、采用受控退化模型、需后续校准、温度缩放或一致性校正。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a generative surrogate for the optical layer. Current control-plane decisions in optical transport networks are made using analytical impairment models, deterministic learned predictors, or quantile-regression-based uncertainty estimates. These approaches expose only a limited, static summary of the optical layer at any given time. This forces the control plane to rely on conservative fixed margins that leave capacity underutilized. Our proposed surrogate is a conditional generative model trained on traces from optical simulators with validated physical models. The surrogate produces a full conditional distribution over physical-layer metrics such as OSNR, Q-margin, nonlinear penalty, and feasibility. This output allows the controller to estimate violation probability and tail risk at arbitrary thresholds at runtime. This is different from existing approaches because no retraining is required for each decision. We present the first case study in fast path feasibility estimation using a generative surrogate for the optical layer. We compare the surrogate against simulators, deterministic learned predictors, and quantile-regression estimators. We evaluate the surrogate along nine research questions (RQ1--RQ9) covering prediction accuracy, inference latency, uncertainty quality, controller integration, cross-emulator generalization, dynamic reconfiguration under span degradation, topology scalability, GNPy-validated generalization, and finally, inference latency on real-world live hardware traces. The core contribution is an optical-layer control abstraction where physical-layer behavior is exposed as a fast probabilistic query mechanism instead of an offline simulation output or a deterministic feasibility rule.

</details>


### [420] [Coordination-Free Workload Regularization for Variable-Cost Distributed Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21162)
*Tao Huang,Chen Zhu,Antonio Alonso,Daming Li,Adarsh Goura,Jaideep Ray,Yitong Zhou*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出Batch Cost Lookahead（BCL），一种无需跨rank协调的分布式训练数据加载策略，通过在rank本地滑动窗口内对固定记录数的批次进行成本均衡重排，显著降低变长序列训练中的同步straggler效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在同步数据并行训练中，各rank虽然分配相同记录数，但变长序列导致各rank计算成本差异巨大，形成straggler，使快速rank空闲等待。现有方案（如sequence packing）仅减少批次内padding浪费，不解决跨rank均衡问题；而全局协调方案（如Libra、ODC）需要额外的通信或运行时协调。

Method: BCL采用rank本地数据加载策略：每个worker缓存K个未来批次（即KB条记录）的窗口，将其重新划分为K个固定B条记录的pack，使最大pack成本最小化。算法基于LPT（最长处理时间优先）初始化加heavy-light交换精炼，无需跨rank元数据交换，不修改runtime，同时保持固定记录数接口不变。此外引入单记录不可约性指数η和rank发散指数δ来界定局部调度的能力边界。

Result: 在六种公开长度分布的配对模拟中，BCL将per-rank估计批次成本变异降低81.4%–82.8%；在13个NeMo-RL SFT语料库的8×H200 GPU测试中，BCL相对pooled MFFD获得1.050–1.167×加速；在H200编译执行的多节点（1–4节点）内部Feed工作负载上，相对packed execution获得1.197–1.343×加速。峰值显存降低约9.9%。识别出p99长度上限作为内存可行性边界。

Conclusion: BCL证明大量变长成本不均衡可在数据加载器边界消除，无需跨rank协调。当记录可装入内存且rank窗口总成本相近时效果最佳；超出η≥1的大记录需要cap或改变表示，δ>1则需要reshard或全局协调。

Abstract: Synchronous data-parallel training usually assigns every rank the same number of records, even when record costs vary by orders of magnitude. For variable-length models, this converts input variation into idle time because each step waits for its most expensive rank-local batch. We present Batch Cost Lookahead (BCL), a coordination-free data-loading policy that buffers a bounded rank-local window and repartitions it into fixed-cardinality packs with balanced estimated cost. BCL preserves the trainer's record-count contract and requires neither cross-rank metadata exchange nor runtime modification. In simulation over public workload distributions, enabling BCL reduces per-rank estimated batch-cost variability by up to 82.8%. Across 13 NeMo-RL SFT corpora on eight H200 GPUs, rank-local BCL runs 1.050 to 1.167 times faster than pooled MFFD. Compiled H200 measurements on an internal sequence workload show speedups of 1.197 to 1.343 times over packed execution from one to four nodes. We also identify a memory-feasibility boundary: a p99 cap for high-variance or OOM-prone data bounds outliers before BCL balances the rest. These results show that substantial variable-cost imbalance can be removed at the data-loader boundary, while clarifying when data preparation or broader coordination is still necessary.

</details>


### [421] [When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21500)
*Muhammad Ibrahim*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文LLM推理中远程KV缓存层级可能比GPU重计算更慢的问题,在GLM-5.3 FP8 MoE + MLA模型、8×B300节点、PCP8预分解构部署上进行了系统性研究。提出双项成本模型(盈亏平衡带宽B*=sR≈2.53GB/s与固定开销T0≈0.33s),设计了跨秩分片KV存储、按秩分区的远程层(8实例,GET带宽提升6.3×至10.76GB/s)、异步加载与三项客户端Bug修复,使命中率高的流量的p99从83.32s降至0.67s(124×),并使预填吞吐提升14–34%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产中开启远程KV缓存层级(L2)后,中位TTFT不变但尾部显著恶化(16k工时p99从3.96s升至17.3s),部署被迫回退到仅L1。这暴露了"远程加载KV比GPU重计算便宜"这一隐含假设在当前硬件上的失效——因为单Valkey实例的单线程命令处理无法匹配现代GPU的预填速度,且同步加载在PCP锁步下会把hit-heavy流变成不稳定队列。

Method: 1) 两项成本模型:T_load=T0+ns/B,T_recompute=n/R,推出盈亏带宽B*=sR与最小有效提示长度R·T0≈17k tokens,以及同步加载下ρ=λns/B的队列稳定性判据。2) 跨PCP秩分片MLA KV存储:chunk c由秩c mod W拥有,证明vLLM现有min查询恰好返回最长缓存前缀,加载协议保证所有秩运行相同集合通信序列、不会失同步化;4) 按秩分区的远程层(每秩一个Valkey实例,无协调);5) 异步加载适配分片存储(每秩用cum-length向量报告a_r);6) 修复三项客户端Bug(完成丢失竞争、缺失KEY的GET永不返回、异步GET使用错误KEY)。评估方法:从生产日志回放683请求流,隔离引擎配置(vLLM 0.31.0 + LMCache 0.5.5 + FlashInfer 0.7.0),用450请求的hit-heavy子集(7.35M tokens,98.5%来自L2)作主要对比;Nsight/py-spy剖析;6项"针在草堆"语义测试+并发/浸泡测试。

Result: 主要结果(450请求hit-heavy子集,16k tokens,L2已warm,L1空):H1b(单实例同步)p50=9.70s,p99=83.32s,max=86.72s,GPU利用率7%;H2b(单实例异步但仅rank-0存储)p50=3.20s,p99=3.82s,但仅50.6% tokens来自L2(其余命中3s超时);H4(8实例异步分片)p50=0.41s,p99=0.73s;H5b(加上所有Bug修复)p50=0.40s,p99=0.67s,max=0.86s,98.5%来自L2,GPU利用率22%——较H1b的p99降低124×。远程层带宽:从单实例1.71GB/s提升到8实例10.76GB/s(6.3×)。预填吞吐:8并发~200k prompt,基线43.2k tokens/s;分片存储→49.4k(+14%);+ FlashInfer PR #3969(swiglu+FP8重新量化内核)→57.3–58.0k tokens/s(+34%),AllGather时间从15.8s降到5.8s, rank 0的D2H流量从19.1GB降到2.4GB。模型预测的T0+0.79/1.71=0.79s与实测0.83–0.88s一致。部署(4P+1D,5×B300):成功100%,TTFT P90=30.5s,P50=18.0s,TPM=12.7M(每节点2.55M)。正确性:24/24针检索,0超时0错误,30分钟1549请求无故障。

Conclusion: 在当前GPU上,远程KV缓存层级必须与硬件预填速率竞争:对GLM-5.3 FP8于单B300节点,B*=2.53GB/s,且T0~0.33s使<17k tokens的提示在任何带宽下重计算更优。跨PCP秩静态分片KV存储使远程层可无协调地按秩扩展(scale-out免费),结合客户端Bug修复把hit-heavy p99降低124×;PCP锁步放大一切per-rank故障,context-parallel引擎的设计应保持per-rank工作对称。局限:每条件单次运行(>10%差异才可信)、仅prefill单引擎、单一提示长度桶、T0由单点拟合未直接测长提示阈值、回放使用私有Valkey非共享、生产端到端对比同时改变了并行度。所有更改已上游提交LMCache(分片存储、按秩URL、异步加载、3项客户端Bug修复)。

Abstract: Reusing the attention KV cache across requests is a standard way to cut prefill cost in long-context LLM serving, and production systems increasingly back the per-engine cache with a remote tier shared by every engine. We study such a tier in a disaggregated deployment of GLM-5.3, an FP8 mixture-of-experts model with multi-head latent attention (MLA), on 8xB300 nodes running prefill context parallelism (PCP8). Enabling the remote tier (LMCache with a Valkey store) left median time-to-first-token unchanged but raised the 16k-token p99 from 3.96 s to 17.3 s. Replaying a production request stream on an isolated engine, we find that a remote hit took 0.88 s against 0.31 s to recompute the prompt, and that synchronous loading turned a hit-heavy stream into an unstable queue: p99 83.32 s with the GPUs 7% busy. A two-term cost model explains both: a hit pays off only if the tier delivers more than B* = sR (2.53 GB/s for this model and GPU), and a fixed per-hit engine cost (T0 ~ 0.33 s) means that hits on prompts shorter than about 17k tokens cannot beat recompute at any bandwidth. Guided by the model, we (i) shard the MLA KV store across PCP ranks, with a proof that the existing minimum-over-ranks lookup returns the longest cached prefix and a load protocol that can never desynchronize collectives; (ii) partition the remote tier by rank, one server instance per rank with no coordination, which raises GET bandwidth 6.3x to 10.76 GB/s; (iii) add asynchronous loading to the sharded store; and (iv) fix three client bugs that caused unbounded stalls. On the hit-heavy stream, with 98.5% of prompt tokens served from the remote tier, p99 falls from 83.32 s to 0.67 s. The sharded store raises prefill throughput by 14%, and by 34% together with an upstream kernel fix. All changes are submitted upstream to LMCache.

</details>


### [422] [Exact Makespan Bounds and the GPipe Homogeneity Bias for Heterogeneous LLM Inference Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21815)
*Zhu Wenbo*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对异构GPU集群上的LLM推理微批次流水线，给出了三种通信模式下makespan的精确闭式解，定量刻画了经典GPipe同构公式的偏差来源，并提供了可计算的真实系统性能上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典GPipe公式假设流水线各阶段同构（τ_j 全相等），但实际推理部署中常混合多代GPU（如RTX 5090/3090/GTX 1070共存的集群），且通信延迟非零。在10×甚至1000×的异构度下，同构公式的偏差巨大（如M=1时高估166.7%），而现有LLM服务文献缺乏异构流水线makespan的精确刻画。

Method: 采用关键路径（critical-path）夹逼法（sandwich），通过证明下界与可达上界吻合，推导出三种通信设置下的makespan closed forms：
- 定理1（无通信）：T(M) = (M-1)τ_max + Σ_j τ_j
- 定理2（异步通信）：T(M) = Σ_j τ_j + Σ_j d_j + (M-1)τ_max
- 定理3（阻塞通信）：T(M) = (M-1)σ_max + Σ_s σ_s，其中σ_s = τ_s + d_s
并推导出偏差分解、相变条件和异步-阻塞夹逼界。所有公式通过11个手工配置 + 1.6×10^5随机模糊测试点验证，相对误差<10^-9。

Result: 1. 经典GPipe同构公式的系统性偏差被精确量化为常数 Σ_j(τ_max - τ_j)，与M无关，是一次性填充代价而非吞吐惩罚；2. 异步通信延迟T_j仅以加性常数出现，不改变稳态斜率τ_max；3. 阻塞通信下，当某d_s > τ_max - τ_s时，通信从加性常数跃变为吞吐瓶颈（相变）；5. 真实部分重叠系统的makespan被夹逼于T_async ≤ T_real ≤ T_block，重叠收益上界为(M-1)(σ_max - τ_max)。生产集群数据（8,571个真实请求）验证了偏差方向与夹逼方向。基于此，给出优化规则：先均衡计算（最小化τ_max），再优化通信。

Conclusion: 异构LLM推理流水线的makespan具有简洁的闭式表达，GPipe同构公式的偏差可精确量化；核心优化优先级是均衡各阶段计算（而非优化链路），因为稳态吞吐仅由τ_max决定。带带宽限制通信、有界缓冲区和prefill-decode交错是自然的开放问题。

Abstract: We give an exact critical-path characterization of the makespan of micro-batch pipelines serving LLMs on heterogeneous GPU clusters, quantifying how the classic homogeneous GPipe formula errs. In the pure-forward, communication-free, infinite-buffer setting, T(M) = (M-1)tau_max + Sum_j tau_j, where tau_j is stage j's per-micro-batch service time and M the micro-batch count (Theorem 1). Under asynchronous communication -- modern NCCL-based serving -- it extends to T(M) = Sum_j tau_j + Sum_j d_j + (M-1)tau_max, with Sum_j d_j a purely additive constant (Theorem 2); under blocking communication, T(M) = (M-1)sigma_max + Sum_s sigma_s with sigma_s = tau_s + d_s, so communication enters the steady-state slope iff some d_s > tau_max - tau_s (Theorem 3). These results quantify the GPipe overestimate, decompose the bias into a homogeneity term Sum_j (tau_max - tau_j) and a communication-ignoring term Sum_j d_j, and imply that balancing per-stage compute dominates communication reduction for steady-state throughput. A real system with partial overlap is sandwiched between Theorems 2 and 3, with a closed-form bound on the overlap throughput gain. All claims are validated pointwise (error < 10^-9) on eleven configurations and a 1.6x10^5-point fuzz, including a mixed RTX 5090/3090/GTX 1070 partition. We situate the results in flow-shop scheduling and list open extensions: bandwidth-limited communication, bounded buffers, prefill-decode interleaving.

</details>


### [423] [Resource-aware Sub-network Allocation for Heterogeneous Decentralized Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22015)
*Zhuojun Tian,Ming Xiao,Mikael Skoglund*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 RASA-DL，一个面向异构去中心化学习的资源感知子网络分配框架，通过离线硬件和学习效用剖析，结合瓶颈延迟最小化问题与二分搜索算法，为各节点分配合适的子网络容量，在异构系统中实现精度-延迟的灵活权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在同步去中心化学习中，计算、通信和内存的系统异构性会导致由资源受限节点决定训练轮次的瓶颈问题。现有方法缺乏对节点特定模型容量与部署资源之间联合配置的全面支持，因此需要一种能在部署阶段根据异构资源为每个节点分配合适模型容量的方法。

Method: 1. 离线构建嵌套紧凑子网络族：基于父模型学习通道排序，通过前缀选择生成可执行嵌套子网络。2. 部署感知学习效能剖析：在轻量级参考去中心化环境中评估每个候选宽度的学习效用。3. 硬件资源剖析：测量各子网络的训练延迟和峰值内存。4. 将子网络分配建模为同步瓶颈延迟最小化问题，受每节点内存约束和聚合学习效用约束。利用延迟阈值的单调可行性，通过基于二分搜索的算法高效求解。5. 嵌套紧凑去中心化训练：各节点按分配的保留率初始化，按嵌套宽度采样策略进行局部训练，并按参数块进行重叠感知的去中心化聚合。

Result: 在 Moderate 和 Severe 资源异构条件下，RASA-DL 的最小延迟运行点（RASA-DL-A）在相同模型化轮延迟下，比最大全局可行的均匀部署准确率分别提升 2.80 和 2.43 个百分点。在 Non-IID 数据异构性较强时优势进一步放大（如 α=0.1 时提升 18.68 个百分点）。方法在 CIFAR-100 上同样有效，且部署感知剖析优于独立剖析。CIFAR-10 上最高准确率达 93.02%，CIFAR-100 上达 67.16%。

Conclusion: RASA-DL 框架通过离线剖析引导的子网络分配，在异构去中心化学习系统中实现了有利的精度-延迟权衡。其核心价值在于：当全局可行均匀宽度受限于最弱节点时，将资源丰富节点的未利用容量转化为可配置的精度-延迟权衡，而非强制整个系统运行在最弱节点的能力水平上。未来工作将考虑时变资源条件和在线模型容量自适应，以及子网络分配与去中心化通信策略的联合优化。

Abstract: System heterogeneity in computation, communication, and memory can substantially limit synchronous decentralized learning, where each training round is constrained by resource-limited nodes. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly determining node-specific model capacities from deployment resources. We propose RASA-DL, a resource-aware sub-network allocation framework that treats the maximum sub-network width assigned to each node as a deployment variable. RASA-DL combines offline hardware profiling of computation and memory costs with deployment-aware profiling of learning utility under heterogeneous decentralized training. Using these profiles together with node- and link-level resource information, we formulate deployment as a bottleneck-latency minimization problem subject to per-node memory constraints and a required aggregate learning utility. Exploiting the monotone feasibility of the latency threshold, RASA-DL efficiently identifies the deployment through a binary-search-based allocation procedure. Experiments under controlled resource heterogeneity demonstrate favorable accuracy--latency tradeoffs. Under the Moderate and Severe regimes, the minimum-latency operating point improves accuracy over the largest globally feasible uniform deployment by 2.80 and 2.43 percentage points, respectively, at the same modeled round latency. The advantage is further amplified under strong Non-IID data heterogeneity.

</details>


### [424] [ETH: Data-Balanced Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism for Training Large Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22035)
*Mianjie Yu,Zhongmin Zhao,Zizhao Mo,Jianxiong Liao,Wenxuan Li,Yulin Qiao,Huanle Xu,Wenquan Yang,Yongqiang Yang,Zeren Li,Ruifeng Tang,Chengzhong Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: ETH提出了一种数据均衡的异构流水线并行训练系统，通过HPP范式和分层负载均衡框架，在处理异构加速器集群时实现高达2倍的训练加速，并将配置生成开销降低最多56倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异构训练系统主要通过在各流水线阶段间分配不等的层数（层均衡）来平衡负载，但该策略面临内存约束瓶颈和粗粒度问题——现代加速器计算能力增长（约16倍）远快于内存增长（不足5倍），导致计算与内存能力不匹配；同时受限于模型层数有限，层均衡难以实现细粒度负载分配，造成高达32%的算力闲置和16%的额外流水线气泡。

Method: ETH系统围绕异构流水线并行（HPP）新范式构建，包含三大核心组件：(1) 分层负载均衡框架——三阶段启发式策略，先用全局批次大小初始化阶段配置，再为各流水线分配不同的本地批次大小以平衡跨流水线负载，最后用更新后的本地批次精炼阶段配置；(2) 分块All-Reduce通信——通过梯度分块与组合解决地址错位和大小不一致问题，并融合相同通信组的块以减少All-Reduce操作；(3) 四种搜索加速优化——流水线缓存避免重复子问题优化、基于二部图匹配和吞吐量缩放的早期剪枝、基于成本函数的优先级搜索排序、以及将搜索复杂度从指数级降至O(N³)多项式时间的动态规划。

Result: 在Ascend 910B2/B3/B4 NPU集群和NVIDIA A100/RTX 3090 GPU集群上对GPT-3（350M-175B）和LLaMA-2 70B进行评估：相比HexiScale实现1.36-2.00倍训练加速，相比Metis实现1.20-1.84倍加速；配置生成时间相比HexiScale减少1.35-17.74倍，相比Metis最多减少56倍；分块All-Reduce相比张量级和设备级分别获得1.38-1.71倍和1.56-2.74倍通信加速；模型收敛曲线与基线几乎一致（差异约0.1%），在大规模集群（128设备）和大序列长度（8192）下保持良好可扩展性。

Conclusion: ETH通过引入数据均衡的异构流水线并行范式，显著扩展了异构环境下的并行训练搜索空间，在大幅降低配置搜索开销的同时实现了更高的训练效率，证明了HPP范式在异构集群上训练大模型的有效性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Current heterogeneity-aware training systems for large models balance workloads by assigning unequal numbers of layers across pipeline stages, a strategy aimed at equalizing execution time through a unique pipeline configuration. However, this approach fails to address critical memory constraints and suffers from inherently coarse balancing granularity. In this paper, we propose Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism (HPP), a novel approach enabling efficient and fine-grained data balance across heterogeneous pipelines. To address HPP's key challenges, prohibitive search overhead for optimal configurations and high communication overhead from asymmetric All-Reduce, we design the ETH training system. ETH employs a hierarchical workload balance framework that jointly optimizes balance across heterogeneous pipelines and within individual pipeline stages. To mitigate asymmetric communication costs, ETH implements block-wise gradient aggregation. Furthermore, it integrates specialized optimizations that dramatically reduce HPP configuration search overhead. Evaluations demonstrate ETH achieves up to 2x training speedup while reducing configuration generation overhead by up to 56x compared to state-of-the-art systems. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [425] [Efficient KV Cache Migration for Geo-Distributed LLM Inference in Collaborative Edge Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22172)
*Mingjin Zhang,Jiannong Cao,Tao Wu,Xiangchun Chen,Ne Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文提出EdgeFlow系统，针对协作边缘计算(CEC)环境下地理分布式LLM推理中的KV缓存迁移问题，设计了混合迁移策略（直接传输+基于激活的重计算），通过优化目标节点选择与计算通信流水线调度，将迁移时间最高减少45%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中心化云端LLM推理存在带宽成本高、隐私风险等问题；边缘部署受限于单服务器算力，而协作边缘计算(CEC)将LLM分片部署在多个地理分布式边缘服务器上。当边缘服务器过载或断连时，必须迁移有状态的KV缓存以维持推理连续性。云端方法（直接跨GPU传输、token级重计算）因带宽受限、硬件资源有限而不适用。

Method: 1. 设计混合迁移机制：前p层采用基于激活的KV重计算（传输50%数据量，但需额外计算），剩余层采用直接传输，并通过并行流水线重叠计算与通信；2. 证明两个定理——最优调度为"先传激活"，且决策等价于确定分割层数p；3. 形式化多节点KV迁移优化问题(MN-KVM)，目标为最小化K个源节点最大迁移时间，受目标节点内存约束；4. 问题分解：先固定迁移策略{X_{k,n}}用遍历法求最优分割点P_k（子问题P2，复杂度O(N·L_k)），再求解目标节点选择子问题P3（NP-hard）；5. 基于LP松弛(P3-R)和极端点解构造2-近似算法，结合二分搜索得到总体O(log K + log T_max)迭代复杂度；6. 对分数变量构造二部图并求完美匹配完成整数化。

Result: 在PolyLink真实分布式平台（连接100+消费级GPU）和大规模仿真上测试Qwen2.5-32B与LLama3.1-70B：相比直接KV传输(DKV)、纯激活重计算(ACT)、贪心版EdgeFlow-G，迁移时间最高降低45%（如Qwen2.5-32B异构目标节点Env. C中比DKV快45.8%）；在不同带宽（100-900Mbps）、不同token长度（32-512）、异构源/目标节点配置下均显著优于基线；与暴力搜索(BF)性能接近但开销大幅减少（325分钟 vs 3.22秒）。

Conclusion: EdgeFlow是首个面向协作边缘计算中地理分布式LLM推理的混合KV缓存迁移方案，通过整合基于激活的重计算与直接传输，配合2-近似近似算法，有效利用异构边缘资源与有限带宽，将迁移时间最多减少45%，增强了分布式LLM推理的鲁棒性与效率。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown exceptional capabilities but rely heavily on centralized cloud GPU clusters, leading to high bandwidth costs, latency, and privacy issues. Edge computing offers a solution by deploying LLMs closer to users on edge servers, yet single edge servers often cannot meet LLMs' heavy computational demands. Collaborative Edge Computing (CEC) addresses this challenge by integrating resources of multiple geo-distributed heterogeneous edge servers, which jointly host small model shards and associated Key-Value (KV) cache for distributed inference. However, edge servers may disconnect or easily become overloaded, making it essential to migrate stateful KV cache to other servers for ensuring continuous service. Existing cloud-based KV cache management methods, such as direct cross-GPUs transmission and recomputation from input tokens are ill-suited for bandwidth-constrained and resource-limited edge environments. In this work, we propose EdgeFlow, a novel hybrid KV cache migration scheme that integrates direct KV cache transmission with activation-based recomputation, leveraging parallel computation and communication to minimize migration time. On this basis, we formulate a multi-node KV migration optimization problem and design a 2-approximation algorithm based on improved linear programming relaxation and bipartite graph techniques. Extensive experiments on a real-world distributed LLM inference platform demonstrate that EdgeFlow reduces migration time by up to 45%, significantly enhancing the robustness and efficiency of distributed LLM inference in collaborative edge computing.

</details>


### [426] [Architecting for Hardware Diversity: Meta's End-to-End Co-Design for High-Performance AI Training on AMD GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22230)
*Haoyu Zhang,Arshad Rahman,Adnan Aziz,Ajith Prabhudev,Amin Farmahini,Ben Rhoads,Benson Ma,Brian Shi,Cen Zhao,CK Luk,Dingming Wu,Emad El-Haraty,Eric Chen,Frank Li,Gary Huang,Gefei Zuo,Haoran Zhang,Hiwot Kassa,Hongyi Zeng,Jack Taylor,Jeremy Hadidjojo,John Donati,Jonathan Sheffield,Julio Machado Silva,Karthik Ganesan,Kent Russell,KR Kishore,Lei Tian,Liu Ke,Muhammad Osama,Peng Chen,Rakesh Hemnani,Ryan Swann,Saleel Kudchadker,Shankar Yanamandram,Shobhit Kanaujia,Shucai Xiao,Srinath Bayareddy,Srinivas Vaidyanathan,Sudharssun Subramanian,Supadchaya Puangpontip,Taylor Robie,Tianhao Huang,Tyler Hart,Viswesh Sankaran,Weijun Jiang,Wenkai Du,Xiaodong Wang,Xiaohu Guo,Yao Rong,Yinbin Ma,Yue Dong,Yuzhen Huang,Yvonne Liu,Zhan Shu,Dan Rabinovitsj,Ajit Mathews,Chunqiang Tang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Meta 提出首个超大规模 AMD GPU 生产训练报告，通过硬件-模型协同设计、Origami 分析性能模型和代理式 AI 工作流三大原则，在 AMD MI350X 上实现与 NVIDIA B200 相当的 DLRM 训练吞吐量（几何平均 101.2%），并已向上游 PyTorch、Triton 和 ROCm 开源生态贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Meta 部署异构 GPU 集群（NVIDIA + AMD + 自研 MTIA）以降低成本并避免供应商锁定，但 NVIDIA 特定的深度优化阻碍了性能可移植性；DLRM 因模型架构多样、矩阵形状不规则、内存访问模式复杂，迁移难度尤甚。

Method: 三大可复用原则：(1) 硬件-模型协同设计——利用 MI350X 比 B200 多 1.6× 的 HBM 容量，扩大 batch、移除激活检查点、优化并行与嵌入分片；(2) Origami 分析性能模型——通过层级内存-计算循环建模，在微秒级零预热选出最优 GEMM tile 配置，精度达离线 autotune 的 93%；(3) 代理式 AI 工作流——将微架构感知调优编码为可复用技能，自动处理 PID swizzle、occupancy hint、MFMA 配置、原子操作的树归约等。

Result: 相比直接移植基线，端到端训练吞吐提升最高 1.5×；10 个生产模型几何平均达 B200 的 101.2%；Origami 在多矩阵形状上达 93% autotune 效率；GDPA 前向 2.5×、HSTU 前向 3.22×、TBE 反向 1.87–3.32×、原子优化边界检查 4×。MI350X 在手写 Triton 核与嵌入操作上具优势，但 GEMM 因 TF32 模拟与 hipBLAS 成熟度仍落后 B200 1.3–1.7×。

Conclusion: MI350X 通过跨栈系统级优化达到 B200 生产级训练性能，证明多供应商 AI 基础设施可行；三大原则（协同设计、分析建模、代理工作流）可推广至 MTIA 及 LLM 等更广泛工作负载；优化已开源回馈 PyTorch/Triton/ROCm 生态。

Abstract: Meta deploys a heterogeneous fleet comprising NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and proprietary MTIA accelerators to reduce costs and mitigate vendor lock-in. However, the extensive history of NVIDIA-specific optimizations hinders performance portability to other hardware. This paper presents our methods for optimizing alternative accelerators, using AMD Instinct MI350X versus NVIDIA B200 for recommendation model training as a case study. We propose three reusable principles. First, hardware-model co-design is essential: rather than directly porting models from NVIDIA GPUs, revising model structures and software recipes allows full exploitation of accelerator-specific strengths (e.g., MI350X's 1.6x HBM capacity relative to B200). Second, our analytical performance model enables zero-warmup optimal kernel selection across diverse datatypes and matrix shapes in production models, drastically simplifying tuning. Third, increasingly mature agentic workflows have lowered the barrier to porting from the CUDA ecosystem; we extend these workflows for microarchitecture-aware kernel optimizations and custom shim generation. Compared to the directly ported baseline, these methods deliver up to 1.5x improvement in end-to-end training throughput. To our knowledge, this is the first hyperscaler report on productionizing AMD GPUs for large-scale training. Our contributions have been upstreamed to the open-source PyTorch, Triton, and ROCm ecosystems.

</details>

### [427] [Subset Sum in Almost-Linear Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20742)
*Ce Jin,Xiao Mao*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We give a deterministic algorithm for finding a subset of the input integers $1\le a_1,\ldots,a_n \le \Delta$ that sums to the target $t$ in $\mathcal{O}(n+\Delta^{1+o(1)})$ time. This improves upon the previous $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(n + \Delta^{1.5})$-time algorithm by Chen, Lian, Mao, and Zhang (SODA 2024), and achieves almost tight dependence on $\Delta$ assuming SETH. We use an inverse theorem for subset sums due to Conlon, Fox, and Pham (2023), and develop a quotient variant of economic cap covering from the polytope approximation literature.

This improves upon the previous $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(n + \Delta^{1.5})$-time algorithm by Chen, Lian, Mao, and Zhang (SODA 2024), and achieves almost tight dependence on $\Delta$ assuming SETH. ### [428] [Eccentricity Shortest Path: the structural parameter landscape](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20769)
*Anand Babu,Ashwin Jacob,Hitendra Kumar,R. B. Sandeep*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The Eccentricity Shortest Path problem asks, given a connected graph and a nonnegative integer $R$, whether some shortest path is within distance $R$ of every vertex. We study its structural parameterized complexity. We give fixed-parameter algorithms for vertex-deletion distance to cographs, vertex-deletion distance to interval graphs, and bandwidth. The interval-deletion result answers a question of Bhyravarapu et al. (IWOCA 2023). We obtain XP algorithms for vertex-deletion distance to chordal graphs, clique-width, and rank-width, without requiring expressions or decompositions for the latter two. Consequently, the problem is polynomial-time solvable for every fixed treewidth, answering a question of Chakraborty et al. (2026). We also derive fixed-parameter tractability for treedepth and XP membership for diameter from earlier algorithms. We prove $\mathsf{W}[3]$-hardness for cutwidth, and hence pathwidth and treewidth, even on graphs of maximum degree at most five; $\mathsf{W}[2]$-hardness for vertex clique-cover number; and NP-hardness on graphs of tree-independence number at most two. For maximum leaf number $\ell$, we obtain an $O(\ell^4)$-bit compression and a polynomial kernel. Finally, unless $\mathsf{NP}\subseteq\mathrm{coNP}/\mathrm{poly}$, we exclude polynomial kernels for bandwidth, feedback edge number, vertex-deletion distance to a clique, and vertex cover number. The last bound also excludes polynomial kernels for vertex-deletion distance to proper interval graphs.

Abstract: The Eccentricity Shortest Path problem asks, given a connected graph and a nonnegative integer $R$, whether some shortest path is within distance $R$ of every vertex. We study its structural parameterized complexity. We give fixed-parameter algorithms for vertex-deletion distance to cographs, vertex-deletion distance to interval graphs, and bandwidth. The interval-deletion result answers a question of Bhyravarapu et al. (IWOCA 2023). We obtain XP algorithms for vertex-deletion distance to chordal graphs, clique-width, and rank-width, without requiring expressions or decompositions for the latter two. Consequently, the problem is polynomial-time solvable for every fixed treewidth, answering a question of Chakraborty et al. (2026). We also derive fixed-parameter tractability for treedepth and XP membership for diameter from earlier algorithms. ### [429] [Tolerant Testers for Subgraph-Freeness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20813)
*Reut Levi,Jonathan Meiri*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In this paper we study the problem of tolerantly testing the property of being $H$-free (which also implies distance approximation from being $H$-free). In the general-graphs model, we show that tolerant $K_k$-freeness testing can be achieved with query complexity that is polynomial in the arboricity of the input graph $G$, $arb(G)$, and independent of the size of $G$ (for graphs in which the average degree is $\Omega(1))$. Specifically for triangles, our algorithm distinguishes graphs which are $\epsilon$-close to being triangle-free from graphs that are $3\epsilon(1+\eta)$-far from being triangle-free with expected query complexity which is $\tilde{O}(arb^3(G))$ (for constant $\eta$ and $\epsilon$). For general $k$-cliques our algorithm distinguishes graphs which are $\epsilon$-close to being $K_k$-free from graphs which are ${k \choose 2}\epsilon(1+\eta)$-far from being $K_k$-free with expected query complexity which is polynomial in $k$, $1/\epsilon$, $1/\eta$ and $arb(G)$. We then generalize our result and provide a similar result for any motif $H$ which is $2$-connected and has radius $1$. This includes for example the wheel graph. Finally, we show that our tester can be applied to the bounded-degree model for tolerantly testing $H$-freeness for any motif $H$. The query complexity of the algorithm is polynomial in the degree bound, $d$, improving the previous state-of-the-art by Marko and Ron (TALG 2009) that obtained quasi-polynomial query complexity in $d$.

### [430] [Near-Linear Preprocessing for Range Weighted Longest Increasing Subsequence Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20983)
*Keisuke Korogi*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We give a deterministic data structure for range weighted longest increasing subsequence (LIS) queries on $n$ values with positive weights. Preprocessing takes $O(n\log^2 n)$ time and space. Value queries take $O(\log n)$ time, and an optimal subsequence of $k$ elements can be reported in $O(k + \log n)$ time. This resolves an open question on truly subquadratic preprocessing with polylogarithmic query time. The key is a single-crossing property of envelopes for value-separated endpoint sets, enabling $O(\log n)$-time persistent merges. The bounds assume constant-time exact addition and comparison of weights.

### [431] [The Komlós Problem in Matrix-Multiplication Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20995)
*Emile Anand,Peter Chen*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We give a randomized algorithm that, for an $m\times n$ matrix whose columns have Euclidean norm at most one, finds a signing with discrepancy below $99$ in expected $\widetilde O(L_{\mathrm{in}}+n^\omega)$ bit operations, where $L_{\mathrm{in}}$ is the input encoding length and $\omega$ is the exponent of matrix multiplication. The previous fastest algorithm with a constant discrepancy bound, due to Li, is deterministic and uses $O(mn+n^{\omega+2}\log^3 n)$ arithmetic operations. We build on the spectral signing framework of Guo, Fang, and Lu and of Li, which rounds a single fractional coloring while one spectral potential controls every row. Li's potential tracks a top eigenvalue, and the gap below that eigenvalue, which can be of order $1/n$, limits the length of every step. We replace it with a resolvent potential that is smooth without any gap condition, and we draw step signs at random, so that the potential only needs to be concave while progress is measured separately. Our key insight is to reuse a single subspace of directions throughout a batch of steps, thereby using only one spectral computation, so that the more expensive linear algebraic operations are paid for only polylogarithmically often at each scale. Within a batch, we sample directions from a Gaussian completion matrix whose inverse we maintain under rank-one row replacements. Finally, we use a finite-precision analysis to prove stability of the algorithm and attain the bit-complexity bound.

### [432] [A 0.4584-approximation for DR-submodular maximization over down-closed convex sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21072)
*Donglei Du*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We obtain a $0.4584$-approximation for nonnegative, non-monotone, $L$-smooth DR-submodular maximization over compact convex down-closed subsets of the unit cube, improving the $4/9\approx0.4444$ ratio of Aggarwal's projection-based algorithm~\cite{aggarwal2026geometry}. A recovery map combining exponential and linear-fractional branches admits a cube-wide affine upper bound. The resulting continuous-time Frank--Wolfe-type algorithm with randomized output and its randomized discrete-time implementation both satisfy $\E F(\widehat x)\ge(0.4584-\varepsilon)\OPT-\delta LD^2$; the implementation uses polynomially many cube-wide value/full-gradient queries and ordinary linear maximization calls, where $D$ is the feasible diameter and $\varepsilon,\delta>0$ are accuracy parameters. Our guarantee and Aggarwal's hardness bound~\cite{aggarwal2026geometry} place the optimal approximation ratio for cube-wide value/full-gradient queries and linear maximization, with additive error $\delta LD^2$, in $[0.4584,0.4705)$. Standard multilinear sampling and pipage rounding imply an expected $(0.4584-\varepsilon)$-approximation for nonnegative submodular set-function maximization under a matroid constraint \cite[Lemma B.3]{vondrak2013symmetry}.

### [433] [A General Framework for Matching with Delays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21285)
*Sara Ahmadian,Shuchi Chawla,Ravi Kumar,Manish Purohit,Shirley Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We present a simple deterministic $O(\log n)$-competitive algorithm for the online minimum-cost perfect matching with delays (MPMD) problem on arbitrary, unknown metric spaces, where $n$ is the (unknown) number of requests. This improves upon the recent $O(\log^5 n)$-competitive algorithm of Dufay and Wattenhofer (SODA 2026) and nearly matches the $\Omega(\log n / \log \log n)$ randomized lower bound of Ashlagi et al. (APPROX 2017). Our algorithmic framework rests on two ingredients: an online moat-growing process that grows active dual variables at a deliberately slowed constant rate $\alpha < 1$ to control temporal asymmetry, and a delayed eligibility rule that matches requests in the same dual component only after their waiting time is proportional to their time-expanded distance. The framework extends naturally to arbitrary concave delay functions, maintaining an $O(\log n)$ competitive ratio, and to $k$-way matching with delays, yielding an $O(k \log n)$-competitive deterministic algorithm.

### [434] [Testing Connectedness and Edge Connectedness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21299)
*Diptaksho Palit,Ramesh Krishnan S. Pallavoor,Sofya Raskhodnikova,Nithin Varma*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We revisit the classical problem of testing connectedness of graphs represented in the adjacency lists model and obtain optimal bounds. Specifically, we show that $\varepsilon$-testing connectedness of graphs with maximum degree at most $d$ requires $\Omega(\frac{1}{\varepsilon} \log \frac{1}{\varepsilon d})$ queries (when $\varepsilon \le \frac{1}{4d^5}$). Our result implies that the connectedness tester of Levi, Pallavoor, Raskhodnikova, and Varma ({\em ACM Trans.\ Comput.\ Theory, 2022}) is optimal. We also study the problem of testing $k$-edge-connectedness of both directed and undirected graphs of average degree $\overline{d}$ in the adjacency lists model and design a tester with query complexity $O(\frac{k}{\varepsilon} \log \frac{1}{\varepsilon \overline{d}})$, improving upon the bounds by Forster, Nanongkai, Saranurak, Yang, and Yingchareonthawornchai (SODA 2020). Furthermore, we complement our upper bound by showing that every one-sided error $k$-edge-connectedness tester must make $\Omega(k/\varepsilon)$ queries.

### [435] [Geometric Hashing in MPC with Applications to Clustering and Stochastic Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21371)
*Sujoy Bhore,Arnold Filter,Eunjin Oh,Hyeonjun Shin,Himanshi Singh*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In this paper we study consistent hashing (a.k.a. sparse partitions) for doubling metrics in the Massively Parallel Computation (MPC) model. A $(\Gamma,\Lambda)$-hash with diameter bound $\Delta$ partitions a metric space into clusters of diameter at most $\Delta$ such that every ball of radius $\Delta/\Gamma$ intersects at most $\Lambda$ clusters in expectation. Consistent hashing has emerged as a central tool in geometric MPC algorithms. However, so far it has been solely used in Euclidean spaces, where it can be pre-computed. On the other hand, in cases where the metric space is received as input and unknown in advance, no previous parallel construction was known. We present the first fully scalable MPC algorithm over machines with local space $n^\sigma$, that given an $n$-point metric space with doubling dimension $d\leq O(\sigma \log n)$, samples a randomized $(\Gamma,2^{O(d/\Gamma)})$-hash in $O(d/\sigma^3)$ rounds. There is a dichotomy: if the doubling dimension is $d=\Omega(\sigma\cdot\log n)$, a polynomial number of rounds is required to compute such a hash. We conclude by showing that this MPC primitive yields $O(d/\sigma^3)$-round fully scalable MPC algorithms for a broad class of fundamental geometric problems in doubling metrics, including stochastic tree embeddings with $O(\log n)$ expected distortion, constant factor approximation for facility location, bicriteria $(O(\epsilon^{-2}),1+\epsilon)$-approximation for $k$-median and $k$-means.

### [436] [Decoding Failure Biases IBLT Count Measurements: A Gaussian-Selection Law at the Peeling Threshold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21418)
*Min Wu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In a self-sizing set-reconciliation protocol, a small first-round Invertible Bloom Lookup Table (IBLT) sketch attempts peeling decoding; after failure, the protocol estimates the difference count $d$ from the count energy and sizes the second round from a lower quantile of the measurement. This quantile must be computed conditionally on failure: the measurement and peeling success are determined by the same random mapping, so conditioning can shift the measurement law. In the ideal peeling model, inside the critical window where failure has nondegenerate probability, the standardized energy and a statistic of the unsigned mapping that governs the peeling outcome (the precritical score) have a joint Gaussian limit with correlation $\eta_k\rho^2$, $\rho$ being the sign imbalance and $\eta_k$ a closed-form constant. The measurement conditional on failure is thus a bivariate normal truncated to a half-plane, which we call the Gaussian-selection law. Since $\eta_k$ changes sign between $k=4$ and $k=5$, under one-sided imbalance the unconditional threshold undercovers exactly when $k\ge5$ and is conservative for $k=3,4$. The key tool is a quenched CLT for a signed quadratic form on a random overlap graph; under asymptotically balanced signs, conditioning on any unsigned mapping event that is permutation-invariant and has probability bounded away from zero leaves the standard normal limit unchanged. After failure the protocol observes the total sign; inverting the selection law yields an upper confidence bound for $d$, asymptotically conservative in the critical window and, when $d/\sqrt M\to\infty$, along the whole load axis. The experiments use analytic constants, none fitted; the unconditional threshold carries a selection error that does not vanish with scale, while the corrected selection-law threshold matches per-configuration empirical quantiles.

### [437] [Incremental Exact Vertex Connectivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21531)
*Felix Adena,Monika Henzinger,Christoph Kern,Daniel Rutschmann*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study the problem of maintaining the vertex connectivity $\kappa$ of a graph under edge insertions. For undirected graphs, our algorithm uses $O(\kappa^4 \log^2 n)$ amortized time per edge insertion. After each edge insertion, the algorithm outputs the current value of $\kappa$, plus a set of $\kappa$ vertices whose removal disconnects the graph. Our algorithm is Monte-Carlo randomized and works with a randomness-adaptive adversary. The algorithm also works on directed graphs against an oblivious adversary, which is equivalent to an output-adaptive adversary if we only have to output the current value of $\kappa$. Previously, algorithms for maintaining the vertex connectivity with $o(n)$ time per edge insertion were only known for $\kappa \le 2$, and need $\tilde{O}(\log^2 n)$ and $O(\sqrt{n})$ time per edge insertion for $\kappa = 1,2$, respectively. Moreover, for $\kappa > 4$, no algorithm faster than recomputation from scratch was known. We complement our algorithm with a conditional lower bound: Under the OMv conjecture, any insertions-only algorithm that outputs the current value of $\kappa$ after every insertion needs $\Omega(n^{1-\varepsilon})$ amortized time per edge insertion for $\kappa = \Theta(n)$. Previous conditional lower bounds for this problem only apply to worst case running time, or algorithms that support both edge insertions and edge deletions.

### [438] [Preprocessed 3SUM: From Reals to Integers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21961)
*Nick Fischer,Jonas Schmidt*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The Preprocessed 3SUM problem asks to preprocess a set $A$ of $n$ numbers so that we can quickly decide whether a query subset $A' \subseteq A$ contains a solution $a+b=c$. The best known query bounds differ substantially between integer and real inputs. For integers, a series of advances with near-quadratic preprocessing reduced the query time from $\tilde O(n^{13/7})$ [Chan, Lewenstein; STOC '15] to $\tilde O(n^{11/6})$ [Chan, Vassilevska W., Xu; STOC '23], and finally to $\tilde O(n^{3/2})$ [Kasliwal, Polak, Sharma; SOSA '25]. For reals, only the first of these bounds has been achieved, by adapting the corresponding integer algorithm [Fischer; SODA '25]. Is this gap inherent to the more limited tools available for real inputs? We give a randomized real-to-integer reduction with $\tilde O(n^2)$ preprocessing overhead and no asymptotic increase in query time. This yields $\tilde O(n^2)$ preprocessing and $\tilde O(n^{3/2})$ query time for real inputs, closing the gap. We show how to extend our result to the setting where one set is unknown at preprocessing time. Our reduction is conceptually simple, and relies on an interesting technical toolkit around old and new tools from sparse linear algebra. More broadly, it suggests a route to real-to-integer reductions for other additive problems.

For integers, a series of advances with near-quadratic preprocessing reduced the query time from $\tilde O(n^{13/7})$ [Chan, Lewenstein; STOC '15] to $\tilde O(n^{11/6})$ [Chan, Vassilevska W., Xu; STOC '23], and finally to $\tilde O(n^{3/2})$ [Kasliwal, Polak, Sharma; SOSA '25]. For reals, only the first of these bounds has been achieved, by adapting the corresponding integer algorithm [Fischer; SODA '25]. Is this gap inherent to the more limited tools available for real inputs? We give a randomized real-to-integer reduction with $\tilde O(n^2)$ preprocessing overhead and no asymptotic increase in query time. This yields $\tilde O(n^2)$ preprocessing and $\tilde O(n^{3/2})$ query time for real inputs, closing the gap. We show how to extend our result to the setting where one set is unknown at preprocessing time. Our reduction is conceptually simple, and relies on an interesting technical toolkit around old and new tools from sparse linear algebra. More broadly, it suggests a route to real-to-integer reductions for other additive problems.

</details>


### [439] [Parameterized Complexity of Isometric Path Cover: Treewidth and Diameter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22010)
*Dibyayan Chakraborty,Oscar Defrain,Florent Foucaud,Mathieu Mari,Prafullkumar Tale*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study the fixed-parameter tractability of the \textsc{Isometric Path Cover} problem where, given an integer $k$ and a simple, undirected, and unweighted graph $G$, the objective is to decide whether $G$ admits a set of $k$ isometric paths (i.e., shortest paths between their endpoints) whose union is the entire vertex set of $G$. We show that \textsc{Isometric Path Cover} is NP-hard on graphs of pathwidth (and thus treewidth) at most 287. This is an interesting contrast with the closely related problems \textsc{Isometric Path Partition} and \textsc{Path Cover}, which are both known to be XP for treewidth, see [Chakraborty et al., WG 2026] and [Foucaud et al., TCS 2026]. On the positive side, we show, by a suitable dynamic programming scheme, that \textsc{Isometric Path Cover} admits an XP algorithm w.r.t.~the parameter combination of treewidth and diameter, running in time $n^{\diam^{O(\tw)}}$ where $\diam$, $\tw$, and $n$ denote the diameter, the treewidth, and the number of vertices of the input graph, respectively. However, we also prove that \textsc{Isometric Path Cover} becomes W[1]-hard for pathwidth on graphs of diameter~7, showing that an XP algorithm is the best one can hope for w.r.t.~this parameterization, under standard complexity theory assumptions.

### [440] [Asteroidal Triples and Friends in (Likely Necessary) Matrix Multiplication Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22133)
*Jakob Nogler,Agnès Totschnig,Virginia Vassilevska Williams*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In a seminal paper, Kratsch and Spinrad [SODA 2003 and SIAM Journal on Computing 2006] studied several important problems in structural graph theory that anticipated two trends in fine-grained complexity, both from the upper- and lower-bound side: * From the upper-bound side, for each of these problems the authors give an intermediate running time strictly between $n^{\omega}$ and $n^3$, where $\omega<2.371177$ is the matrix multiplication exponent. When optimized, this running time can be made $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^{(3+\omega)/2})$. By now, many more problems can be solved in this running time: directed unweighted or node-weighted APSP, a variety of matrix products such as max-min and dominance, RNA Folding and many more. For some of these, the community has also developed tools suggesting that this intermediate running time is necessary. * From the lower-bound side, the authors give lower bounds of $n^{\omega-o(1)}$, conditioned on three natural hardness hypotheses on the complexity of quantified variants of triangle detection that account for different types of hardness of such problems. Despite this, it has remained open for over 20 years which of these two pieces of evidence reflects the truth for the problems that Kratsch and Spinrad study: whether the intermediate running time is indeed necessary and stronger lower bounds hold, or whether the hardness evidence of Kratsch and Spinrad is essentially tight. In this paper, we resolve this question and show that the latter is the case: all problems admit an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^{\omega})$ time algorithm. As an additional contribution, we make partial algorithmic progress on further problems in structural graph theory of intermediate complexity, improving over previous work [Chiu and Lu, STACS 2022 and Information and Computation 2024][Spinrad, Discrete Applied Math 2004].

### [441] [Per-State Signatures and Mean Time-to-Failure: An Algorithm for Systems With Simultaneous Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22181)
*Guido Lagos,Simón Ávila*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We present an algorithm that computes the structural signature and the mean time-to-failure (MTTF) of a monotone binary system at every one of its states, rather than only at the state in which all components work. It makes no assumption on the structure function and evaluates it exactly once per state, as many times as needed for the signature of the complete system alone, so computing the MTTF everywhere costs only a factor polynomial in the number of components over computing it once. As a by-product, it identifies all minimal path sets. We assume exchangeable component failure times whose survivor count is a continuous-time Markov chain. This setting admits simultaneous failures, as in the Lévy-frailty Marshall-Olkin, binomial failure rate and lethal-shock models, where the simplifications available for single failures do not apply. We use the per-state MTTF to define threshold repair policies. We show that the per-state signature is a strictly finer decision criterion than the MTTF: signature dominance at a common failure count implies MTTF dominance, but not conversely. Under the Lévy-frailty Marshall-Olkin model the MTTF is monotone in the state, which yields the long-run cost rate of every threshold policy in a single pass. Experiments on 22 benchmark networks with up to 30 components and 31 failure models show that the best MTTF-threshold policy has a median excess cost of 0.36% over the optimal state-based policy, and that it is never worse than the best policy that repairs after a fixed number of failures.

### [442] [Tree Edit Distance: Near-Linear-Time Approximate, Sublinear, and Dynamic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22250)
*Bingbing Hu,Tomasz Kociumaka,Jakob Nogler,Barna Saha*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Tree edit distance (TED), the analog of string edit distance (ED) for hierarchical data, is the minimum number of node insertions, deletions, and substitutions transforming one labeled rooted ordered tree into another. We narrow polynomial gaps between TED and ED in near-linear-time approximation, sublinear algorithms, and dynamic algorithms. We give an $n^{o(1)}$-approximation in $O(n)$ time and, for every $0<\delta<1$, a $(\log n)^{O(1/\delta)}$-approximation in $O(n^{1+\delta})$ time. This improves the previous near-linear-time $O(\sqrt n)$-approximation [Boroujeni et al., STOC'19] and brings TED to parity with ED in this regime up to polylogarithmic factors. With query access to the balanced-parentheses (Euler-tour) representation of the input trees, we give the first sublinear-time TED algorithm: for every $\tau\in[1,n]$, it computes a $\tau n^{o(1)}$-approximation of $1+\mathrm{ted}$ in $O(n/\tau)$ time. For dynamic TED, we give an exact algorithm with amortized update time $\tilde{O}(k^7)$ and a $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation with amortized update time $\tilde{O}_{\varepsilon}(k)$, where $k$ caps the distance that must be reported. The exact algorithm is the first to beat recomputation in a nontrivial parameter regime. The approximation improves prior dynamic guarantees [Das et al., FOCS'25] and cannot be significantly improved in any parameter regime without a breakthrough for static $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation of ED. All results use dynamic programming on a new hierarchical tree decomposition, analogous to partitioning strings into blocks of geometrically decreasing sizes. It combines structural properties previously achieved only in isolation, providing a framework for transferring algorithmic ideas from ED to TED, with additional ingredients addressing the obstacles in each computational setting.

### [443] [Subgraph Counting with Local Node Differential Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22278)
*Sofya Raskhodnikova,Adam Smith,Connor Wagaman,Anatoly Zavyalov*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study the problem of approximately counting subgraphs under local node differential privacy (LNDP), a recently introduced model that enforces strong privacy guarantees in analyses of distributed social networks. We design a noninteractive $(\varepsilon,0)$-LNDP algorithm that, given any public $k$-node template graph $H$, counts occurrences of $H$ in a sensitive undirected $n$-node graph with additive error $O(n^{k-\frac{1}{2}}/\varepsilon^{k-1})$, for any constant $k$. We complement this algorithm with a lower bound showing that every noninteractive $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-LNDP algorithm for counting copies of any $k$-node template graph with maximum degree greater than $1$ must have error $\Omega(n^{k - \frac{1}{2}})$. Thus, our algorithm achieves optimal error for counting constant-size subgraphs, up to $\mathrm{poly}(1/\varepsilon)$ factors. Our results substantially expand the types of network statistics known to be approximable under LNDP: prior work considered only functions of the degree distribution. In addition, our lower bound yields the first known $\mathrm{poly}(n)$ gap between central and local node differential privacy when accuracy is required for all input graphs. Previous separations either only involved $\mathrm{poly}(1/\varepsilon)$ factors or only applied to promise problems.

### [444] [Near-Optimal Parallel $M$-Matrix Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22302)
*Chih-Hung Liu,Aaron Sidford,Ta-Wei Tu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: In this paper we consider the problem of computing a positive diagonal scaling of a $d \times d$ symmetric $M$-matrix so that all row and column sums are $1$. We provide a poly-logarithmic iteration algorithm that solves this problem to high accuracy, where the cost of each iteration is dominated by the cost of solving a Laplacian system. This improves upon the recent $\tilde{O}(d^{1/3})$ iteration bound of [Vladu STOC 2025] and yields a randomized algorithm for the problem that runs in near-linear time and poly-logarithmic parallel depth.

### [445] [RecSoup: Efficient Model Merging Approach for Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21220)
*Zidong Jia,Guofu Xie,Xiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RecSoup是一个针对可控多目标推荐（CMOR）的轻量级两阶段模型融合框架，通过结合任务向量剪枝与可学习的偏好-系数映射，在推理时高效实现动态目标权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CMOR方法（重排序或参数生成）存在权衡范围受限或训练/推理成本高的问题；直接将LLM中的模型融合应用于推荐系统面临缺乏共享线性机制和跨目标参数干扰的挑战。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 冲突缓解剪枝——综合考虑目标特定重要性和跨目标相关性进行剪枝；(2) 自适应融合——通过轻量级门控网络将偏好向量映射为融合系数。可证明模型融合在理论上优于参数生成方法。

Result: 在多个数据集和骨干网络（MovieLens-1M、Amazon）上，RecSoup在HV、Pareto前沿长度和可控性方面优于MMR、Soup、TATR、CMR、Paragon等基线；推理延迟比超网络方法快165–228倍。

Conclusion: 模型融合是CMOR更有效且更高效的范式，RecSoup通过剪枝缓解干扰并通过自适应系数学习实现灵活的可控多目标推荐，可扩展到准确性、多样性、公平性等设置。

Abstract: Recommender systems often need to balance multiple conflicting objectives. Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation (CMOR) enables dynamic adjustment of objective trade-offs at inference time without retraining, adapting to shifting user or system requirements. Existing CMOR approaches typically rely on output-level reranking or parameter-generating modules, which either limit the scope of feasible trade-offs or incur substantial training and inference cost. Model merging provides a promising alternative by reusing multiple objective-specific models via parameter combination. However, its direct application to recommender systems is challenging due to the lack of a shared linear regime and cross-objective interference. To address these issues, we propose RecSoup, a lightweight two-stage approach for effective CMOR via specialized model merging. RecSoup first mitigates parameter interference across objectives through a pruning strategy that jointly considers objective-specific importance and cross-objective relevance. It then performs adaptive parameter merging via a learnable preference-to-coefficient mapping, allowing dynamic trade-off control at inference time without joint retraining or additional generative modules. Theoretically, we prove that RecSoup outperforms the parameter generation paradigm in effectiveness and efficiency, as it can fully navigate the Pareto front without smoothness constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that RecSoup achieves improved Pareto front quality and effective controllability while delivers 165--228x faster inference-time latency than parameter generation approaches. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [446] [Learning When to Think: Utility-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Efficient Text Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21030)
*Yingtao Luo,Kangyi Zhao,Shiyi Du,Yubo Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. However, additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. Existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes, providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. We propose AURA, a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. AURA further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. On the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark, AURA-4B achieves 34.7 average nDCG@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. Results on MS MARCO further suggest that this specialization need not substantially degrade conventional in-domain retrieval.

### [447] [VoteGEO-Bench: Measuring the Impact of Generative Engine Optimization on Electoral Visibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21330)
*Shiqi Zhang,Xiaokui Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for election information, yet little is known about how external web content shapes the political information they present. Generative engine optimization (GEO) rewrites web content to improve its visibility in generated responses. To investigate its potential risks in voting scenarios (VoteGEO), we introduce VoteGEO-Bench, a benchmark covering the 2024 U.S. presidential election and the 2026 Japanese House of Representatives election, combining election-related queries, historical webpages, and voter personas. We first analyze sources cited by generative engines and find that many citations come from lower-cost owned and open-platform sources, while some webpages remain visible across days. We then evaluate 11 rewriting strategies in 4 categories, examining target specification, effectiveness across engines and elections, and the role of voter personas. Rewriting without specifying a target rarely increases target exposure, whereas target-specified rewriting more often does. Strategies that improve page organization or strengthen a position through argumentation yield greater gains than adding supporting evidence or changing wording. For the two strongest strategies, gains remain broadly positive across evaluated U.S. personas, but persona conditioning shows no consistent effect on these gains. Explicit partisan identities can create baseline exposure gaps larger than the gain from rewriting one webpage. When partisanship is implicit in the voter profile, baseline shifts depend on how strongly the engine responds to that signal.

### [448] [Information-Gain Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Deep Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20664)
*Chenxi Li,Xueyang Feng,Songyang Liu,Chenxu Wang,Xiaoying Tang,Chaozhuo Li,Litian Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising approach for transferring the capabilities of large agents to compact students. In deep search, where agents iteratively retrieve external evidence, a teacher's preference among plausible queries before retrieval may not predict which queries will return useful evidence. Standard OPD nevertheless supervises each student query from the preceding context alone, inducing a failure mode we term \textbf{\textit{evidence-blind supervision (EBS)}}. To understand this, we regroup the OPD objective by interaction turns and reveal two implicit priors: a \textit{budget prior} that allocates supervision by token volume, and a \textit{direction prior} that favors tokens preferred by the teacher, neither of which accounts for the evidence returned by the current query. Our empirical analysis shows that both priors contribute to EBS in practice: the first search turn accounts for 51.1\% of total absolute information gain but receives only 18.0\% of the supervision budget, while 43.7\% of search queries have teacher rewards that disagree in sign with post-retrieval information utility. To mitigate this, we propose \ours, which uses post-retrieval information gain (IG) to calibrate both priors: reallocating supervision toward information-critical turns while calibrating query preferences using the utility of retrieved evidence. Experiments on six multimodal search benchmarks show that \ours improves average accuracy by 3.4 and 1.7 percentage points for 2B and 4B students over standard OPD, enabling the 4B student to surpass its 8B teacher on MMSearch and BrowseComp-VL.

In deep search, where agents iteratively retrieve external evidence, a teacher's preference among plausible queries before retrieval may not predict which queries will return useful evidence. Standard OPD nevertheless supervises each student query from the preceding context alone, inducing a failure mode we term \textbf{\textit{evidence-blind supervision (EBS)}}. To understand this, we regroup the OPD objective by interaction turns and reveal two implicit priors: a \textit{budget prior} that allocates supervision by token volume, and a \textit{direction prior} that favors tokens preferred by the teacher, neither of which accounts for the evidence returned by the current query. Our empirical analysis shows that both priors contribute to EBS in practice: the first search turn accounts for 51.1\% of total absolute information gain but receives only 18.0\% of the supervision budget, while 43.7\% of search queries have teacher rewards that disagree in sign with post-retrieval information utility. To mitigate this, we propose \ours, which uses post-retrieval information gain (IG) to calibrate both priors: reallocating supervision toward information-critical turns while calibrating query preferences using the utility of retrieved evidence. Experiments on six multimodal search benchmarks show that \ours improves average accuracy by 3.4 and 1.7 percentage points for 2B and 4B students over standard OPD, enabling the 4B student to surpass its 8B teacher on MMSearch and BrowseComp-VL.

</details>


### [449] [Idea2Prior: Auditable Paper Retrieval and Ranking from Research Ideas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20857)
*Shitian Yang,Ruijie Tao,Jian Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Finding a paper from an informal research idea requires more than matching topic words: relevant work may use different terminology, and its distinguishing mechanism may be absent from the abstract. We present \system{}, an auditable literature-search system built on PaperArena. It combines multi-source discovery, identity verification, facet-based abstract assessment, semantic citation expansion, and joint Expert ranking. A retrieval-only mode ranks up to five papers from a shortlist of at most 60, using complete available abstracts and locally selected PDF evidence from five fixed acquisition attempts, without generating a long-form report. In a historical comparison covering ten queries from each of EASY, MEDIUM, and HARD, aggregate reported Hit@5 is 53.3\% for \system{}, 43.3\% for ChatGPT web Deep Research, and 36.7\% for Gemini web Deep Research under the documented accounting convention. The advantage is concentrated in EASY and MEDIUM; ChatGPT leads on HARD. Selected \system{} runs average 8 minutes 53 seconds, compared with user-reported web averages of 5.2 and 4.7 minutes. A separate nine-query API sample averages \$0.0945 per task; this is a historical cost observation, not a matched comparison with web subscription costs. Pairwise Top 5 coverage ranges from 6\% to 34\%, showing differing returned evidence sets. The system also exposes optional implementation analysis and citation-evolution tools. These results support targeted idea-to-paper retrieval while leaving general web research, forum search, and broader relevance evaluation open. this https URL

### [450] [TransX Technical Report: Scaling Sequence Transduction for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20913)
*Da Xu,Liyan Fang,Divya Venugopalan,Sunny Hsu,Xukai Wang,Rishav Roy Chowdhury,Cindy Liang,Nishant Satya Lakshmikanth*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: We present TransX, a sequence-transduction framework and co-designed infrastructure for scaling industrial recommendation with explicit control over model-compute allocation and execution amortization. TransX separates sequence encoding, behavior memory, and candidate-conditioned fusion into independently scalable components. Training amortizes causal trajectory computation across behavioral prefixes and fans out memory states to candidates; serving disaggregates bulk prefill, nearline refresh, and online prediction through compact behavior-memory KV. We observe anisotropic scaling returns: encoder scaling may saturate beyond moderate depth at fixed memory resolution and fusion capacity; increasing supervision shifts the allocation frontier toward candidate-conditioned fusion; and the memory resolution needed to preserve quality remains roughly stable as model capacity grows. We train TransX on click and conversion, post-train its shared behavioral interface for retrieval and preference ranking, and explore generative recommendation offline. In separate production A/B experiments, the core TransX model improves CTR by 6.02% and conversion by 4.45%, while post-trained retrieval and preference-ranking variants improve CTR by 2.96% and conversion by 1.33%, respectively, over corresponding production baselines. Under matched training conditions, the training infrastructure increases supervised-target throughput by 84%. In serving, disaggregation reduces TransX's total serving cost by nearly 80% versus colocated serving at matched traffic and SLO, enabling approximately 5X the per-request model FLOPs of the HSTU-style production baseline at the same total serving cost. At matched per-request model FLOPs, TransX delivers approximately 4X higher request throughput per H200. These results show that online serving cost need not grow proportionally with recommendation model capacity.

### [451] [Aligning LLMs with Sparse Retrieval via Adaptive Sparse Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21877)
*Tongna Chen,Minghan Li,Guodong Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic representations, their application to first-stage retrieval incurs substantial latency and storage costs. Neural sparse retrievers such as SPLADE provide efficient retrieval but rely on relatively compact encoders with limited representational capacity. To bridge this gap, we propose an LLM-based sparse retrieval framework with input-adaptive sparse alignment. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic $\alpha$-truncation strategy that selects input-specific supervision supports based on the cumulative activation mass of SPLADE representations. This strategy guides the LLM to preserve salient lexical signals while suppressing less informative activations, without relying on a fixed support budget. Subsequent retrieval fine-tuning combines contrastive learning, knowledge distillation, and sparsity regularization to improve retrieval effectiveness. Experiments on MS MARCO and six selected BEIR datasets demonstrate improvements over SPLADE++ while maintaining competitive effectiveness against LLM-based sparse retrievers. Compared with Lion-sp, our method reduces index storage by 6.4-fold and end-to-end query latency by over 11-fold, achieving a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.

### [452] [GACC-Bench: Benchmarking Goal-Adaptive Context Compression Ability across Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21893)
*Weiting Liu,Zhiyu Pan,Shuhong Wang,Zhenquan Yao,Jungang Li,Li Zhao,Jian Jiang,Jianfeng Feng,Ai Han,Wenlian Lu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Context compression in long-running applications of large language models (LLMs) must preserve goal-relevant information, often before specific downstream questions are known. We introduce GACC-Bench, a benchmark for Goal-Adaptive Context Compression that evaluates how reliably LLMs adapt information retention to specified high-level goals. For each source context, we derive one or more high-level goals by grouping source-grounded questions according to shared downstream objectives. The benchmark contains 500 goals and 2,571 questions over 281 document and agent-trace contexts from seven collections spanning diverse domains, with all instances reviewed by human experts. The compressor receives a source context, a goal, and a context-length budget, with the associated evaluation questions withheld. A fixed reader answers these questions individually using the same compressed context. Our evaluation of ten LLM compressors reveals substantial gaps to full-context performance even for the best-performing model, particularly in supporting correct answers to every question associated with a goal. Compared with goal-agnostic compression, target-goal conditioning consistently improves accuracy, whereas mismatched-goal conditioning reduces it. GACC-Bench is available at this https URL .
