### [453] [Where the SRAM Goes: Per-Symbol Attribution of Static Memory in FreeRTOS-C and Embassy-Rust IoT Firmware on a 64 KB RISC-V Microcontroller](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21064)
*Romi Fadli,Jan Everhard Riwurohi,Wahyu Ramadani Putri Utami,Zulfa Malika Amana*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种将嵌入式固件的SRAM占用按架构类别（调度器堆、网络缓冲池、任务栈、链接器保留区）进行逐符号归因的分析方法，并在CH32V203RBT6（RISC-V MCU）上对FreeRTOS-C和Embassy-Rust两套固件栈各八个累积里程碑（共16个构建）进行了测量和对比，揭示了lwIP与smoltcp在网络内存占用上虽百分比接近但绝对值差异显著（4.4倍），并指出lwIP在该平台无法实现全静态分配而需要20KB arena。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前为内存受限MCU选择固件栈时，通常仅依据聚合的二进制大小来判断SRAM占用，但无法揭示RAM的具体去向及原因。缺乏细粒度的内存归因方法，使得开发者在做技术选型和优化时难以获取有指导意义的洞见。

Method: 提出一种逐符号（per-symbol）的静态RAM归因方法：将已sized的ELF符号界定到 .data、.bss 和 .stack 等区段范围，按调度器堆、网络缓冲/池、任务栈、链接器保留区域四个架构类别进行分解。通过对全部16个构建验证类别总和与基于大小的总额精确一致来确保方法正确性。实验覆盖从空任务骨架到完整MQTT-over-Ethernet客户端的八个累积里程碑，分别在FreeRTOS-C和Embassy-Rust上实现，在CH32V203RBT6（64KB SRAM的RISC-V MCU，含片上以太网MAC/PHY）上以硬件验证功能一致性。

Result: （1）两套固件栈在网络RAM占用占比上几乎相同——FreeRTOS/lwIP为63.8%，Embassy/smoltcp为63.9%；（2）但绝对数值差异达4.4倍：lwIP占用40,719字节，而smoltcp仅占用9,316字节；（3）FreeRTOS任务栈以每任务约1KB线性增长，而Embassy的async状态随状态机复杂度增长；（4）lwIP在该平台上无法以全静态分配策略集成，需要额外20KB的arena，而smoltcp则不需要。所有测量框架、归因工具及16个固件实现均作为artifacts开源发布。

Conclusion: 该逐符号归因方法能有效揭示固件SRAM在架构层面的内部结构，弥补了仅看汇总数据的不足；实证表明在同等网络RAM占比下，TCP/IP栈的选择（lwIP vs smoltcp）对绝对内存开销影响巨大；同时验证了Embassy-Rust异步模型相比FreeRTOS传统任务栈在可扩展性上的潜在优势，为内存受限嵌入式系统的固件栈选型提供了量化依据。

Abstract: Selecting a firmware stack for a memory-constrained microcontroller is usually guided by aggregate binary sizes, which report how much SRAM a build consumes but not where it goes or why. We address that gap with a per-symbol attribution method that decomposes static RAM into architectural categories - scheduler heap, network buffers and pools, task stacks, and linker-reserved regions - by bounding sized ELF symbols to the .data, .bss and .stack section ranges. The method is validated by reconciling every category sum exactly against the size-based totals for all sixteen builds. We apply it to eight cumulative firmware milestones, from a bare task scaffold to a full MQTT-over-Ethernet client, implemented twice, in FreeRTOS-C and in Embassy-Rust, on the CH32V203RBT6, a RISC-V microcontroller with 64 KB SRAM and an on-chip Ethernet MAC and PHY, with functional parity verified on hardware at every milestone. The decomposition shows that both stacks spend a nearly identical share of their RAM on networking (63.8% versus 63.9%), yet the absolute cost differs by 4.4 times: 40,719 bytes for lwIP against 9,316 bytes for smoltcp. FreeRTOS task stacks grow linearly at roughly 1 KB per task while Embassy async state grows with state-machine complexity. We also report that lwIP could not be integrated under an all-static discipline on this platform, requiring a 20 KB arena that smoltcp does not. The measurement harness, the attribution tool, and the sixteen firmware implementations are released as artefacts.

</details>


### [454] [Range: Decoupling KV-Cache Reuse Granularity from Storage Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21241)
*Dingsen Shi,Jiahao Zhang,Liqiang Lv,Boming Huang,Yanbo Dai,Ying He,Donger Chen,Harry Fu,Wang Feng,Song Fu*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: LLM serving reuses cached key-value (KV) state to skip prefill, and growing contexts push that state past GPU HBM and CPU DRAM onto NVMe SSDs, placing prefix restore on the critical path of time-to-first-token (TTFT). We find that on a well-configured host-issued path the SSD is not the bottleneck: restoring the same 6 GiB of KV takes 2.1 s as 192 objects but 3.0 s as 6,144 objects, and more under layerwise loading, because every layer of the storage stack - lookup, allocation, I/O submission, GPU delivery, store, index - charges per logical object while the bytes stay the same. This cost grows with the KV footprint: longer contexts, deeper models under layerwise loading, and tensor parallelism each multiply the object count. Prior systems move this per-object work from the CPU to the GPU; the work remains per object. This paper presents Range, a KV-cache storage engine for vLLM and LMCache built on one principle: every cost on the storage path scales with bytes or physical batches, never with logical objects. Range tickets replace per-key lookup and ownership with token metadata and physical leases; byte stripes make the on-media layout independent of reuse granularity; completion-owned GPU transfer banks batch delivery and extraction and release each layer to attention as it lands. Range keeps the kernel cuFile path and changes four lines of vLLM. On a fixed 6 GiB restore, Range's median TTFT stays at 1.79-1.80 s across a 32x range of object counts and under layerwise delivery, within 70 ms of the prefix already being resident in GPU memory, while tuned in-process LMCache rises from 2.12 s to 3.01 s. Range improves on the fastest multiprocess DRAM-bounced path by 0.44 s at coarse granularity while moving no payload through host memory, and holds layerwise reuse at the cost of coarse-grained reuse, where the best stock path takes 2.24 s.

### [455] [Characterizing Predictability-Latency Trade-offs of KV-Cache SSD Offloading in LMCache for LLM Serving Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21249)
*Ying He,Dingsen Shi,Yanbo Dai,Donger Chen,Harry Fu,Chris Tsu,Wang Feng,Song Fu*

Main category: cs.OS

TL;DR: KV-cache offload is widely used to stretch GPU memory for LLM serving, but its storage behavior has not been characterized at the block-device level. In this paper, we study LMCache through realworld multi-session workloads that span same/different context x same/different prompt, using over 100 stateless requests per workload. Our comparison is observational rather than factorial: it contrasts two realizable deployment snapshots -- LMCache 0.3.0 with buffered I/O and the kernel page cache, and LMCache 0.3.16 with prefix-aware deduplication and O_DIRECT. Key findings define the paper. First, the legacy stack appears almost read-free at the SSD layer in all four workloads, but a flush_ram experiment shows that this is conditional on page-cache warmth: once the cache is evicted, the same path issues about 1 GB of sequential reads in 683 ms. Second, deduplication delivers a dramatic write reduction only for the exact-repeat workload: one set collapses from 1.62 GB to 11.75 MB of writes, while the other three sets remain in the 2-5 GB range. Third, O_DIRECT converts a hidden and bimodal read cost into an explicit and stable one: on one set, warm TTFT rises from 27 ms to 93 ms because each of the 99 warm requests re-reads the same ~12 MB partial chunk from SSD. The main conclusion is therefore not "newer is better," but a system trade-off: predictability versus average-case latency.

### [456] [Amora: Communication-Efficient Private Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21174)
*Qiuhao Wang,Zuowei Chen,Xu Yang,Saiyu Qi,Yong Qi*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: Amora是一个单服务器隐私保护近似最近邻搜索（PANNS）系统，通过将SimplePIR与图分区结合，并采用双PIR分割布局（VecPIR用于分区级距离检索，NbrPIR用于子组级邻居列表检索），将通信成本从每顶点降低到每分区，从而将在线通信量减少93–99%，同时在准确率上优于现有最优方案Pacmann。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端向量数据库上的近似最近邻搜索面临查询隐私泄露问题：用户的查询向量可能编码敏感意图。现有的单服务器图基方案Pacmann虽然准确率高，但每次PIR查询仅检索单个顶点，存在显著的通信开销，使其在带宽受限场景下不实用。

Method: Amora的核心方法是双PIR分割布局：将每个顶点的向量和邻居列表分离到两个异构的PIR矩阵中。VecPIR将向量水平铺开，一次查询计算整个分区内所有顶点的内积距离；NbrPIR将邻居列表垂直堆叠并按子组组织以保持矩阵平衡。此外还引入了三个优化策略：批量PIR（将多个查询合并为单次矩阵乘法）、基于质心的剪枝（过滤远距离分区）、以及TopCand探索（从每个分区提取最近顶点作为跳跃式导航种子）。安全性基于LWE假设，采用半诚实威胁模型。

Result: 在5个数据集（SIFT1M、SIFT10M、Deep1M、MSMARCO、AGNEWS，维度96–1024，规模最高达1000万向量）上的评估表明：相比Pacmann，Amora将在线通信量减少93–99%，同时在Recall@10/MRR@10上提升0.017–0.025。延迟在4个数据集上降低45–66%，仅在MSMARCO上略高。预处理通信和客户端存储也减少82–98%。消融实验证实双PIR分割布局、批量PIR、TopCand探索和质心剪枝均为必要组件。

Conclusion: Amora通过将SimplePIR与图分区结合并设计双PIR分割布局，成功将PANNS的通信成本从每顶点降低到每分区级别，在保持高准确率的同时显著降低了通信开销，为带宽受限场景下的隐私保护向量搜索提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Approximate nearest neighbors search (ANNS) over cloud-hosted vector databases raises a critical privacy concern: the query vector, which often encodes sensitive user intent, is exposed to the server. Private ANNS (PANNS) allows a client to retrieve nearest neighbors without revealing its query. The state-of-the-art single-server scheme, Pacmann (ICLR'25), achieves high accuracy via graph-based search with private information retrieval (PIR), but incurs substantial communication overhead because each PIR query retrieves only a single vertex. We present Amora, a communication-efficient PANNS system that applies SimplePIR to a partitioned graph index so that one PIR query is amortized over many vertices. To retrieve as much of the distance and neighbor information the search needs under a limited communication budget, Amora adopts a dual-PIR split layout with two heterogeneous PIR matrices that stay balanced in dimension: VecPIR retrieves inner products for an entire partition of vertices as their distance at once, while NbrPIR retrieves necessary neighbor lists at subgroup granularity for graph traversal. This layout shifts the cost model of PIR query from per-vertex to per-partition, which significantly reduces the communication overhead. To further improve efficiency by reducing the number of scans and query rounds in the PIR database, Amora introduces batch PIR to pack multiple queries into one matrix multiplication, centroid-based pruning to filter unpromising partitions, and TopCand exploration that seeds jump-style graph navigation with the closest vertices from each retrieved partition. We evaluate Amora on five datasets spanning 96 to 1024 dimensions and up to 10 million vectors. Compared to Pacmann, Amora reduces online communication by 93--99% while achieving higher search accuracy.

</details>


### [457] [AdaBool: Sparse Boolean Matrix Processing with Adaptive Data Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21264)
*Xiangrui Yang,Yifan Lei,Jiawei Yang,Yekang Zhan,Yuxin Zheng,Lei Mao,Zhaoren Wu,Yibo Huang,Yiming Qiu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: AdaBool是一个GPU加速的稀疏布尔矩阵乘法(SpBMM)框架，通过自适应数据表示解决真实世界布尔矩阵中稀疏度分布高度不均匀的问题。核心思想是将矩阵划分为细粒度元素块，根据局部稀疏度为每个块选择最合适的编码（offset-based ARRAYn或bitmap-based BITSET），并配合异构GPU执行模型和系统级优化，在多个基准测试中超越现有基线超过一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏矩阵处理系统普遍采用单一、整体化的数据表示（如CSR），但真实世界布尔矩阵的稀疏度分布呈现高度偏斜（从10^-6到10^-2不等），不同区域的最优压缩方式不同。强制使用单一固定表示会留下大量优化空间未利用。此外，SpBMM是内存密集型负载，内存访问效率成为关键瓶颈。

Method: 方法包含三个核心层面：(1) 自适应数据表示——将矩阵行划分为固定大小(l=256)的块，根据块内非零元素数量选择ARRAY0/4/8/16/32或BITSET编码；(2) 异构GPU执行模型——包括角色感知编码（静态矩阵A用自适应表示，动态矩阵B用bitmap）、基于类型的执行（同类型块池用专用kernel处理）、块级调度（AdaBool-T遍历式和AdaBool-C候选式）；(3) 系统级优化——交叉寻址内存布局（避免bank conflict）和聚合行索引（压缩行索引减少内存流量）。

Result: 在RTX 4090 D和A6000上，AdaBool在微基准测试中比cuSPARSE、Sputnik、cuBool快达165.9倍。在生产数据集AdsFilter上，AdaBool-T平均延迟0.158ms，比cuSPARSE快7.4倍，比cuBool快8.4倍，吞吐量峰值12,279 QPS（比cuSPARSE快63.9倍）。在公开数据集Email-Enron、pdb1HYS、Human-Gene1上同样取得4.9-32.3倍的加速。GPU内存消耗仅为cuBool的0.21-0.65倍。

Conclusion: AdaBool证明在GPU上实现高性能SpBMM需要超越单一整体化数据表示，转向基于局部稀疏度的自适应范式。通过数据表示、执行策略和系统优化的协同设计，AdaBool在多样化的真实世界工作负载上实现了显著且鲁棒的性能提升，已在推荐系统生产环境中部署四年。该工作也为未来探索自动调度选择器等方向留下了空间。

Abstract: Many data processing tasks revolve around determining whether logical relationships exist between two sets of entities, a pattern that can be naturally modeled as Sparse Boolean Matrix Multiplication (SpBMM). Under Boolean semantics, matrix representations no longer need to store numerical values and instead focus on encoding the positions of non-zero elements, making it highly amenable to data compression for substantially lower memory access overhead. The key challenge, however, is that the most effective compression depends heavily on sparsity distribution: different methods perform best at different sparsity levels, while real-world matrices often contain sharply varying sparsity across regions. Consequently, forcing the entire matrix into any fixed, monolithic representation leaves considerable optimization opportunities untapped. We present AdaBool, a SpBMM framework designed to reconcile this tension through an adaptive data representation. AdaBool partitions matrices into fine-grained element blocks and represents each block with the encoding best matched to its local sparsity. On top of this adaptive encoding, AdaBool introduces a heterogeneous GPU execution model that groups blocks by encoding type and maps them to matching processing paths, enabling efficient execution and scheduling across GPU resources. We implement AdaBool end to end with low-level system optimizations, evaluate it on both production and public workloads, and show that it outperforms representative baselines by over an order of magnitude.

</details>


### [458] [ConStore: Search-Overlapped Prefetch and Co-Retrieval-Aware Content Storage for Disk-Based ANNS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21676)
*Zhutao Zhuang,Nong Xiao,Zhiguang Chen,Yue Yu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: ConStore是一个面向磁盘近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）的内容存储引擎，通过搜索重叠预取（SICP）和协同检索感知内容分组（RPAG+GCF+WASR）两项互补技术，减少大K值场景下的端到端检索延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业级ANNS应用通常需要较大的top-K（如100-3000），而现有研究多关注小K场景下的向量搜索。对百万至十亿级向量语料库的剖析显示，在大K下内容获取延迟可匹配甚至超过向量搜索延迟，成为不可忽视的一类检索开销。

Method: 1) SICP：将图搜索（DiskANN）和聚类搜索（SPANN）抽象为渐进式SSD I/O，在候选队列稳定的leading候选上以有界I/O预算进行推测性内容预取，不改变最终top-K；2) RPAG：利用查询日志构建共检索图，对频繁共同检索的文档进行加权图划分（METIS），放入连续CCS段中；3) WASR：通过监测共检索模式的变化，在有界重写预算下选择性地重组段布局；4) GCF：将同段内的内容请求合并为页面对齐的批量读。

Result: 在三个多跳问答工作负载（2Wiki/HotpotQA/MuSiQue）、K从10到1600的测试中：DiskANN上端到端检索延迟较最优逐文档读基线最多降低48%，SPANN上最多降低25%。SICP在SIFT100M和SIFT1B的十亿级索引上证明可扩展性。共段命中率RPAG约52.8%（K-Means约15.4%，Random约3.9%）。预取精度62.6%-99.9%，最终K覆盖率超99%。

Conclusion: ConStore将内容获取视为磁盘ANNS检索的一类核心开销，其两项互补技术（预取重叠与协同检索感知布局）可独立部署，并在保留最终top-K的同时显著降低端到端检索延迟，验证了在工业级大K场景下优化"搜索+获取"完整流水线的必要性。

Abstract: Disk-based approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) supports retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), search, recommendation, and advertising over corpora that exceed memory capacity. Existing ANNS research often focuses on vector search at small top-K, whereas industrial-scale applications require larger retrieval sets. Fetching the corresponding content from storage remains comparatively underexplored. Our profiling across million- to billion-vector corpora shows that, at large K, content fetch latency can match or exceed vector-search latency and cannot be ignored in end-to-end retrieval. We present ConStore, a content storage engine combining two complementary techniques to reduce end-to-end retrieval latency. Speculative Inline Content Prefetch (SICP) commonly abstracts graph-based and cluster-based ANNS as progressive SSD I/O that refines an in-flight candidate queue. It prefetches content for stable leading candidates under a bounded I/O budget, overlapping content reads with search without changing the final top-K results. Co-Retrieval-Pattern-Aware Grouping (RPAG) uses query logs to place frequently co-retrieved documents in contiguous segments. Workload-Adaptive Segment Reorganization (WASR) adapts this layout to workload shifts by selectively regrouping segments under a bounded rewrite budget. Group Content Fetch (GCF) exploits this layout to coalesce per-document random reads into batched, page-aware I/O requests. SICP works independently of the content layout, while RPAG and GCF reduce fetch cost even without prefetching. Across three multi-hop QA workloads with K from 10 to 1600, ConStore reduces end-to-end retrieval latency over the best per-document-read baseline by up to 48% on DiskANN and 25% on SPANN. Separate experiments on 100M- and billion-vector indexes demonstrate SICP's applicability at larger scales.

</details>


### [459] [Reflective Compositional Grounding for Natural-Language-to-SPARQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21796)
*Isabelle Mohr,John Dujany,Andre Freitas*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种NL2SPARQL框架，将概念组合性置于查询解释的核心，通过固定概念编码器进行组合检索，加入类型兼容性和层级邻近度进行结构化排序，并使用反思性精化机制按阶段归因诊断并定向修正场景。本文还形式化了一个单调精化纪律和保守保留定理。实验在五个基准/知识图目标上验证了检索和反思机制的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言查询生成在大规模知识图谱上面临经典的词汇问题：用户表达的概念和组成方式可能与目标模式差异显著，同时模型上下文限制要求选择性地访问模式信息。查询生成必须构建相关模式上下文、在其中锚定问题的概念，并将其解释组合成可执行查询。

Method: 框架包含两个互补的组合机制：1) 概念组合——使用Mohr等2026a的固定概念编码器对复合表达式进行整体编码，加入类型兼容性和层级邻近度因子进行结构化排序；2) 关系组合——通过阶段化查询过程（grounding、binding、construction）实现绑定和查询构建。反思性精化机制使用执行结果和语义批评审查参数绑定、连接和运算符作用域，将诊断出的差异归因到特定阶段a*，并仅更新该阶段的需求集Γ_a*（目标更新保证）。表单由步骤的算法3控制场景。

Result: 在五个基准/知识图目标上，平均模式recall@10从0.712提升到0.837（从Flat到Full检索）。反思性提示重写在固定检索下为每个目标增加2.27-3.33答案F1点。消融实验证实：组合编码器（RH1）贡献8.4pp召回率提升，结构排序（RH2）再贡献4.1pp，反思精化（RH3）贡献2.27-3.33 F1点，跨四个骨干模型的检索增益（RH4）均为正值。限定求解器在两个层有提升但整体MF1下降9.52点，主要归因于稀疏标签序列化和更粗的活验证属性。

Conclusion: 论文将NL2SPARQL形式化为提示参数化的锚定、绑定和构造过程，在锚定阶段使用组合感知编码器，反馈机制围绕整个过程。作用域需求累积提供了保留纪律，其中被接纳的规范保留先前的需求并限制允许的阶段行为，第二个结果（保守保留定理）在显式兼容性合约下建立了已学解释映射的保留。然而这些是有条件的结果，其前提是报告的实验未建立。检索和精化增益在目标、骨干和组合相关层中始终保持一致。

Abstract: Natural-language query generation over large knowledge graphs embodies the classical vocabulary problem in human-systems communication. Questions express concepts through wording and compositions that can differ substantially from the target schema, while limited model context requires selective access to schema information. We present an NL2SPARQL framework that places conceptual compositionality at the center of query interpretation and connects it to the relational composition required for binding and query construction. A fixed concept encoder represents compound expressions jointly, and schema candidates are ranked using semantic similarity, type compatibility, and hierarchy proximity. Reflective refinement critically examines how the grounded meanings are realized through argument bindings, joins, and operator scope. Diagnosed semantic discrepancies guide revisions to the responsible stage. We formalise a monotone refinement discipline that accumulates scoped interpretation requirements and establish conditions under which changes to the composed process preserve previously validated interpretations. Across five benchmark/knowledge-graph targets, mean schema recall@10 increases from 0.712 to 0.837. With retrieval held fixed, reflective prompt rewriting adds 2.27-3.33 answer-F1 points. These experiments evaluate the grounding and refinement mechanisms, while the formal analysis specifies the stronger requirements for conservative adaptation across queries.

</details>


### [460] [TraHist: Fast and Accurate Cardinality Estimation for Trajectory Data (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22310)
*Yujeong Jo,Incheol Baek,Changbeom Shim,Yon Dohn Chung*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出 TraHist，一种基于直方图的轨迹数据基数估计器，通过密度自适应直交桶划分来同时保持轨迹连续性和局部密度一致性，在低/中等选择性查询上将最强基线估计误差降低超过20倍，同时保持亚毫秒查询延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于直方图的基数估计器采用点中心、轴对齐划分，假设记录独立，但轨迹数据中同一移动对象的样本存在强时空依赖，导致轨迹被桶边界切割、在跨桶聚合时重复计数而产生过度估计，这是分区边界与轨迹诱导密度模式不匹配的结构性缺陷。

Method: TraHist 提出"密度对齐划分"作为设计原则并通过两阶段实现其高效近似：(1) 构建规则网格 CountGrid 聚合轨迹样本并施加对数变换得到离散密度场 ρ_p；(2) 通过基于最小堆的密度自适应传播算法（MERGE/BOUNDARY 决策）形成直交桶，局部对比度 D(x,n)=α|ρ_p(x)-ρ_p(n)|+(1-α)|μ(x)-μ(n)| 与自适应阈值 τ(x)=β·μ(x) 控制边界触发，累积传播成本由优先队列按升序处理；估计时通过逐点计数乘以轨迹-点比率 γ^(k) 进行对象级校正。

Result: 在 Porto、T-Drive、GeoLife 三个真实大规模轨迹数据集上的实验表明：在 T-Drive 固定 50 桶设置下，TraHist 在中等选择性查询上相对最强基线（DEH）的 Q-error 降低超过20倍；在固定内存预算下相对 DEH 降低 3.5–5.4 倍（低选择性）和 1.1–3.7 倍（中等选择性）；查询延迟保持在亚毫秒级，构建时间在 Porto 上仅 15–23 秒（T-Drive 约 6–7 秒），显著低于 DEH/CASE+ 的 46–75 倍开销。轨迹碎片计数 F(T) 在 T-Drive 上接近1，远优于其他基线 27–76 片段。

Conclusion: TraHist 通过将分区边界对齐于轨迹诱导的密度结构而非固定坐标轴，从根本上缓解了轨迹碎片化和桶内密度异质性两大结构性问题，其密度自适应传播作为理想连续优化的可处理近似，理论上由累积传播代价与桶内方差之间的偏差上界所支持；实验验证其在碎片化主导的低/中等选择性查询中带来显著精度增益，同时保持直方图方法的轻量级、无需训练特性，并能有效扩展到增量维护与数据漂移场景。

Abstract: Cardinality estimation is fundamental for query optimization in database systems. Histogram-based estimators are widely used for their simplicity and efficiency but rely on point-centric partitioning that assumes record independence. This assumption breaks in trajectory data, where records from the same moving object show strong spatiotemporal dependencies. Conventional axis-aligned histograms therefore fragment trajectories across partition boundaries, leading to overestimation through duplicate counting. This error reflects a structural limitation of partition boundaries that are misaligned with trajectory-induced density patterns. To this end, we propose TraHist, a histogram-based estimator approximating density-aligned partitioning via efficient grid-based propagation. TraHist builds density-adaptive rectilinear buckets to preserve trajectory continuity and local density coherence while keeping histogram efficiency. Experiments on large-scale real-world datasets show that TraHist reduces estimation error by over 20x relative to the strongest competing estimator in query regimes where trajectory fragmentation is a dominant source of estimation error, while maintaining sub-millisecond query latency and competitive construction cost.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [461] [Poison Valleys: Diagnosing Path-Dependent Failure in LLM Code Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21514)
*Veljko Skarich*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Poison Valleys 通过在两个合成的 Python 代码修复任务（PersistQueue 原子批量声明和 Dijkstra 源敏感过滤）上注入预定义的"毒家族"（合理但错误的软件机制）到 LLM 的假设、计划或两者中，进行 1,844 次模型请求，追踪从上游错误观念→实现承诺→代码机制→违反的软件义务的因果路径。结果显示，将错误观念从假设移到计划层面会使失败率增加约 30%；不同错误观念产生不同的违反义务分布。该工作建立了基于执行诊断的失败机制可测量链条，为代码修复代理提供"计划到代码"的关键干预点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码修复代理失败时，最终测试只能告诉我们补丁错误，但无法揭示哪个早期决策导致失败，或哪项软件义务被违反。已有研究能定位轨迹内的失败或扰动特定阶段，但缺乏从特定上游错误观念到具体实现机制再到可执行违反义务的因果链路。论文旨在填补这一空白，建立可测量的连接以指导修复系统的干预设计。

Method: 采用受控实验设计：(1) 定义"毒家族"——预先审查、合理但错误的软件机制，绑定错误假设、实现承诺、验证实现和可执行见证四个对象；(2) 修复序列 O→D→H→P→C，将毒家族注入假设（H）、计划（P）、两者（H+P）或都不注入（canonical）；(3) 两个合成任务：PersistQueue（SQLite 磁盘队列的原子批量声明）和 Dijkstra（NetworkX 多源最短路径的源敏感过滤）；(4) 评估通过 Oracle 判断整体通过/失败，通过针对性诊断坐标判断违反的软件义务（恢复、标识、隔离、持久性/路由、权重、API、兼容性）；(5) 离线重放系统通过 UUID 关联所有记录，SHA-256 标识交接点，可在不发起新模型请求的情况下重建和重跑执行。使用 Cramér's V 衡量关联强度，并通过 2000 次 bootstrap 计算 95% 区间。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 将毒家族从假设移到计划层，PersistQueue 失败率从 21.9% 升至 54.7%（+32.2 pp），Dijkstra 从 53.4% 升至 83.0%（+28.9 pp），平衡实验混合后失败风险比分别为 2.44 和 1.54；(2) H+P 相比 P-only 仅小幅再增加 6.3% 和 2.2%，表明计划是关键承诺点；(3) 计划仅尝试下，毒家族与违反义务的 Cramér's V 在 PersistQueue 为 0.475、Dijkstra 为 0.314，关联结构化但非确定性；(4) 同一家族可在不同模型上产生不同结果（如 Dijkstra B01 在 GPT-5.6 Luna 中 35.0% 成功，在 Qwen 3.8 Flash 中仅 4.7%）；(5) 各模型配置的效应量差异显著（PersistQueue 范围 -3.8% 至 +45.1%，Dijkstra +6.6% 至 +39.1%）。共 669 次成功（41.0%），964 次失败（59.0%）。

Conclusion: Poison Valleys 建立了从上游错误观念→实现承诺→代码机制→违反义务的可测量连接。计划阶段是高杠杆的干预边界——当错误观念被表达为操作、状态归属、更新顺序、错误处理和兼容性选择等具体实现承诺时，它们会直接传递到代码中。论文建议修复系统在计划生成后、代码生成前检查计划是否保留了软件契约，并提出后续工作：将失败的候选代码连同违反义务名称一起反馈给同一模型，测试二次修复是否能通过 Oracle 并减少失败的诊断检查。两个任务的局限性在于不代表真实仓库、语言和自然 bug 的多样性，且构造效度并非完全确立。

Abstract: When code-repair agents fail, final tests reveal that a patch is wrong but not which earlier commitment caused it or which software obligation failed. Poison Valleys traces this path in 1,844 model requests on two synthetic Python cases: PersistQueue adds atomic batch claiming to a disk-backed queue, while Dijkstra adds source-sensitive filtering to shortest-path search. We define plausible but incorrect software mechanisms, place each in a model's hypothesis, implementation plan, or both, and evaluate the generated code with an Oracle and targeted diagnostic coordinates. Moving the misconception from hypothesis to plan increased failure by 32.2% in PersistQueue and 28.9% in Dijkstra after matching the experimental mix. Different misconceptions produced distinct, model-dependent patterns of violated obligations, although several could converge on the same behavior. This creates a measured connection from upstream misconception to code mechanism and failure form. Code, data, and demo: this https URL .

</details>


### [462] [CodeHealth Predicts the Token Cost of Agentic Code Review: A Pre-Registered Study of 465 Agent-Authored Pull Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21914)
*Lo Gullstrand Heander,Markus Borg,Emma Söderberg,Christofer Rydenfält*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 一项预注册的观察性研究，从AIDev数据集中抽取465个由智能体编写的PR（来自246个仓库），使用包含4个评审智能体和1个修复智能体的冻结流水线，配合3种不同的LLM进行审查与修复，测量基线CodeHealth分数与代币成本之间的关联。结果显示，在所有三个LLM上，CodeHealth系数均为负值且95%置信区间排除零：每提升一个CodeHealth点与3.5%至6.1%的代币成本降低相关；该效应不被PR规模所中介；Complex Method和Complex Conditional两种代码异味预测了修复成本；批量修复未使中位CodeHealth发生系统性变化；探索性分析发现该效应集中在评审阶段，且与被评分文件的文件大小存在中介关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着多智能体LLM流水线越来越多地承担按token计费的代码审查工作，代码质量对智能体审查成本的影响尚未被量化。以往关于代码质量与维护成本的研究均以人类为单位（注意力、工作时间、理解力），而智能体审查的成本单位已转变为按token计费的推理成本。本研究旨在检验校准于人类可维护性的CodeHealth指标能否预测智能体审查与修复的token成本，并将其与PR规模的影响区分开来。

Method: 预注册的观察性研究设计。从246个仓库中按CodeHealth层级与PR规模三维网格（3×3）联合分层抽样465个由智能体编写且已合并的PR，对每个仓库设上限（单格最多2个PR，总数最多9个）。使用包含4个评审智能体（按ISO/IEC 25010质量模型分区）和1个修复智能体的冻结流水线，3种LLM（deepseek-v4-flash、qwen3-6本地部署、sonnet-5）分别独立处理每个PR。主要分析模型为线性混合模型：log(tokens_total) ~ health + log(footprint) + language + (1|repo)，按LLM分别拟合。预注册的联合判定标准为三个LLM的β_health估计均为负且至少两个95%置信区间排除零。还包含中介分析（CH↔文件大小↔相关成本的三路径分解）、三种代码异味的偏Spearman相关分析、批量修复后ΔCodeHealth的描述性报告，以及工具输出过大缺陷的OSF修订和27个PR的重复性子样本用于评估运行间方差。

Result: RQ1：CodeHealth预测智能体审查与修复的token成本，三个LLM上β_health均为负（deepseek-v4-flash：-0.062 [-0.090, -0.035]；qwen3-6：-0.049 [-0.085, -0.014]；sonnet-5：-0.036 [-0.070, -0.001]），每个CH点对应3.5%至6.1%的成本降低，PR规模未中介该关联。RQ2：CH与PR规模之间无显著关联（β在+0.007至+0.014之间，区间均包含零），CH效应在控制规模后仍然显著，为直接效应。RQ3：Complex Method和Complex Conditional在三个LLM上均显著预测修复阶段成本；Code Duplication未通过显著性检验。RQ4：批量修复后中位ΔCodeHealth为0。探索性分析显示效应集中在评审阶段（去除修复阶段后系数更负），评审在低CH代码上轮次更多、输入上下文更多，但评论数量并未增加；调整被评分文件的总行数后，CH系数被吸收，解释为文件大小的中介作用；按发现数量计算的评审成本降低5.0%至7.6%/CH点。

Conclusion: 校准于人类可维护性的代码质量指标CodeHealth能够预测多智能体审查与修复的推理成本，每提升一个CH点与3.5%至6.1%的token成本降低相关。该效应不被PR规模中介，而是与被评分文件的文件大小存在中介关系，提示其作用路径为：低CH代码往往出现在大型低内聚文件中，智能体需要更多轮次和上下文来推理。该结果支持重构工作在智能体审查场景下的延伸价值，但强调有效的重构应改变代码结构与文件大小，而非仅提升评分指标。研究受限于单一质量度量、单一成本构造、单一流水线以及三个2026年版本的LLM，已发布的复制包支持在后续LLM和其他可维护性指标下重新验证。

Abstract: Context: Organizations increasingly delegate code review to multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines billed per token. Low code quality raises human maintenance effort, but its effect on agent review cost has not been measured. Objective: We test whether baseline CodeHealth predicts the token cost of agentic review and fix beyond pull request (PR) footprint. Method: In a pre-registered observational study, we sampled 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories in AIDev, jointly stratified by CodeHealth and footprint under repository caps. A frozen five-agent review-and-fix pipeline processed every PR with three different LLMs. Per LLM, we fitted a mixed model of log tokens on CodeHealth and log PR footprint, with a repository random intercept. Results: For all three LLMs the CodeHealth coefficient was negative, with 95% CI excluding zero; each CodeHealth point was associated with 3.5% to 6.1% lower token cost. CodeHealth was unrelated to PR footprint, so PR size does not explain the association. Two of three registered smells predicted fix cost; batch fixing left median CodeHealth unchanged. Exploratory analyses located the association in the review stage, where agents iterated more on unhealthy code without writing more comments. Adjusting for the size of the scored files absorbed the association, which we interpret as mediation by file size. Conclusions: A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability also predicts the inference cost of multi-agent review and fix. The effect is modest per point and not carried by PR size, so the refactoring case extends to agent-reviewed code when it changes structure and file size, not only the score. Data Availability: this https URL

</details>


### [463] [Harnessing MPI mutations for AI error detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20616)
*Asia Auville,Tim Jammer,Eric Petit,Pablo de Oliveira Castro,Emmanuelle Saillard,Mihail Popov*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于AI的MPI（MPI错误检测）静态分析框架。针对动态验证工具开销大、静态分析准确率低的问题，作者构建了源自数千个GitHub开源项目的大规模数据集MPI Mutated Dataset (MMD)，并通过代码变异注入真实错误。利用该数据集训练以AST-T5为embedding的MLP模型，在MPI-BugBench (MBB)错误分类（含CallOrdering、InvalidParameter等）上达到了高达92.0%的检测准确率，在部分场景下超越了Qwen-3 Coder LLM和动态验证工具ITAC。同时评估了Claude Sonnet 4.5在不同提示工程下的表现，验证了AI驱动的大规模MPI错误检测的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPI程序中的错误检测面临两难：动态验证工具（如ITAC、MUST）虽然精度高，但计算开销极大；而现有的静态分析工具开销低但准确率不足。当前的AI/LLM方法难以针对HPC中MPI的特定错误类型进行有效基准测试和适配，缺乏大规模、高质量的真实错误数据集。

Method: 1. **数据集构建**：从GitHub爬取数千个开源项目，过滤排序后提取MPI程序，构建MPI Mutated Dataset (MMD)，并使用代码变异（mutations）注入模拟开发者真实缺陷的错误。2. **MLP训练**：使用AST-T5（仅Transformer编码器网络）提取抽象语法树（AST）代码嵌入，训练轻量级多层感知机（MLP）分类器，对MBB基准中的多种MPI错误类别进行分类。3. **LLM评估**：采用提示工程（prompting strategies）评估Claude Sonnet 4.5的零样本及少样本能力，并将其与Qwen-3 Coder及动态工具对比。4. **代理工作流（agentic pipeline）**：集成多类分类与错误检测的全流程验证。

Result: 1. MLP+AST-T5模型在MBB分类上达到了高达92.0%的检测准确率，性能优于普通提示下的Qwen-3 Coder LLM。2. Claude Sonnet 4.5在经过工程化提示（engineered prompts）后，InvalidParam检测准确率从84.8%提升至93.6%，超越了动态验证工具ITAC（87.0%）。3. 全代理工作流在MBB上达到了73.9%的多类分类整体准确率和87.6%的错误检测召回率。

Conclusion: 研究表明，基于AI（特别是轻量MLP与LLM结合）的静态/半静态检测方法能够在保持低开销的同时，达到甚至超越传统动态验证工具的准确率。所构建的MMD数据集为大规模MPI错误分析提供了良好基础，未来可针对单一MPI错误类型进行深度研究，并推动HPC应用的大规模自动化验证。

Abstract: MPI errors are challenging to identify despite the significant number of expert verification tools. Dynamic tools (i.e., requiring profiling) are computationally expensive and accurate in error detection, whereas static analysis (i.e., operating at source code or compilation) is computationally cheap but less accurate. Interestingly, the recent success of AI and LLMs offers an alternative to increase static analysis accuracy while preserving its low overhead. Yet current methods remain difficult to benchmark, too general, and poorly adapted to the specific challenges of high-performance computing. In this paper, we investigate how AI-powered tools can efficiently and accurately detect errors in real-world MPI applications. We propose a novel MPI Mutated Dataset (MMD), constructed from MPI programs extracted from thousands of open-source GitHub projects. After sorting and filtering these files, we inject errors that realistically emulate developers' mistakes using synthetic code mutations. We leverage the dataset to train different AI models and assess their generalization capabilities against standard verification tools. We train compact multilayer perceptrons (MLP) with AST-T5 embeddings (i.e., transformer only encoder network) to detect diverse MPI errors (from the MPI-BugBench (MBB) classification) including CallOrdering or InvalidParameter, achieving detection accuracies up to 92.0%. In some cases, our method outperforms the expert prompted Qwen-3 Coder LLM and provides competitive results compared to established dynamic verification tools. We further evaluate Claude Sonnet 4.5 across different prompting strategies, showing that engineered prompts improve InvalidParam detection accuracy from 84.8% to 93.6%, surpassing the dynamic tool ITAC (87.0%). The full agentic pipeline achieves 73.9% overall multi-class accuracy and 87.6% bug detection recall on MBB. This paves the way for large-scale verification efforts that can use our dataset as a foundation to thoroughly investigate each MPI error in real world applications.

</details>


### [464] [Developer Experiences with Cursor AI-native IDE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20618)
*Haoran Xue,Gias Uddin,Song Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对Cursor AI原生IDE的官方公共论坛进行了大规模纵向研究,分析了超过两年内收集的14,714篇论坛帖子,旨在揭示开发者如何评估AI IDE、使用中的摩擦点以及日常使用中最重要的体验维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI编码助手研究多基于受控实验、小规模访谈或短期观察,缺乏对AI原生IDE在真实、长期、社区驱动使用情境下的纵向洞察。本文通过分析Cursor官方公共论坛的大规模数据,填补这一研究空白,理解工作流关键机制如何塑造开发者的采用决策与日常体验。

Method: 采用三阶段研究流程:(1)使用Python爬虫收集2023年8月至2025年11月间14,714篇论坛帖子(含51,965条评论、1120万浏览量、51,518个点赞);(2)通过人工开放编码(标注1,000篇)与GPT-5 mini辅助标注相结合,构建两层分类法(9大类、34子类),并进行情感标注(三类:正/中/负)与使用姿态标注(primary_ide/non_primary_ide/trial_blocked/unclear);(3)利用浏览量、点赞数、评论数等交互信号分析注意力分布与时间演化。情感标注一致性达81%,使用姿态标注一致性达86%。

Result: 研究发现:(1)讨论集中于工作流关键机制(71%),如上下文索引、模型路由、代理工作流,这些同时是价值与挫败感的主要来源;(2)负面体验集中于可用性(27.4%帖子,48%负面)、定价(9.5%帖子,仅8%正面)与可靠性(性能负面率89%,依赖性负面率68.7%);(3)随时间推移,摩擦焦点从早期接入/设置障碍转向定价、稳健性与持续工作流可靠性;(4)将Cursor作为主要IDE使用的帖子正面率(33%)远高于非主要工具(13.2%)或试用受阻(2.3%);(5)正面帖子集中于功能请求区(46.4%正面),反映赞赏常嵌入于扩展现有功能的提案中;(6)VS Code是最主要的对比对象(69.7%),开发者关注生态兼容性与切换成本。最终提炼出六条设计教训,涵盖运行就绪性与信任基础设施、AI中介的可读性与控制、端到端工作流连续性三大主题。

Conclusion: 工作流关键机制既是AI原生IDE价值的主要来源,也是主要的故障面。开发者讨论热度会随产品成熟从访问障碍转向能力局限,再转向定价/价值与稳健性。本文为AI优先IDE的设计提出具体优先事项——将运营就绪性作为前提、构建透明可控的上下文、采用可解释的路由策略、为代理工作流设计有界自主性与强大恢复路径,并将定价与使用计量视为信任基础设施。

Abstract: AI-powered integrated development environments (IDEs) are increasingly positioned as practical tools for software development, integrating AI assistance into everyday activities such as editing, refactoring, and debugging. However, how developers evaluate AI IDEs as working environments, what frictions shape their adoption, and which aspects of the experience matter most in everyday use remain underexplored. Prior evidence on adoption and use is mainly controlled tasks, small interview samples, and short observation windows, which offer limited visibility into longitudinal, community-driven experience and the workflow drift that emerges in everyday practice. To bridge this gap, we conduct a large-scale longitudinal study of Cursor, a prominent AI-native IDE, through its official public forum, where users report bugs, request features, and discuss everyday use. Our analysis covers 14,714 forum posts collected over more than two years. We find that discussion is dominated by workflow-critical mechanisms (71%) such as context indexing, model routing, and agent workflows, which are also the main sources of both perceived value and frustration. Negative experiences center on usability, pricing, and dependability, including installation and setup, usage limits and consumption, crashes, and latency. Over time, the focus of friction shifts from early access and setup barriers toward pricing, robustness, and sustained workflow reliability.

</details>


### [465] [HPCAgent-Bench: A Framework for Sound Benchmarking of Code-Optimizing Agents, Harnesses, and Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20673)
*Yakup Koray Budanaz,Lorenzo Paleari,Marcin Copik,Alexandru Calotoiu,Timo Schneider,Benjamin Chen Ming Choong,Shriram Chandran,Lars Hulsbergen,Levi Widmer,Torsten Hoefler*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 HPCAgent-Bench，一个用于公平评估代码优化智能体（coding agents）的综合性基准测试框架。它包含 689 个内核，覆盖循环级优化、HPC 科学计算和机器学习三类任务，支持 CPU/GPU 单节点及多节点执行，并通过外部裁判、双盲随机输入和显著性检验等机制防止智能体作弊。作者提出了两项新指标——干预效能（intervention efficacy）和加权令牌成本（weighted token cost），并在多种模型、平台、工具和测试框架的对照实验中发现，代码优化智能体在速度提升方面相较自动并行化器可达 4.2 倍加速，而不同的"工具、提示框架（harness）或技能包（skill packets）"对速度提升影响有限，但令牌成本变化可达 3 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的代码优化智能体基准存在明显局限：范围狭窄（仅覆盖 GPU kernel 或某一领域）、测试方法存在漏洞（如暴露测试用例与固定输入使智能体可作弊）、加速结果可靠性低、令牌成本核算方式不统一，且各工作之间难以相互比较。HPCAgent-Bench 的目标是提供一套兼具科学性（correctness、可复现）与工程实用性（跨平台、跨语言）的评测体系，使研究人员能够在受控条件下公平地回答"某个新模型、某个新工具或某项新技能，究竟让这个优化智能体变好了还是变贵了？"

Method: 方法体系包含以下几个核心组件：（1）评测骨架（benchmarking framework）：每个内核以 NumPy 单次描述，自动派生 C 与 Fortran 参考实现，通过统一的 C-ABI/Python 接口接收提交，外部裁判（judge）使用两个独立的秘密种子（评分种子与提交种子）生成随机输入以验证正确性并计时，封闭了硬编码、缓存、定时器探测、设备跨用等作弊路径。（2）干预效能指标（intervention efficacy）：通过配对运行（仅改变一项设置，例如加入/移除技能包或工具），以三项比率——成功率比 ρ_R、加速比 ρ_S（仅对双方都解决的内核采用几何均值）和成本比 ρ_C——量化单次干预的影响。（3）加权令牌成本（weighted token cost）：以 w_in T_in + w_cache T_cache + w_out T_out 表示，三种默认权重——billed（1,0.1,1）、effective（1,0,1）、total（1,1,1）——分别对应供应商计费、实际上下文以及每次重新计费的保守计费方式。（4）689 个内核组成的语料（corpus），分三条赛道：LLR（来自 TSVC-2 及其扩展）、SC（自天气/电子结构/聚变/地震/分子动力学等多类生产代码与代理应用，按 13 个 Berkeley dwarfs 组织）和 ML（深度学习算子与模型）。（5）显著性检验：加速需通过单侧 Mann-Whitney U 检验（α=0.1），干预效应采用配对 t 检验并以 Benjamini-Hochberg q<0.05 控制家族错误率。

Result: 主要结果：（1）智能体能力——开源权重的 LLM 智能体相对自动并行化器（Pluto/PPCG）可达 4.2 倍加速，对 CPU Numba 基线的平均加速为 5–7 倍，HIP GPU 内核为 21–55 倍。（2）可移植性（portability）——在第二台机器 GH200 上，93–99% 不含设备特定代码的答案仍然正确，每内核加速的 Spearman 秩相关系数 r_s ≥ 0.84。（3）控制性（control）——在 40 对配对配置中，干预仅在 2 对中显著改变加速比，却使令牌成本变化可达 3 倍；其中 OpenHands 为 Qwen3.8-27B 节省 2.1 倍计费令牌，mini-SWE-agent 为 OSS-120B 节省 3 倍，而 AutoKernel 虽使 OSS-120B 的评分调用次数翻三倍，但加速比未显著变化。（4）通用性（generality）——同一评分器可同时评估 CPU、GPU 与多节点代码，Qwen3.8-27B 的分布式 ML 模型在 4 节点 16 GPU 上较单 GPU PyTorch 达 10× 加速，比 PyTorch 分布式 3.9× 更优。（5）稳健性（validity）——通过模糊化输入、设备隔离、计时轮换与可信度上限等机制拦截作弊尝试，最终人工核查 10,633 份答案中仅 54 份可疑。

Conclusion: HPCAgent-Bench 是首个兼具通用性、稳健性、可移植性、可控性与透明性的代码优化智能体基准。它以单一 ABI 在 CPU、GPU 与多节点环境下对 689 个内核进行统一评测，并通过外部裁判在秘密随机输入上验证正确性与计时，将每一份提交与答案全部归档以便追溯。实验得出的总体结论是：尽管开源权重模型已能稳定且显著地超越自动并行化器，但目前新提出的工具、技能包或测试框架（harness）大多并未真正加快智能体，而主要使其更昂贵或更廉价。HPCAgent-Bench 因此提出一套"做一次只改变一项、配对统计、权重明示"的评测规范，并通过 Zenodo 公开全部测量数据与脚本，使任何新干预的成本/性能影响可被独立复现。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used to optimize code, but existing benchmarks fix one accelerator, programming model or harness, so they cannot isolate what each component contributes or show whether added skills and tools repay their cost. We present HPCAgent-Bench with 689 kernels in three tracks: loop-level optimization challenges, kernels extracted from HPC codes, and machine-learning models. The framework specifies each kernel once in NumPy, derives C and Fortran references, accepts submissions through a common C ABI or Python interface, and runs them on CPUs or GPUs, on one or multiple nodes. An external judge checks correctness on hidden fuzzed inputs and times each submission, closing paths agents use to exploit the testing system. We introduce two metrics for reporting results: \textit{intervention efficacy} measures an intervention, such as adding a tool, through paired runs on speedup, success rate and cost, and \textit{weighted token cost} reports input, cached-input and output tokens under explicit weights. Agents reach up to $4.2\times$ speedup over automatic parallelizers, and their optimizations transfer to another machine: $93$--$99\%$ of answers without device-specific code remain correct, and per-kernel speedups keep a rank correlation of $r_s\ge0.84$. Across 40 matched setups, interventions significantly change speedup only twice but token cost by up to $3.0\times$. Because token weighting decides whether a saving is significant, we state the weights and release every token count as a standard for cost reporting. We provide the first comprehensive, broad and hardened benchmark for the sound evaluation of agentic optimization, with transparent cost metrics.

</details>


### [466] [Robotic-supported Data Loss Detection in Android Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20807)
*Davi Freitas,Breno Miranda,Juliano Iyoda*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为R-DLD（Robotic-supported Data Loss Detection）的机器人辅助Android应用数据丢失检测基础设施，通过低成本机器人模拟真实用户交互来非侵入性地检测应用中的数据丢失问题，实验成功在77个应用中发现341个数据丢失问题，89.55%获得开发者确认。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能手机应用开发面临两大挑战：1）需要在多种硬件和操作系统版本上进行测试；2）需要以非侵入性（类似终端用户交互）的方式进行测试，而手动测试成本高、繁琐且易出错。因此需要自动化机器人解决方案来应对多样化的智能手机系统并执行非侵入性测试。

Method: 提出R-DLD（机器人辅助数据丢失检测）基础设施：1）使用低成本材料构建机器人，便于在测试环境中采用；2）通过直接与智能手机传感器进行交互来实现更非侵入性、更真实的测试；3）作为Android应用数据丢失检测的机器人辅助框架。

Result: 在从Android应用商店随机选取的77个应用中，R-DLD成功识别出341个数据丢失问题。所有报告的bug均得到开发者响应，其中89.55%确认了数据丢失问题，35.82%已被后续修复。

Conclusion: R-DLD提供了一种有效的、成本可控的机器人辅助方案，能够以非侵入性方式检测Android应用中的数据丢失缺陷，具有较高的开发者认可率和修复率，有助于加速应用开发周期并减少手动测试工作量。

Abstract: Smartphones have become integral to modern life due to their diverse applications. However, the development of applications for these devices faces significant challenges, primarily due to two factors: (i) the diverse hardware and operating system versions that require testing across multiple configurations; and (ii) the imperative activity of testing the smartphone in a non-invasive way (similar to an end-user interaction), which is expensive, tedious and error-prone as it is usually carried out manually. In this context, robotic automation has emerged as an effective solution for addressing the diversity of smartphone systems and versions, and in performing some testing tasks non-invasively. In addition, automated robots facilitate quick, accurate, and repetitive testing, thus enabling developers to validate their applications across various configurations effectively. This results in a less invasive verification and in a significant reduction in time spent on manual testing, thus accelerating the development cycle. Our work proposes R-DLD (Robotic-supported Data Loss Detection), a robot-assisted infrastructure for data loss detection in Android applications, offeringless invasive and more realistic tests by interacting directly with smartphone sensors. The robot is constructed using cost-effective materials, facilitating its adoption in testing environments. In our empirical evaluation R-DLD successfully identified 341 data loss issues in 77 randomly selected apps from an Android store. All reported bugs received responses from the developer, with 89.55% confirming the data loss problems, while 35.82% have being subsequently fixed.

</details>


### [467] [Skip the Compressor: Coding Agents Fix More Issues When They Pick Whole Files](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21073)
*Xiaocong Yang,Rishit Chatterjee,Himanshu Udupi,Vikram Ramavarapu,ChengXiang Zhai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种名为CQ2-CARE的简单文件选择器,用于编码智能体在处理超出上下文窗口的大型代码仓库时,通过选择少量完整的原始文件(而非压缩令牌或检索片段)来填充上下文预算。实验表明,在300个SWE-rebench问题上,CQ2-CARE在GPT-5.6和Claude Opus 5上分别解决了43.7%和46.7%的问题,显著优于三类压缩器(LLMLingua-2、LongLLMLingua、LongCodeZip)和三类检索器(BM25 chunks、Dense、BM25 files),甚至优于两个专门针对问题解决训练的方法(SWE-Pruner和SweRank)。失败模式分析揭示:检索器经常遗漏需要编辑的文件,而压缩器虽然保留文件但改变了文本,导致补丁无法应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体需要在远大于其上下文窗口的代码仓库中工作。修复问题需要同时满足两个条件:(1)需要修改的文件必须出现在上下文中;(2)这些文件的代码必须与原始仓库完全一致,因为模型必须精确引用它要编辑的行。然而现有的两类方法——检索器(按与问题的相似度排序)和压缩器(删除令牌以适应预算)——分别存在不同缺陷:检索器可能遗漏需编辑的文件,压缩器可能改变文件文本,使补丁无法应用。在相同的令牌预算下,如何填充上下文才能让模型解决最多问题,是一个尚未系统比较的关键问题。

Method: 提出CQ2-CARE,一种精确文件选择器(exact-file selector),其核心思想是将预算花在选择"哪些文件需要完整展示"上,而非压缩现有内容或检索片段。算法流程:(1)从代码仓库中选取与问题共享最多词汇的路径清单(I,最多32K令牌);(2)让被测试的模型独立采样三次回答"哪些文件必须修改"(L₀、L₁、L₂);(3)取L₁和L₂共同命中的文件作为候选F(基于一致性作为可靠性信号),若无交集则回退到L₀;(4)过滤测试文件和文档目录中的路径,按倒数排名排序;(5)模型再规划最多4个搜索请求(如定义、调用者),通过grep找到对应片段作为补充证据E;(6)将F中的完整源代码文件和E中的片段组装为最终上下文,设80K令牌上限。关键设计:文件展示为完整verbatim,无需任何压缩模型参与。

Result: 在300个SWE-rebench问题上(2025年1月至2026年5月创建)进行预算匹配的受控对比,使用GPT-5.6和Claude Opus 5两个模型家族。主要结果:(1)CQ2-CARE在GPT-5.6上解决43.7%问题,Claude Opus 5上解决46.7%;(2)比最佳压缩器高6.3点(两个模型均如此);(3)比最佳检索器高9.3和12.7点;(4)比SWE-Pruner(训练型行级剪枝器)高2.0和7.3点,比SweRank(训练型整函数检索器)高0.7和1.7点;(5)与黄金文件上界(49.3%/46.3%)差距较小。失败分解分析揭示:检索器的损失主要来自"黄金文件召回率ρ"低(常漏掉需编辑的文件),压缩器的损失主要来自"逐字行率ε"低(虽然保留了文件但改变了文本,导致补丁应用率从98.0%降至70.7-89.7%)。受控测试表明,改变CQ2-CARE自身上下文中每行20%的令牌会使解决率降低9.7点(p<0.001),而同样从候选文件出发的LongCodeZip与CQ2-CARE表现相当(+1.0点)。稳健性检查:不同预算(25%/50%/75%)、搜索/替换编辑格式、第二个补丁样本下结论一致。在成本方面,CQ2-CARE的GPT-5.6每问题花费$0.151,低于LongLLMLingua($0.176)和SWE-Pruner($0.180)。

Conclusion: 在编码智能体的固定上下文预算下,选择少量完整的原始文件进行展示,比压缩令牌或检索片段能解决更多问题。该结论在两个模型家族和多种稳健性检查下一致成立。失败模式呈现清晰二分:检索器丢失了需编辑的文件,压缩器改变了补丁必须引用的文本,且每种损失都是独立的。该研究的核心启示是:对于需要精确引用的代码编辑任务,上下文预算应优先用于选择正确的完整文件,而非压缩已选内容。此外,中间指标(如本地化F1)可能产生误导——单次采样裁剪到相同文件数与双采样一致性能相当,因此应采用端到端、预算匹配、使用基准测试的评估方法。代码、提示和逐题结果将公开。

Abstract: A coding agent works on repositories that can be far larger than its context window can hold. Prompt compressors and retrievers offer solutions to this problem, but patching an issue needs two things at once: the files that must change, and their code exactly as written, since the model must reproduce the lines it edits. Retrievers rank code by its similarity to the issue rather than by whether it must change, and compressors delete text to fit the budget. We show that at an equal token budget, an agent resolves more issues when the budget goes to choosing which files to show verbatim, as our simple selector CQ2-CARE does, than when it goes to pruning tokens or retrieving chunks. We fit every context to the same per-issue budget on 300 recent SWE-rebench issues and grade each patch with the benchmark's tests. With GPT-5.6 and Claude Opus 5, CQ2-CARE resolves 43.7% and 46.7% of the issues, 6.3 points more than the best of three compressors with either model, and 9.3 and 12.7 points more than the best of three retrievers. CQ2-CARE even resolves more issues than two methods trained for issue resolution, SweRank (by 0.7 and 1.7 points) and SWE-Pruner (by 2.0 and 7.3). Our analysis shows the defects of the baseline methods: retrievers often miss the files to edit, and compressors keep them but alter their text, so fewer patches apply. Exact-file selection needs no compression model and shows every line as the repository has it, so the model can quote the code it edits.

</details>


### [468] [Plausible Is Not Enough: Trust and Evidence in AI-Authored Pull Request Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21144)
*Md Shamimur Rahman,Khairul Alam,Banani Roy,Chanchal K. Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究者调查了239名跨31国的从业者，对比其审核AI生成PR（AIPR）与人类编写PR（HPR）时的信任、证据要求和验证行为差异，发现审查者对AIPR采用更高证据门槛，并将其视为"证据归属问题"而非单纯正确性检查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI代理生成PR在软件开发中日益普及，审查者是否对AI代码应用与人类代码相同的审核标准尚不明确。理解这一差异有助于改进代码审查流程、AI代理工作流及工具设计。

Method: 采用配对调查设计（matched HPR vs. AIPR questions），向239名来自31个国家的从业者发放问卷，对比每位受访者在两种情境下的信任水平、证据要求、验证实践和决策行为。

Result: 64.9%受访者对AIPR初始信任较低；更依赖"提示者"（prompter）专业能力与变更规模边界，而非作者过往记录或子系统熟悉度。批准时55.2%认为自身推理对AIPR充分（对HPR仅28.5%），但更少依赖测试覆盖率。61.1%对AIPR要求更高证据；残余不确定性下阻止批准的比例从HPR的19.4%升至43.9%。验证手段首选测试检查、项目上下文和本地执行，复杂逻辑倾向部分重写。AIPR中"所有权不清晰"导致审查暂停的比例（29.3%）约为HPR（14.6%）的两倍。开放回答反映"难以验证无可靠上下文与人类问责的合理代码"。

Conclusion: AIPR审查本质是证据归属问题（evidence-ownership problem），而非单纯正确性验证。审查者需要将生成式变更与已验证行为及负责任维护者关联。代码审查工具与代理工作流应：暴露代码来源（provenance）、区分生成主张与人工验证证据、在批准前使不确定性可见。

Abstract: Code review is where AI-authored pull requests (AIPRs) must earn reviewer trust before integration, yet it is unclear whether reviewers apply the same criteria used for human-authored pull requests (HPRs). We surveyed 239 practitioners from 31 countries using matched HPR and AIPR questions to compare trust, evidence requirements, and verification practices within respondents. Most respondents (64.9%) reported lower initial trust in AIPRs. They relied less on author track record and subsystem familiarity, emphasizing instead human prompter expertise and bounded change size. For approval, respondents more often considered their own reasoning through critical cases sufficient for AIPRs than HPRs (55.2% versus 28.5%), while relying less on test coverage. Overall, 61.1% reported higher evidence requirements for AIPRs, and the share who would block approval under residual uncertainty increased from 19.4% for HPRs to 43.9% for AIPRs. Respondents prioritized test inspection, project context, and local execution, and more often selected partial reimplementation to verify non-trivial logic. Unclear ownership was also more likely to pause AIPR review (29.3% versus 14.6%). Open-ended responses pointed to the difficulty of validating plausible code without reliable context and human accountability. These findings frame AIPR review as an evidence-ownership problem, not merely a correctness check. Reviewers need to connect generated changes to validated behavior and responsible maintainers. Review tools and agentic workflows should expose provenance, distinguish generated claims from human-validated evidence, and make uncertainty visible before approval.

</details>


### [469] [Beyond Confidence: Rethinking Uncertainty Calibration in Deep Code Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21248)
*Ravishka Rathnasuriya,Wei Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文针对深度代码模型（漏洞检测与缺陷预测）系统研究了不确定性度量与后验校准对选择性预测（accept–defer）可靠性的实际效用，揭示了"校准分数改善≠选择性预测改善"这一核心问题，倡导联合评估校准质量、选择性预测质量与保留区域风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度代码模型在漏洞检测和缺陷预测等高可靠性需求任务中常出现过度自信错误。现有校准研究多以概率对齐（ECE等）为终点，忽视其对下游选择性预测（置信度高则接受、低则延迟至人工）实际效用的影响。作者认为校准分数改善未必带来更安全的部署决策，需重新审视不确定性校准在代码任务中的价值。

Method: 在漏洞检测（Devign，二分类）与缺陷预测（CodeChef，多分类）两个代码分类任务上，评估7个代码模型（CodeBERT、RoBERTa、GraphCodeBERT、StarCoder-3B、CodeLlama-7B、DeepSeek-Coder-7B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B）、13种不确定性信号（vanilla、entropy、MI、MC、RC、BvSB、MCD派生3种、DE派生3种等）、3种后验校准方法（TS、PS、Iso.R）。用ECE/MECE/BS衡量概率对齐，用风险-覆盖曲线衡量接受-延迟决策质量，并提出保留区域风险视角。

Result: 三大发现：（1）未校准时不确定性信号严重失准（漏洞检测ECE达1.79%–48.65%，缺陷预测最高72.14%），但AUARC仍可达0.681–0.754与0.885–0.927，说明排序能力与概率可靠性脱节；（2）PS与Iso.R大幅降低ECE（缺陷预测MI从72.13%降至0.10%），但AUARC几乎不变，揭示"校准分数改善≠选择性预测改善"，单调校准保持排序不变故不改变接受集合；（3）ECE、MECE、BS与AUARC衡量的可靠性属性不同，可对同一不确定性信号给出矛盾排名，且Iso.R会导致"桶塌缩"（bucket collapse），降低阈值决策的分辨率。建议联合报告校准质量、选择性预测质量与保留区域风险。

Conclusion: 数字层面的校准改进不应被视作部署可靠性的直接代理。代码模型可靠性需以"决策导向"视角重新定义：必须联合评估校准质量（ECE/MECE/BS）、选择性预测质量（AUARC）与保留区域风险（接受集合误差率、桶塌缩程度），否则高置信度错误将持续危及漏洞筛查与缺陷分诊等关键SE工作流中的接受-延迟决策安全。

Abstract: Deep learning models have shown significant promise in code-related tasks. While confidence calibration techniques have been proposed to improve model reliability, their effectiveness in real-world tasks with strict accuracy requirements remains uncertain. In this paper, we investigate two key questions: first, whether existing measurement metrics, including confidence scores and uncertainty metrics, are effective for guiding selective prediction; and second, whether existing calibration techniques can improve these metrics to better identify cases where model predictions are likely to succeed or fail. We conduct a systematic study on defect prediction and vulnerability detection using seven code models, evaluating thirteen uncertainty signals and three widely used post-hoc calibration methods. Our analysis reveals three major findings: (1) even strong uncertainty signals can remain poorly calibrated and provide limited separation at the high-confidence end, constraining selective prediction in practice; (2) standard post-hoc calibrators often improve calibration scores but do not consistently translate into better selective prediction behavior; and (3) commonly used calibration metrics can disagree with selective prediction performance, underscoring the need to evaluate both jointly. Moreover, our findings motivate a decision-oriented view of reliability in deep code models, where calibrated scores must be evaluated together with selective-prediction quality and retained-region risk before they can support accept--defer deployment.

</details>


### [470] [When CONTRIBUTING Files Fall Short: Revising OSS Contribution Guidelines with Repository Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21316)
*Kai Zheng,XinGuo Zhou,Xin Tan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出ContribAlign框架,通过分类引导的证据整合自动修订开源项目的CONTRIBUTING文件。其核心包含分类诊断、证据收集、冲突验证和分类生成四个阶段,并构建了包含30种细粒度指导类型的分类法。实验表明该方法在文档质量上有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源项目中CONTRIBUTING文件常存在信息不完整或过时的问题,现有研究虽能识别文档缺口,但无法提供修订所需的仓库特定知识。手动维护面临维护者时间有限等挑战,需要自动化工具来恢复并验证分散在仓库中的项目知识,以生成准确、完整的贡献指南。

Method: 提出ContribAlign框架,包含四个阶段:(1)基于预训练语言模型的六类贡献分类诊断器;(2)通过30种细粒度指导类型引导的RAG检索与类别专属的仓库证据处理(含RepoLaunch构建执行记录、PR评审记录、配置文件等);(3)基于规则的事实验证器,检查8类仓库特定声明(路径、标签、包脚本、运行时版本等);(4)按类别调用LLM生成并合成最终文档。分类器加权F1为0.764,验证器精确率97.3%、召回率91.5%。

Result: 在94个GitHub仓库上进行评估,人工评估显示ContribAlign修订的文档在正确性、有用性、新手友好性和完整性四个维度上均优于原始指南和三个基线,在40次对比中33次被选为优选修订。贡献最大的是有用性、新手友好性和完整性的显著提升。

Conclusion: 该研究表明通过类别特定的仓库证据并过滤检测到的冲突来生成贡献指南修订是可行的,为开源文档维护提供了实用工具。框架的细粒度分类法还可独立用作维护者手动修订的检查清单。局限性在于依赖单一LLM(DeePSeek-V4.1-Flash)且评估集中于成熟的GitHub项目,未来工作需扩展到更多样化的项目和生成模型。

Abstract: Contribution guidelines help newcomers participate in open-source software projects, yet often contain incomplete or outdated information. Existing studies characterize newcomers' information needs and documentation gaps, but revising these guidelines requires recovering and validating project-specific knowledge from scattered sources. We present ContribAlign, a framework for automatically revising CONTRIBUTING files through category-guided evidence integration. A qualitative analysis yields a taxonomy of 30 fine-grained guidance types across six contribution categories. ContribAlign uses a classifier to diagnose coverage of the six categories in the original guidance, then uses the taxonomy to collect and organize project-specific evidence. It filters detected conflicts and uses a large language model to generate category-level revisions. The classifier achieves a weighted F1 score of 0.764, improving on the existing classifier by 0.156, while the verifier detects factual conflicts with 97.3% precision and 91.5% estimated recall. Human evaluation shows that ContribAlign achieves the highest overall quality among the original guidelines and three baselines, with significant improvements in usefulness, beginner-friendliness, and completeness. These results suggest that ContribAlign can help maintain more accurate and useful contribution guidelines.

</details>


### [471] [SWE-at-Scale: Scalable Issue Synthesis from Historical Bug Fixes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21359)
*Silin Chen,Zihan Zhang,Xiaodong Gu,Jiale Huang,Yuling Shi,Han Li,Zhao Shan,Chengcheng Wan,Zhensu Sun,Haibing Guan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出SWE-at-Scale框架，通过反转真实软件修复来自动合成多样化的仓库级软件工程（SW )任务。该框架将有限的真实修复数据转化为可复用的监督信号，训练专用的bug注入模型在新代码上下文中生成多样化、可执行且具有挑战性的合成任务，在真实性和多样性方面优于现有合成基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着编码智能体能力提升，评估需要更多样化的可验证软件工程任务。然而真实任务受限于自然问题报告频率和人工标注的高成本，现有合成方法主要依赖大模型的预训练知识结合启发式提示，难以捕捉真实软件失败的复杂机制。需要一种可扩展的SW任务合成方法。

Method: SWE-at-Scale框架包含两阶段：（1）训练数据构建：从13,407个真实修复（来自688个仓库）反转构建（正确代码，错误代码）配对作为监督信号；（2）训练bug注入模型：使用Qwen3.5-9B作为骨干网络，采用LoRA监督微调学习从正确代码生成bug诱导补丁。提出两个变体：SWE-at-Scale直接学习生成bug诱导补丁，SWE-at-Scale+显式学习自然语言bug模式。任务组装通过基于执行的验证（导致通过测试变为失败的P2F测试）和LLM生成问题描述。

Result: 实验结果表明：SWE-at-Scale +达到94.0%的可用率和61.2%的人类偏好率，SWE-at-Scale达到72.6%和55.9%，均优于现有合成基线。任务难度方面，四个编码智能体的Pass@1范围为16.81%-48.48%，SWE-at-Scale +接近DeepSWE等人类专家设计任务的难度。在多样性方面，平均bug类型熵（MBTE）随采样预算从K=5的0.583增至K=200的2.063 bits，88.27%的可用补丁保持唯一；200代/文件时bug多样性仍稳健扩展。

Conclusion: SWE-at-Scale将有限真实修复转化为可复用监督信号，实现真实、多样且具有挑战性的可执行SW任务的可扩展合成。其反转学习范式使习得的bug分布可在推理时探索，从同一代码上下文生成不同bug类型，bug类型多样性随采样预算增长而持续扩展而不完全饱和。该方法为编码智能体评估提供了可持续的合成任务来源。

Abstract: As coding agents become increasingly capable, robust evaluation requires a broader and more diverse supply of verifiable software engineering (SWE) tasks. However, real-world tasks are constrained by the natural frequency of issue reporting and the substantial cost of manual curation. Furthermore, existing synthetic approaches rely primarily on the pretrained knowledge of large models coupled with heuristic prompting, often failing to capture the authentic, complex mechanics of software failures. To exponentially scale SWE task production, we introduce SWE-at-Scale, a framework that automatically synthesizes realistic issues by reverse-engineering real-world software fixes. Our key insight is that historical fixes encapsulate deep mechanistic knowledge of bug formation: inverting a fix transforms repair supervision into bug-induction supervision grounded in actual development scenarios. SWE-at-Scale transfers these learned bug patterns to novel code contexts, repeatedly sampling diverse bug typologies to construct executable SWE tasks. Extensive experiments show that SWE-at-Scale generates more diverse and realistic SWE tasks than current synthesis baselines while posing greater challenges to state-of-the-art coding agents. Notably, SWE-at-Scale can generate distinct bug types from a single code context, with bug diversity scaling robustly even up to 200 generations per file. Overall, SWE-at-Scale turns finite real-world fixes into reusable supervision for scalable synthesis of realistic, diverse, and challenging SWE tasks.

</details>


### [472] [Agentic Dependency Transformations: Lessons from an Exploratory Case Study of Flask](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21372)
*Kaya Kitada,Yoshiki Higo,Raula Gaikovina Kula*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过对 Flask 仓库的探索性案例研究，探讨了"依赖转换"（dependency transformation）这一新兴研究方向——即 AI 编码智能体（agent）改变代码仓库处理外部依赖的方式。研究围绕两个研究问题展开：一是可用上下文如何影响依赖发现，二是智能体迭代处理依赖时所采用的转换策略。最终得出五项初步教训和五部分研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代软件大量依赖第三方库，维护者需在复用收益与依赖维护风险之间权衡。现有自动化工具（如 Dependabot）主要支持版本更新和漏洞扫描，但在判断依赖使用位置、移除安全性及行为保持方面仍依赖人工。AI 编码智能体具备搜索代码库、编辑多文件、运行构建与测试的能力，使其有可能从根本上改变依赖处理方式（而非仅更新版本），因此提出"依赖转换"概念并开展早期探索。

Method: 以 Flask 固定提交（236 文件）为研究对象，使用 OpenAI ChatGPT 5.4 配合开源 pi 编码智能体框架进行实验。设计两类实验：(1) 通过有/无清单文件（manifest）上下文的两次会话对比依赖发现差异，记录执行时间、对话轮次、工具调用、token 数等指标，并将报告的候选依赖按来源（根声明、lockfile、示例、文档、构建工具）人工分类；(2) 设计"依赖转换工作流"，采用 Prompt A（执行转换并自修复）和 Prompt B（兜底修复）两提示驱动，对比有/无上下文条件下智能体逐一转换的处理结果，记录转换策略、完成阶段（首轮/重试）、直接完成与级联完成、测试产物变更等。

Result: RQ1 结果：有上下文时报告 114 个候选依赖（多为 lockfile 条目），无上下文时仅 28 个；27 个为两次会话共同报告。差异主要在于"报告范围"而非"发现能力"——无上下文会话仍从 import、测试、文档中恢复出 27 个根声明依赖中的 19 个。RQ2 结果：64 个候选全部达到"转换完成"（37 个首轮、27 个重试），其中 12 个为级联完成（均为 Celery 示例的依赖）。在 52 个直接完成中，归纳出五种转换策略：本地重实现（9）、标准库实现（4）、拷贝并自拥有（13）、依赖移除（17）、混合/配置替换（9）。智能体在 57/64 次转换中编辑了测试，创建 31 个新测试文件、修改 5 个，但未删除任何测试；至少一次转换改变了原始行为预期。

Conclusion: 本文提出"依赖转换"作为新兴研究方向，得出五项教训：(1) 可用上下文影响依赖发现的范围；(2) 依赖发现可能受下游目标驱动而不同；(3) 修复效率需多周期评估；(4) 依赖转换策略多样，不止于本地重实现；(5) 仅靠构建与测试通过不构成行为保持的独立证据。提出五部分研究议程：转换契约、转换分类法、超越构建与测试的验证、修复导向的智能体工作流、人工检查点与长期权衡。本文为早期观察性结果，而非验证性结论。

Abstract: Modern software relies heavily on third-party libraries, requiring maintainers to balance the benefits of reuse against dependency-related maintenance and risk. We define dependency transformation as an emerging approach in which an AI coding agent alters how a repository handles external dependencies. Local reimplementation is one transformation strategy that recreates required functionality as local code; dependency transformation is broader and may include other strategies. In this emerging-results paper, we report an exploratory case study of Flask to explore dependency transformation strategies. We design experiments that show how available context shapes an agent's dependency discovery and iterative transformation of dependencies. The case yields five preliminary lessons. These lessons and the five-part research agenda position dependency transformation as an emerging research direction and motivate explicit transformation contracts, provenance constraints, preservation requirements, and independent validation criteria.

</details>


### [473] [The Role of Agentic Instruction Categories for Code Generation: A Study of Five Python Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21421)
*Warren Gerald Polandra,Yoshiki Higo,Raula Gaikovina Kula*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了五类智能体指令（Repository Overview、Function Description、Implementation Detail、Testing、Reconstruction Steps）的31种非空组合在两个LLM（Gemma 4与GPT-5.4）和五个Python库上的代码生成效果，研究指令类别如何影响token成本、编译率、功能正确性与结构相似性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管agent文件（如AGENTS.md）已广泛用于智能体编码系统，但其中哪些指令类别真正有助于高效生成agent文件和高质量代码仍不清楚。盲目增加指令数量未必能降低成本或提升代码质量，因此需要细粒度地研究各类别的作用，以指导agent文件的编写与指令优先级动态调整。

Method: 采用5个trivial Python库（areyoustillthere、audiodiff、autolink、bitmap、compactor）与两个LLM（Gemma 4-26B-A4B、GPT-5.4），使用OpenCode的Plan+Build双智能体框架，遍历31种指令组合共生成310个AGENTS.md并据此重建310个库变体；评估维度为：agent文件生成的token使用量（RQ1）、编译成功率（RQ2a）、对人类编写测试的功能正确性（Passed/Partial/Failed，RQ2b）、结构指标（LoF、FL、CC、FC）与人类编写版本的相似度（RQ2c）。

Result: ◆ RQ1：token使用量由LLM与目标库特征主导，而非指令数量；GPT-5.4在RepoOvw+FuncDec+ImpDetl+ReConStp组合下token最高（compactor库，888,781），Gemma 4最低token组合为FuncDec+ImpDetl（bitmap库，68,070），单类与多类组合均出现在最高与最低token列表中。◆ RQ2a：编译率对指令类别不敏感，Gemma 4为88.39%，GPT-5.4为98.06%；Testing类别略最高。◆ RQ2b：Gemma 4无任何变体通过全部测试（Function Description获20%最高partial率），GPT-5.4有12.99%全部通过（Reconstruction Steps获16.25%最高full-pass率）。◆ RQ2c：Reconstruction Steps最频繁地出现在LoF（6/10）与总CC（7/11）最接近人类的组合中；Testing与Reconstruction Steps并列最频繁出现在FL（各11/16）与FC（12/19）最相似的组合中。◆ 综合：指令选择应根据目标结果与LLM定制，盲目堆砌指令类别不可靠。

Conclusion: 提供更多指令类别既不能可靠降低agent文件生成成本，也未必提升生成代码质量；指令组合的效果高度依赖于目标结果（成本/正确性/结构相似性）与所选LLM。研究结果呼吁：（1）将指令视为可配置资源，针对任务与模型动态选择相关指令；（2）未来基准应在更细粒度的指令层面而非整体artifact层评估agent文件；（3）在更大规模、多样化系统与多智能体框架中重复研究，以验证与推广结论。

Abstract: Agentic coding systems increasingly rely on repository-level agent files, such as this http URL , to communicate project knowledge and developer intent. However, it remains unclear which categories of agent instructions enable efficient agent-file generation and accurate code generation. We evaluate five instruction categories: Repository Overview, Function Description, Implementation Detail, Testing, and Reconstruction Steps, across all 31 non-empty combinations using two Large Language Models (LLMs), Gemma 4 and GPT-5.4, and five human-written Python libraries. Our study addresses two research questions, comprising five sub-questions, on agent file generation and code generation. Results show that the number of instructions alone does not determine token usage for agent-file generation, with substantial variation across models and libraries. Although most AI-generated libraries compiled successfully regardless of the instruction combination, functional correctness remained limited. No Gemma 4 variant passed all tests, whereas 12.99% of GPT-5.4 variants did. Function Description achieved Gemma 4's highest partial-pass rate, while Reconstruction Steps achieved GPT-5.4's highest full-pass rate. For structural similarity to human-written code, Reconstruction Steps was most frequently associated with libraries closest to the originals in Lines of File and total Cyclomatic Complexity, while Testing and Reconstruction Steps were jointly most frequent for File Count and Function Count.

</details>


### [474] [Realization Divergence in Multi-Provider Quantum Computing: A Pre-Registered Study of What Survives Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21714)
*Jouni Peltonen,Vlad Stirbu,Tommi Mikkonen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究多供应商量子计算中的"实现发散"（Realization Divergence）：相同源电路在不同量子软件栈下编译与执行时产生的可观测差异。通过在三家供应商（IQM、IonQ、Rigetti）的四台设备上开展预注册实验，结合分层观测模型与边界检查，发现：1）发散排序依赖布局策略与设备，而非电路规模本身；2）供应商接口可观测性差异显著限制跨平台比较；3）复合工具链存在三类静默接口故障。文章主张操作性可移植性必须在显式观测层与有效性条件下测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子程序经编译器、转译器和供应商服务处理后，"所写即所跑"的距离鲜被测量。跨供应商比较日益重要，但异构接口限制了可观测性，现有研究未能系统区分软件效应与硬件噪声，也未建立跨工具链的可靠性检查。

Method: 基于设计科学研究（DSR），构建四阶段工具链（转译→结构分析→执行→发散量化），采用Qiskit v2.5.1（optimization level 3）与Amazon Braket API。分层观测模型覆盖源语言层(L_src)、中间表示层(L_ir)、转译层(L_target)、执行层(L_exec)；结构发散使用加权相对差异得分（深度/双比特门数/总门数，权重网格66组）；分布发散使用Jensen-Shannon散度；预注册预测与显式探索性分析并行。主要实验：132次主硬件运行（11电路×3设备×2轨道×2重复）+ IonQ控制实验 + Rigetti布局匹配回顾附加实验。

Result: 1）嵌入半径与双比特开销Spearman相关0.805（vs 电路规模0.492），在239次分配布局嵌入中成立；2）BV8-BV12执行发散在IQM Emerald上呈正向（重复中置信区间不相交），在IQM Garnet上呈反向，IonQ全连接控制上消失；3）BV8-BV12结构反演在最低索引布局下对66组权重均成立，在编译器默认布局下消失；4）Rigetti Cepheus跟踪比较中所有六个支持/原生比率上置信限均低于注册阈值2×，但未建立等价性；5）Rigetti Ankaa-3与Cepheus支持操作列表完全相同，但原生纠缠门从iswap变为cz；6）复合工具链存在三类故障：需要但未声明、声明但未消费、接受但被覆盖。

Conclusion: 实现发散测量需明确指定观测层、参考、布局、度量权重与不确定性。结构加权敏感性支持特定条件排序而非通用架构聚类；供应商接口限制跨平台声明的边界；复合工具链的静默失败需通过元数据验证、能力探测、布局检查与结果编码检查检测。操作性可移植性主张必须附带其有效性条件方可辩护。

Abstract: Quantum programs pass through compilers, transpilers and vendor services before execution. However, the distance between what was written and what runs is rarely measured. We call this distance realization divergence: the observable difference in how an identical source circuit is realized and behaves across quantum software stacks. We report a hardware study across three vendors and four devices, combining pre-registered predictions with explicitly identified exploratory analyses and amendments. In a compilation experiment with assigned placement policies, embedding radius correlates with two-qubit overhead at Spearman 0.805, against 0.492 for circuit size. Under a fixed lowest-index policy, an eight-qubit Bernstein-Vazirani circuit exhibits greater execution divergence than a twelve-qubit circuit on IQM Emerald. The opposite ordering occurs on IQM Garnet. Both comparisons replicate across two repetitions with disjoint confidence intervals. These results support a placement-dependent explanation, without isolating individual hardware noise mechanisms. The same ordering inversion is absent on the all-to-all IonQ control. On Rigetti Cepheus, a follow-up using topology-aware native placement found no consistent advantage in correct-answer probability for either submission track, but did not establish equivalence between the tracks. Structural comparisons depend on metric weighting, placement and device generation. Provider interfaces also limit observability: Rigetti's supported-operation list remained unchanged across a device generation that replaced the native entangler. We classify silent interface failures in composed toolchains and identify checks at toolchain boundaries, connecting valid cross-provider comparisons with concrete software-quality practices.

</details>


### [475] [Benchmarking and Enhancing Design-Aware Code Review in the Linux Kernel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21925)
*Zhenhao Zhou,Kai Yu,Ying Wang,Zhiqiang Yuan,Junhao Zeng,Yijian Wu,Chong Wang,Xin Peng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对代码审查中超越局部正确性的"设计感知"推理问题，提出了DesignLore方法与DesignReviewBench基准。研究从Linux内核mm子系统历史评审中挖掘决策案例并构建自适应设计分类法，以指导新补丁的设计权衡检测。实验表明，现有编码代理在设计感知审查上能力有限（最强基线Sashiko F1仅0.213），而DesignLore取得0.259的F1，相对提升21.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成熟软件系统（如Linux内核）的代码审查需要推理设计权衡，识别替代方案并考虑项目特定约束，而现有自动化审查方法主要关注缺陷和正确性，难以复用历史评审讨论中积累的设计知识。

Method: 形成性研究：对2021–2026年600个评审线程进行四步决策案例挖掘流水线（原子建议提取、回复约束的逻辑关系归纳、决策案例合成、线程级案例完整性反思），构建层次化设计分类法。DesignLore包含三个阶段：决策知识提取、设计分类法构建（轮次式自顶向下，含批标注、结构细化）、设计知识增强的代码审查（基于知识的规划与代码验证）。基准DesignReviewBench包含72个补丁系列和79个参考设计权衡。

Result: DesignLore在DesignReviewBench上F1达0.259，相比最优基线Sashiko相对提升21.6%，相比OpenCode-RAG相对提升22.7%，且成本仅为Sashiko的一半。在三种代理系统和四种骨干模型上均保持一致增益。累积消融显示各阶段均有贡献，第三阶段（规划与验证）贡献最大。LLM评估与人类判断高度一致（Pearson R=0.945）。离线构建知识库成本为324.6美元。

Conclusion: 设计权衡在Linux内核代码审查中普遍存在（约60%线程涉及）且常复发（约34%线程有相关历史先例）。现有编码代理在设计感知审查方面能力有限，而DesignLore通过恢复、组织并复用历史设计知识，实现了优于现有方法的性能，并能在不同代理系统和骨干模型间泛化。研究强调了设计感知审查的重要性，展示了显式恢复和结构化历史设计知识以提升自动化代码审查的潜力。

Abstract: Code review often requires reasoning beyond local correctness. In mature software systems, reviewers must recognize design trade-offs introduced by a proposed change, compare alternative solutions, and reason about their compatibility with project-specific constraints. We refer to this problem as design-aware code review. However, existing automated review approaches primarily focus on defects and correctness, while the design knowledge accumulated in historical review discussions remains difficult to reuse. To address these challenges, we present DesignLore, a knowledge-augmented approach that extracts design decisions from historical review discussions, organizes them into an adaptive design taxonomy, and reuses relevant historical knowledge to guide code review. We further construct DesignReviewBench, a benchmark derived from real patch-review histories for systematically evaluating design-aware code review. Our evaluation shows that design-aware review remains challenging for current coding agents, with the strongest baseline achieving an F1 of only 0.213 on design trade-off detection. In comparison, DesignLore achieves an F1 of 0.259, a 21.6% relative improvement, and consistently delivers gains across different agent systems and backbone. These results highlight the importance of design-aware review and demonstrate the potential of recovering and reusing historical design knowledge to support it.

</details>


### [476] [Stateful Testing for Deep Learning Compilers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22003)
*Jiatao Ge,Ruixiang Qian,Yibo Hu,Yanzhou Mu,Yinglong Zou,Jiawei Liu,Zhenyu Chen,Chunrong Fang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Rondo是首个针对深度学习编译器的状态化测试方法。它将测试用例建模为⟨模型, 调用序列⟩, 通过变异调用序列和基于编译行为的MCMC采样来探索编译器状态。Rondo使用三路差分测试预言(无编译、编译无状态保留、编译保留状态)来检测有状态编译器缺陷, 并通过最小化调用序列保留缺陷复现条件。在四个深度学习框架(PyTorch、JAX、TensorFlow、MindSpore)上检测出117个缺陷(35个有状态缺陷), 提交39份报告, 开发者确认35份, 修复18个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度学习编译器(如PyTorch的torch.compile)采用惰性编译并跨调用缓存编译产物, 导致编译器状态(缓存的代码、guards等)会影响后续调用, 即使单独调用正确, 后续调用也可能出错。现有测试方法通常只测试单次调用⟨模型, 调用⟩, 无法显式捕获建立编译器状态所需的先前调用序列。通过分析26个公开报告的缺陷, 作者发现检测此类有状态缺陷需要: (1) 跨调用的缺陷触发, (2) 巨大的测试空间, (3) 缺少可用的预言机来判定错误是否由编译器状态引起。

Method: 1. **测试表示**: 将测试用例定义为⟨模型M, 调用序列X⟩, 通过固定的初始状态和调用序列来确定达到的编译器状态κ_h, 使状态可重现和探索。2. **测试空间探索**: (a) 通过13种变异算子(改变输入形状/类型/布局/设备/重采样/缩放/特殊值/更新参数/模式切换/恢复状态/反向传播/重复/截断)生成新测试用例; (b) 当编译器约束可用时使用SMT求解器合成输入以满足特定guard条件; (c) 使用自适应MCMC采样器, 基于编译行为键的稀有度评分来引导搜索, 偏好产生罕见编译行为的序列。3. **三路差分测试预言**: 对每个测试用例运行三种模式——无编译(Without compilation)、编译无状态保留(Compiled without state, 每次调用前重置编译器状态)、编译保留状态(Compiled with state)——使用结构化观测(返回值值树和程序状态)和表征感知的数值比较规则比较输出、形状和dtype、特殊值(NaN、Inf、有符号零、次正规数), 并应用6项独立语义检查(精度、确定性、位模式一致性、数学恒等式、多实现共识、数学界限)。4. **状态化缺陷确认与最小化**: 通过在保留和重置编译器状态下重复同一调用(同时保持输入和程序状态对齐)来确认状态化缺陷; 将见证分类为stateful、point-wise、history-exposed; 通过删除调用块或简化输入来最小化调用序列, 同时保留见证类、原始调用、失败模式和症状签名。

Result: **RQ1 缺陷检测**: 在PyTorch、JAX、TensorFlow、MindSpore四个框架中共检测117个缺陷(其中35个有状态缺陷), 提交39份缺陷报告(18份为状态化缺陷), 开发者确认35份(16份状态化缺陷), 修复18个缺陷(11个状态化缺陷)。**RQ2 多样性与覆盖率**: Rondo在四种行为覆盖率指标(Input/Path/Guard/HBC)和编译器Python源代码行覆盖率上均最高。HBC为0.242, 比最强基线RandomHistory高106.66%; 源代码行覆盖率为14.94%(覆盖33,591行)。**RQ3 组件消融**: 移除编译反馈使Input/Path/Guard分别下降44.44%/48.00%/48.19%; 移除状态操作使HBC下降49.01%; 移除return算子影响回退调用的覆盖率; SMT合成带来较小的Input/Path/HBC增益。**RQ4 预言有效性**: 从仅崩溃检查到完整预言, 真阳性从31增加到539; 完整预言的告警精度达99.26%, 仅4个误报(假发现率0.74%)。**RQ5 序列最小化**: 117个测试用例中44个(37.61%)被有效缩短; 这44个序列的压缩比平均为83.34%, 调用数从22.18降至1.73。

Conclusion: Rondo首次系统地研究了深度学习编译器中的状态化缺陷, 提出了用调用序列表征和探索编译器状态的新视角。核心创新在于: (1) 将测试用例表示为⟨模型, 调用序列⟩以显式捕获跨调用状态依赖; (2) 三路差分预言(无编译/编译无状态/编译保留状态)能有效区分编译器缺陷和状态化缺陷; (3) 基于编译行为反馈的MCMC引导搜索比随机搜索更高效地探索状态空间。实证表明, Rondo能在四种主流深度学习框架中发现大量真实的状态化和非编译器缺陷, 行为覆盖率和源代码行覆盖率均优于现有方法。该工作揭示了单次调用测试的局限性, 为编译器测试社区提供了新的研究方向和工具。

Abstract: Modern deep learning compilers compile models lazily and cache artifacts across invocations. Retained compiler state can make a later invocation incorrect even when it is correct in isolation. An analysis of 26 publicly reported issues in PyTorch, JAX, and TensorFlow shows that detecting such bugs requires sequences that first establish compiler state and then expose a failure. We present Rondo, a stateful testing method that represents each test case as a model paired with an invocation sequence. Rondo mutates invocation sequences and uses a Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler guided by compilation behavior to favor rarely observed behaviors. Its three-way differential oracle compares execution without compilation, compiled execution with compiler state reset, and compiled execution with state retained. It confirms stateful bugs by replaying the same invocation with state retained and reset while preserving inputs and program state, then shortens sequences while preserving the original bug. We evaluate Rondo on four deep learning frameworks using 24 common model architectures. Rondo detects 117 bugs, including 35 stateful bugs. We submit 39 bug reports, including 18 for stateful bugs; developers confirm 35 reports, including 16 for stateful bugs, and fix 18 bugs, including 11 stateful bugs. Rondo achieves the highest behavior coverage and compiler Python source-line coverage among the compared methods, with 99.26% alarm precision. It shortens 44 of 117 invocation sequences, reducing the lengths of these 44 sequences by 83.34% on average.

</details>


### [477] [WEAVE: Weaving Real-World Code Evolution into Dependency-Structured Tasks for Benchmarking and Training Code Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22039)
*Weihao Li,Zihang Xu,Zhongqiu Wang,Songwei Yu,Wenqiang Zhu,Yuechen Luo,Jingxuan Xu,Yanan Wu,Haoyang Huang,Ken Deng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: WEAVE提出了一种将代码仓库中多个相关PR（拉取请求）转化为具有依赖结构的可执行任务框架，并引入Graph Credit指标用于依赖一致的进度评估与代码智能体训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可执行仓库级基准（如SWE-bench）以单一issue/PR为任务单元，无法刻画真实软件工程中跨多个PR的依赖结构（特性开发、迁移、系统性修复等），导致任务聚合粗糙、评估结构无关、长程代码智能体的进度衡量与学习信号受限。

Method: 1) 类型化变更位点（typed change loci）：从PR diff中提取AST声明、轻量符号、配置/模式项、声明签名、依赖键五类细粒度程序实体；2) 仓库校准耦合：采用类似TF-IDF的逆频率加权计算PR间耦合分数，过滤机械变更（revert/backport/cherry-pick/近重复），组装为有界依赖DAG；3) 可执行任务实例化：通过reverse-topological revert或LLM辅助carve构造基态，统一任务规范，并进行节点级测试归属；4) Graph Credit：基于递归最小值（min-bottleneck）算子，将下游节点得分约束为上游依赖完成的最小值；5) 训练：以Graph Credit为核心组件的复合奖励进行SFT+GRPO强化学习，采用三阶段DAG复杂度课程。

Result: 构建了3200训练任务与300评测任务，覆盖6种编程语言。在30个仓库/219条专家标注依赖边上的依赖恢复AP达37.7%（次优基线26.6%），覆盖率84.5%。8个前沿模型×2种scaffold的评测显示Flat-F2P平均比Graph Credit高10.5pp（"phantom credit"），随机图对照下该差距降至<2pp。SFT中WEAVE相比Atomic-PR在Resolved上提升3.0/3.7pp（4B/35B），Graph Credit提升5.4/6.2pp；token效率至少4×。GRPO中R_WEAVE比binary Resolved奖励高3.7pp（4B）和4.3pp（35B），比flat F2P高2.0/2.6pp；Graph Credit与Resolved的Spearman相关性达0.82（vs Flat-F2P 0.69）。

Conclusion: 依赖结构化任务是评估和改进长程代码智能体的原则性基础。WEAVE通过仓库校准的类型化位点耦合恢复真实PR依赖DAG，统一了任务构建、依赖条件评估（Graph Credit）与可验证的RL奖励信号。Graph Credit的min-bottleneck设计在算子对比与随机图消融中得到验证，能有效揭示并消除扁平评分下的"phantom credit"。

Abstract: Real-world software engineering rarely consists of isolated changes. Features, migrations, and systematic fixes often unfold across multiple pull requests (PRs), requiring coordinated modifications across a repository. Yet most executable repository-level benchmarks retain a single issue or PR as the task unit, while existing multi-PR settings rely on coarse aggregation and structure-agnostic evaluation. This mismatch obscures dependencies among changes and limits progress measurement and learning signals for long-horizon code agents. We introduce WEAVE, a framework that transforms verified PR histories into executable, dependency-structured tasks. WEAVE leverages repository-calibrated typed change loci to organize related PRs into bounded DAGs and instantiate each as a unified executable task. We further introduce Graph Credit, a deterministic, test-grounded metric that measures dependency-consistent partial progress and supports dense, verifiable rewards for reinforcement learning. Experiments on task construction, agent evaluation, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning show that WEAVE yields coherent executable tasks, enables more faithful progress measurement than flat scoring, and provides effective supervision and verifiable rewards for training code agents.

</details>


### [478] [Are We Testing the Wrong Quantum Bugs? A Study of Fault Representation Gaps in Quantum Software Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22089)
*Asif Mohammed Saad,Ahsanul Ameen Sabit,Jonah Brandenburgh,Jiyuan Wang,Qian Zhang,Soneya Binta Hossain*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对量子软件测试中的故障表示差距进行了实证研究，通过审计四个量子变异测试工具、三个精选错误基准和410个真实GitHub错误，揭示了现有故障模型与实际量子软件故障之间存在86.6%的巨大差距，表明当前测试方法主要关注电路级故障，而忽略了编译器、表示层和框架接口中的真实故障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子程序依赖编译器、中间表示和执行框架，这些组件中的故障会改变正确程序的行为。然而，量子测试技术通常使用变异生成的故障和精选错误基准进行评估，但这些伪故障是否反映现代量子软件中的真实故障尚不清楚。本文旨在填补这一空白，量化现有故障表示与实际量子软件故障之间的差距。

Method: 三阶段实证研究方法：(1) 构建基线——审计四个量子变异测试工具(QMutPy、Muskit、QCRMut、QuanForge)的48个操作符和三个精选基准(Bugs4Q-NA、Bug-Pattern、Bugs in Quantum Computing Platforms)的310个案例，建立35个错误家族分类；(2) 收集分类——从2024年7月至2026年7月间收集10个量子软件仓库(Qiskit、PennyLane、Cirq、TKET、CUDA-Q、Amazon Braket、Mitiq、QuTiP、OpenQASM、PyQuil)的1019个GitHub问题，通过AI辅助策展和双人独立审查保留410个经过验证的错误；(3) 审查比较——将所有错误分类到56个家族，跨来源比较故障表示。三源统一分类到56个错误家族是方法核心。

Result: 研究发现巨大的代表性差距：四个变异测试工具仅支持20个错误家族(11个量子特异+9个经典)，精选基准额外添加15个家族(共35个)。但410个真实错误中只有56个(13.7%)属于这些已有家族，354个(86.3%)属于两类来源都未涵盖的家族。最大的未表示家族是编译器转换错误(66个)、类型处理错误(53个)、输入验证缺失(47个)、电路构造错误(29个)和依赖不兼容性(28个)。按源划分：仅23个错误(5.6%)有变异支持的家族，33个有精选基准家族，354个是仅野外发现的。Qiskit和PennyLane贡献了310个错误，但即使移除它们，89.0%的错误仍是仅野外发现的。21个家族完全缺席于现有来源。这些故障通常依赖于中间表示、编译器流水线、输入类型或依赖版本，而非孤立的门或语句修改。

Conclusion: 研究得出四个关键教训：(1) 正确的电路不能保证正确编译——编译器转换错误是最大的未覆盖家族；(2) 表示边界需要显式的正确性检查——类型处理、格式转换和序列化错误频繁；(3) 故障模型必须捕获上下文而非仅本地编辑——许多故障依赖特定编译器流水线、依赖版本或多种机制交互(19个错误有多个家族)；(4) 基准必须保留失败条件并随软件演进。整体结论：量子软件测试必须超越电路级故障，转向测试编译器语义、表示边界和组件交互，未来的故障模型和基准应覆盖这些机制。

Abstract: Quantum software relies on compilers, intermediate representations, and execution frameworks that transform programs before execution. Faults in these components can change the behavior of otherwise correct quantum programs. Yet quantum testing techniques are often evaluated using mutation-generated faults and curated bug benchmarks. We investigate how well the faults represented by these artifacts reflect those encountered in modern quantum software. We audit four quantum mutation-testing tools and three curated bug benchmarks, and collect 410 verified bugs from ten quantum software repositories over two years. We classify faults from all three sources into a common taxonomy of 56 bug families and compare their representation across mutation operators, curated benchmarks, and recent real-world bugs. The mutation tools support 20 bug families, and curated benchmarks add 15 more. Yet only 56 of the 410 real-world bugs (13.7%) belong to families represented by either source; the remaining 354 (86.3%) belong to families absent from both. The largest unrepresented families concern compiler transformations (66 bugs), type handling (53), and input validation (47). Unlike local gate or statement changes, these faults often depend on intermediate representations, compiler pipelines, input types, or dependency versions. Existing mutation operators primarily modify circuits and program constructs, whereas many real-world faults arise in the compilers, representations, and framework interfaces that process them. Addressing this gap requires looking beyond circuit-level faults toward testing semantic preservation across compiler transformations, correctness at representation boundaries, and interactions between software components. Our study provides empirical evidence to guide fault models and benchmarks that capture these mechanisms and preserve the contexts needed to reproduce them.

</details>
